/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Topology.ContinuousMap.CompactlySupported.FixedSupport
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.MultiplierActions
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.ContinuousLinearMap
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Set

/-!
# Literal Haar convolution as an actual fixed-support Banach-valued integral

For original f and h, the curve s ↦ f(s)·α_s(h(s⁻¹·)) lies in the stock
bounded-function subspace supported in tsupport(f)·tsupport(h). Joint
coefficient continuity makes this an actual continuous compactly supported
Banach-valued curve. Bounded point evaluations identify its integral with
the original convolution. Its bounded map to the literal L1 completion
therefore gives the original completed convolution image.

The fixed-support carrier and integral are constructed, not supplied as
model or agreement hypotheses. No raw or L1 C-star square law is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped CompactlySupported Pointwise

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The original compact product supports both the convolution and all its coefficient slices. -/
def convolutionSupport (f h : Carrier μ α) : Set G :=
  tsupport (toCc μ α f) * tsupport (toCc μ α h)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The product of the original two compact supports is compact. -/
theorem isCompact_convolutionSupport (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    IsCompact (convolutionSupport μ α f h) :=
  (toCc μ α f).hasCompactSupport.mul (toCc μ α h).hasCompactSupport

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The same product is closed without imposing separatedness on the original group. -/
theorem isClosed_convolutionSupport (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    IsClosed (convolutionSupport μ α f h) :=
  (isClosed_tsupport (toCc μ α h)).mul_left_of_isCompact (toCc μ α f).hasCompactSupport

/-- The literal original coefficient-left/group-left slice in one actual complete support carrier. -/
def compactConvolutionCurve (f h : Carrier μ α) (s : G) :
    BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h) := by
  let F := toCc μ α f
  let H := toCc μ α h
  let c : C_c(G, A) := coefficientLeftCc (F s) (groupLeftCc α s H)
  have hzero (x : G) (hx : x ∉ convolutionSupport μ α f h) : c x = 0 := by
    change F s * α s (H (s⁻¹ * x)) = 0
    by_cases hs : s ∈ tsupport F
    · have hH : s⁻¹ * x ∉ tsupport H := by
        intro hHx
        apply hx
        change x ∈ tsupport F * tsupport H
        simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using Set.mul_mem_mul hs hHx
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hH, α.apply_zero, mul_zero]
    · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hs, zero_mul]
  have hSupport : tsupport c ⊆ convolutionSupport μ α f h := by
    apply closure_minimal
    · intro x hx
      by_contra hnot
      exact hx (hzero x hnot)
    · exact isClosed_convolutionSupport μ α f h
  exact BoundedContinuousFunction.ccToSupported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h) c hSupport

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Every Banach-curve coefficient is the original twisted convolution kernel. -/
@[simp]
theorem compactConvolutionCurve_apply (f h : Carrier μ α) (s x : G) :
    (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s).1 x = f s * α s (h (s⁻¹ * x)) :=
  rfl

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The fixed-support Banach curve is exactly the existing original multiplier slice as a C_c value. -/
theorem toCc_compactConvolutionCurve (f h : Carrier μ α) (s : G) :
    BoundedContinuousFunction.supportedToCc ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h)
        (isCompact_convolutionSupport μ α f h) (isClosed_convolutionSupport μ α f h)
        (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s) =
      toCc μ α (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h)) := by
  apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Joint original-kernel continuity gives continuity in the true fixed-support Banach norm. -/
theorem continuous_compactConvolutionCurve (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    Continuous (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h) := by
  apply BoundedContinuousFunction.continuous_supported_of_joint ℂ A
    (convolutionSupport μ α f h) (isCompact_convolutionSupport μ α f h)
  change Continuous (fun p : G × G => kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) p.2 p.1)
  exact (continuous_kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h)).comp continuous_swap

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual Banach-valued curve vanishes outside the original first compact support. -/
theorem hasCompactSupport_compactConvolutionCurve (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    HasCompactSupport (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h) := by
  refine HasCompactSupport.intro' (toCc μ α f).hasCompactSupport (isClosed_tsupport (toCc μ α f)) ?_
  intro s hs
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
  intro x
  change (toCc μ α f) s * α s (h (s⁻¹ * x)) = 0
  rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hs, zero_mul]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The literal continuous compactly supported Banach curve is Haar integrable. -/
theorem integrable_compactConvolutionCurve (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    Integrable (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h) μ :=
  (continuous_compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    (hasCompactSupport_compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Bounded evaluation identifies the actual Banach-valued integral with the original convolution. -/
theorem toCc_integral_compactConvolutionCurve (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h)) :=
      NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
    BoundedContinuousFunction.supportedToCc ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h)
        (isCompact_convolutionSupport μ α f h) (isClosed_convolutionSupport μ α f h)
        (∫ s : G, compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s ∂μ) =
      ccConvolution μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) := by
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h)) :=
    NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
  intro x
  let L : BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h) →L[ℂ] A :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.supportedEvalCLM ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h) x
  have hL := L.integral_comp_comm (integrable_compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h)
  change L (∫ s : G, compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s ∂μ) =
    ccConvolution μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) x
  calc
    _ = ∫ s : G, L (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s) ∂μ := hL.symm
    _ = ∫ s : G, f s * α s (h (s⁻¹ * x)) ∂μ := rfl
    _ = _ := (ccConvolution_apply μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) x).symm

/-- The original fixed-support L1 image is bounded by support measure times its sup norm. -/
theorem norm_supportedToL1_raw_le (K : Set G) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKclosed : IsClosed K)
    (b : BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A K) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    ‖toL1Completion μ α (fromCc μ α (BoundedContinuousFunction.supportedToCc ℂ A K hK hKclosed b))‖ ≤
      μ.real K * ‖b‖ := by
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  have hzero (x : G) (hx : x ∉ K) : ‖b.1 x‖ = 0 := by rw [b.2 x hx, norm_zero]
  have hcompact : HasCompactSupport (fun x : G => ‖b.1 x‖) :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro' hK hKclosed hzero
  have hnorm : Integrable (fun x : G => ‖b.1 x‖) μ :=
    b.1.continuous.norm.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcompact
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : G, ‖b.1 x‖ ∂μ := by rw [norm_toL1Completion]; rfl
    _ = ∫ x in K, ‖b.1 x‖ ∂μ :=
      (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hzero).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ _ in K, ‖b‖ ∂μ :=
      integral_mono hnorm.integrableOn (integrableOn_const hK.measure_ne_top)
        (fun x => BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_coe_le_norm b.1 x)
    _ = μ.real K * ‖b‖ := by rw [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul]

/-- The original fixed-support functions map boundedly to their literal L1 completion images. -/
def supportedToL1Completion (K : Set G) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKclosed : IsClosed K) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A K →L[ℂ] L1Completion μ α := by
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  let J : BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A K →ₗ[ℂ] L1Completion μ α :=
    { toFun b :=
        toL1Completion μ α (fromCc μ α (BoundedContinuousFunction.supportedToCc ℂ A K hK hKclosed b))
      map_add' b c := by
        have heq :
            fromCc μ α (BoundedContinuousFunction.supportedToCc ℂ A K hK hKclosed (b + c)) =
              fromCc μ α (BoundedContinuousFunction.supportedToCc ℂ A K hK hKclosed b) +
                fromCc μ α (BoundedContinuousFunction.supportedToCc ℂ A K hK hKclosed c) := by
          apply ext μ α
          intro x
          rfl
        rw [heq, map_add]
      map_smul' r b := by
        have heq :
            fromCc μ α (BoundedContinuousFunction.supportedToCc ℂ A K hK hKclosed (r • b)) =
              r • fromCc μ α (BoundedContinuousFunction.supportedToCc ℂ A K hK hKclosed b) := by
          apply ext μ α
          intro x
          rfl
        rw [heq, map_smul, RingHom.id_apply] }
  exact J.mkContinuous (μ.real K) (norm_supportedToL1_raw_le μ α K hK hKclosed)

/-- The bounded fixed-support map retains the original canonical L1 coefficient image. -/
@[simp]
theorem supportedToL1Completion_apply (K : Set G) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKclosed : IsClosed K)
    (b : BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A K) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    supportedToL1Completion μ α K hK hKclosed b =
      toL1Completion μ α (fromCc μ α (BoundedContinuousFunction.supportedToCc ℂ A K hK hKclosed b)) :=
  rfl

/-- The Banach-to-L1 map has the true finite-support-measure sup-norm bound. -/
theorem norm_supportedToL1Completion_le (K : Set G) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKclosed : IsClosed K)
    (b : BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A K) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    ‖supportedToL1Completion μ α K hK hKclosed b‖ ≤ μ.real K * ‖b‖ :=
  norm_supportedToL1_raw_le μ α K hK hKclosed b

/-- Integrating the actual compact-support Banach curve gives the same completed convolution image. -/
theorem integral_compactConvolutionCurve_toL1Completion (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h)) :=
      NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
    supportedToL1Completion μ α (convolutionSupport μ α f h)
        (isCompact_convolutionSupport μ α f h) (isClosed_convolutionSupport μ α f h)
        (∫ s : G, compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s ∂μ) = toL1Completion μ α (f * h) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h)) :=
    NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  change supportedToL1Completion μ α (convolutionSupport μ α f h)
      (isCompact_convolutionSupport μ α f h) (isClosed_convolutionSupport μ α f h)
      (∫ s : G, compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s ∂μ) = toL1Completion μ α (f * h)
  rw [supportedToL1Completion_apply, toCc_integral_compactConvolutionCurve]
  rfl

/-- The original L1 integral of literal multiplier slices is the canonical Haar convolution image. -/
theorem integral_toL1Completion_coefficientLeft_groupLeft (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (L1Completion μ α) := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
    (∫ s : G, toL1Completion μ α (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h)) ∂μ) =
      toL1Completion μ α (f * h) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  let _ : CompleteSpace (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionCompleteSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (L1Completion μ α) := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h)) :=
    NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  let J := supportedToL1Completion μ α (convolutionSupport μ α f h)
    (isCompact_convolutionSupport μ α f h) (isClosed_convolutionSupport μ α f h)
  have hvalues (s : G) : J (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s) =
      toL1Completion μ α (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h)) := by
    rw [supportedToL1Completion_apply, toCc_compactConvolutionCurve, fromCc_toCc]
  calc
    _ = ∫ s : G, J (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s) ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun s => (hvalues s).symm)
    _ = J (∫ s : G, compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s ∂μ) :=
      J.integral_comp_comm (integrable_compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h)
    _ = _ := integral_compactConvolutionCurve_toL1Completion μ α f h

end

end HaarTwistedCore

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.ConvolutionCurve
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.L1ToSeminormCompletion

/-!
# The literal Haar convolution integral in an actual seminorm completion

The fixed-support Banach curve is mapped through the original L1 completion
and its constructed contractive map to the same admissible seminorm's
completion. Its values are the original coefficient/group slices. The
bounded complex linear map gives both their actual integrability and the
canonical image of the original convolution as their Haar integral.

These are prerequisites of the original covariant integrated identity;
neither that identity nor the full covariant norm comparison is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)
variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)) (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α)

include hp in
/-- The literal coefficient/group curve is integrable in the same seminorm completion. -/
theorem integrable_toNonUnitalCompletion_coefficientLeft_groupLeft (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    let _ : NormedSpace ℝ p.NonUnitalCompletion := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
    Integrable (fun s : G =>
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h))) μ := by
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  let _ : CompleteSpace (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionCompleteSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (L1Completion μ α) := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ p.NonUnitalCompletion := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h)) :=
    NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  let J : BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h) →L[ℂ]
      p.NonUnitalCompletion :=
    (l1ToSeminormCompletionCLM μ α p hp).comp
      (supportedToL1Completion μ α (convolutionSupport μ α f h)
        (isCompact_convolutionSupport μ α f h) (isClosed_convolutionSupport μ α f h))
  have hvalues (s : G) : J (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h)) := by
    change l1ToSeminormCompletionCLM μ α p hp
      (supportedToL1Completion μ α (convolutionSupport μ α f h)
        (isCompact_convolutionSupport μ α f h) (isClosed_convolutionSupport μ α f h)
        (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s)) = _
    rw [l1ToSeminormCompletionCLM_apply, supportedToL1Completion_apply,
      toCc_compactConvolutionCurve, fromCc_toCc, l1ToSeminormCompletion_apply]
  exact (J.integrable_comp (integrable_compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h)).congr
    (Eventually.of_forall hvalues)

include hp in
/-- The original convolution image is the Haar integral of its literal multiplier slices. -/
theorem integral_toNonUnitalCompletion_coefficientLeft_groupLeft (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    let _ : NormedSpace ℝ p.NonUnitalCompletion := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
    (∫ s : G, p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h)) ∂μ) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (f * h) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  let _ : CompleteSpace (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionCompleteSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (L1Completion μ α) := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ p.NonUnitalCompletion := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h)) :=
    NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  let P : L1Completion μ α →L[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion := l1ToSeminormCompletionCLM μ α p hp
  let J₀ := supportedToL1Completion μ α (convolutionSupport μ α f h)
    (isCompact_convolutionSupport μ α f h) (isClosed_convolutionSupport μ α f h)
  let J : BoundedContinuousFunction.Supported ℂ A (convolutionSupport μ α f h) →L[ℂ]
      p.NonUnitalCompletion := P.comp J₀
  have hvalues (s : G) : J (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h)) := by
    change l1ToSeminormCompletionCLM μ α p hp
      (supportedToL1Completion μ α (convolutionSupport μ α f h)
        (isCompact_convolutionSupport μ α f h) (isClosed_convolutionSupport μ α f h)
        (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s)) = _
    rw [l1ToSeminormCompletionCLM_apply, supportedToL1Completion_apply,
      toCc_compactConvolutionCurve, fromCc_toCc, l1ToSeminormCompletion_apply]
  calc
    _ = ∫ s : G, J (compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s) ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun s => (hvalues s).symm)
    _ = J (∫ s : G, compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s ∂μ) :=
      J.integral_comp_comm (integrable_compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h)
    _ = P (toL1Completion μ α (f * h)) := by
      change P (J₀ (∫ s : G, compactConvolutionCurve μ α f h s ∂μ)) = _
      exact congrArg P (integral_compactConvolutionCurve_toL1Completion μ α f h)
    _ = _ := l1ToSeminormCompletion_apply μ α p hp (f * h)

end

end HaarTwistedCore

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.Basic
public import MathlibExt.Topology.ContinuousMap.CompactlySupported.Discrete

/-!
# Original measure/action-indexed carrier with discrete finite coefficients

The reusable compact-support/Finsupp construction belongs to the neutral
continuous-map owner. Only the original measure/action-indexed Haar carrier wrapper is constructed
here. The formerly unreleased generic aliases have been retired. It needs a monoid, with no inverse or Haar hypothesis.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CompactlySupported

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
variable {A : Type uA}

variable [Monoid G] [MeasurableSpace G] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The same original indexed Haar core as its literal finite complex coefficient module. -/
def discreteCoefficientsEquiv : Carrier μ α ≃ₗ[ℂ] (G →₀ A) where
  toFun f := CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.toFinsupp (toCc μ α f)
  invFun x := fromCc μ α (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ofFinsupp x)
  left_inv f := by
    apply ext μ α
    intro g
    rfl
  right_inv x := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro g
    rfl
  map_add' f h := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro g
    rfl
  map_smul' c f := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro g
    rfl

/-- The discrete Haar-core coefficient equivalence preserves every original value. -/
@[simp]
theorem discreteCoefficientsEquiv_apply (f : Carrier μ α) (g : G) :
    discreteCoefficientsEquiv μ α f g = f g := rfl

/-- The inverse discrete coefficient map has the literal original finite support values. -/
@[simp]
theorem discreteCoefficientsEquiv_symm_apply (x : G →₀ A) (g : G) :
    (discreteCoefficientsEquiv μ α).symm x g = x g := rfl

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.SeminormCoefficientActions
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap

/-!
# Actual finite Hilbert Gram coefficient bounds

The finite sums are the original source values under an actual representation
of the same-p completion. The original coefficient and its computed positive
unitization complement give a norm-square decomposition for those sums.
Consequently a zero original Gram sum has a zero transformed coefficient sum.
This proves the kernel inclusion required for descent to the actual Gram
span; it assumes no descended operator, bound, norm model or nondegeneracy.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace BigOperators

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH uI

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α))
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (σ : p.NonUnitalCompletion →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))
variable {ι : Type uI}

/-- The literal weighted finite sum of original-source Hilbert operator values. -/
def finiteHilbertGram (s : Finset ι) (z : ι → ℂ) (f : ι → Carrier μ α) (ξ : ι → H) : H :=
  ∑ i ∈ s, z i • σ (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (f i)) (ξ i)

/-- The literal finite coefficient transform using the actual unitized source action. -/
def finiteHilbertGramCoefficient (a : Unitization ℂ A) (s : Finset ι)
    (z : ι → ℂ) (f : ι → Carrier μ α) (ξ : ι → H) : H :=
  finiteHilbertGram μ α p σ s z (fun i => coefficientLeftUnitization μ α a (f i)) ξ

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The non-scalar coefficient transform retains exactly the original coefficient values. -/
@[simp]
theorem finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_inr (a : A) (s : Finset ι)
    (z : ι → ℂ) (f : ι → Carrier μ α) (ξ : ι → H) :
    finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (a : Unitization ℂ A) s z f ξ =
      ∑ i ∈ s, z i • σ (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a (f i))) (ξ i) := by
  simp only [finiteHilbertGramCoefficient, finiteHilbertGram, coefficientLeftUnitization_inr]

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The original coefficient and computed complement give the exact finite Gram square identity. -/
theorem finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_inner_square (a : A) (s : Finset ι)
    (z : ι → ℂ) (f : ι → Carrier μ α) (ξ : ι → H) :
    ⟪finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (a : Unitization ℂ A) s z f ξ,
      finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (a : Unitization ℂ A) s z f ξ⟫_ℂ +
    ⟪finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (coefficientSquareComplement a) s z f ξ,
      finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (coefficientSquareComplement a) s z f ξ⟫_ℂ =
      ((‖a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ⟪finiteHilbertGram μ α p σ s z f ξ, finiteHilbertGram μ α p σ s z f ξ⟫_ℂ := by
  let π : Carrier μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := σ.comp p.toNonUnitalCompletion
  let c := coefficientSquareComplement a
  let r : ℂ := ((‖a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hInner (u v : Carrier μ α) (x y : H) :
      ⟪π u x, π v y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, π (star u * v) y⟫_ℂ := by
    have hProduct : π (star u * v) = star (π u) * π v := by
      rw [map_mul, map_star]
    rw [hProduct]
    change ⟪π u x, π v y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, star (π u) (π v y)⟫_ℂ
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right _ _ _).symm
  have hCross (u v : Carrier μ α) (x y : H) :
      ⟪π (coefficientLeft μ α a u) x, π (coefficientLeft μ α a v) y⟫_ℂ +
      ⟪π (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c u) x,
        π (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c v) y⟫_ℂ = r * ⟪π u x, π v y⟫_ℂ := by
    rw [hInner, hInner, hInner]
    have hOperators :
        π (star (coefficientLeft μ α a u) * coefficientLeft μ α a v) +
          π (star (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c u) * coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c v) =
            r • π (star u * v) := by
      have h := congrArg π (coefficientLeft_cross_gram_square μ α a u v)
      simpa only [map_add, map_smul, c, r] using h
    calc
      _ = ⟪x, (π (star (coefficientLeft μ α a u) * coefficientLeft μ α a v) +
          π (star (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c u) *
            coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c v)) y⟫_ℂ := by
        change ⟪x, _⟫_ℂ + ⟪x, _⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, _ + _⟫_ℂ
        rw [inner_add_right]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe]
      _ = ⟪x, (r • π (star u * v)) y⟫_ℂ := by rw [hOperators]
      _ = r * ⟪x, π (star u * v) y⟫_ℂ := by
        change ⟪x, r • π (star u * v) y⟫_ℂ = _
        exact inner_smul_right _ _ _
  have hSmul (u : Carrier μ α) (w : ℂ) (x : H) : w • π u x = π u (w • x) :=
    (map_smul (π u) w x).symm
  have hPair (i j : ι) :
      ⟪z i • π (coefficientLeft μ α a (f i)) (ξ i),
        z j • π (coefficientLeft μ α a (f j)) (ξ j)⟫_ℂ +
      ⟪z i • π (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c (f i)) (ξ i),
        z j • π (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c (f j)) (ξ j)⟫_ℂ =
      r * ⟪z i • π (f i) (ξ i), z j • π (f j) (ξ j)⟫_ℂ := by
    simp_rw [hSmul]
    exact hCross (f i) (f j) (z i • ξ i) (z j • ξ j)
  simp only [finiteHilbertGramCoefficient, finiteHilbertGram, coefficientLeftUnitization_inr]
  change ⟪∑ i ∈ s, z i • π (coefficientLeft μ α a (f i)) (ξ i),
      ∑ j ∈ s, z j • π (coefficientLeft μ α a (f j)) (ξ j)⟫_ℂ +
    ⟪∑ i ∈ s, z i • π (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c (f i)) (ξ i),
      ∑ j ∈ s, z j • π (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c (f j)) (ξ j)⟫_ℂ =
    r * ⟪∑ i ∈ s, z i • π (f i) (ξ i), ∑ j ∈ s, z j • π (f j) (ξ j)⟫_ℂ
  simp_rw [sum_inner, inner_sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s,
        (⟪z i • π (coefficientLeft μ α a (f i)) (ξ i),
          z j • π (coefficientLeft μ α a (f j)) (ξ j)⟫_ℂ +
        ⟪z i • π (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c (f i)) (ξ i),
          z j • π (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α c (f j)) (ξ j)⟫_ℂ) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, r * ⟪z i • π (f i) (ξ i), z j • π (f j) (ξ j)⟫_ℂ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      exact hPair i j
    _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.mul_sum]

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The computed coefficient and complement sums have the exact original norm-square decomposition. -/
theorem finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_norm_sq (a : A) (s : Finset ι)
    (z : ι → ℂ) (f : ι → Carrier μ α) (ξ : ι → H) :
    ‖finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (a : Unitization ℂ A) s z f ξ‖ ^ 2 +
      ‖finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (coefficientSquareComplement a) s z f ξ‖ ^ 2 =
        ‖a‖ ^ 2 * ‖finiteHilbertGram μ α p σ s z f ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
  have h := congrArg (RCLike.re : ℂ → ℝ)
    (finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_inner_square μ α p σ a s z f ξ)
  have hr : RCLike.re ((‖a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = ‖a‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, Complex.ofReal_re]
  have hi : RCLike.im ((‖a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := by
    rw [RCLike.im_eq_complex_im, Complex.ofReal_im]
  simpa only [map_add, RCLike.mul_re, hr, hi, zero_mul, sub_zero, inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using h

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The original finite Gram coefficient transform has the actual coefficient norm bound. -/
theorem norm_finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_inr_le (a : A) (s : Finset ι)
    (z : ι → ℂ) (f : ι → Carrier μ α) (ξ : ι → H) :
    ‖finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (a : Unitization ℂ A) s z f ξ‖ ≤
      ‖a‖ * ‖finiteHilbertGram μ α p σ s z f ξ‖ := by
  have hSquare := finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_norm_sq μ α p σ a s z f ξ
  have hLe : ‖finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (a : Unitization ℂ A) s z f ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (‖a‖ * ‖finiteHilbertGram μ α p σ s z f ξ‖) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (a : Unitization ℂ A) s z f ξ‖ ^ 2 +
          ‖finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (coefficientSquareComplement a) s z f ξ‖ ^ 2 :=
        le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖a‖ ^ 2 * ‖finiteHilbertGram μ α p σ s z f ξ‖ ^ 2 := hSquare
      _ = _ := (mul_pow _ _ 2).symm
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _)
    (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg a) (norm_nonneg _))).mp hLe

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- A zero original finite Gram sum has a zero transformed coefficient sum. -/
theorem finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_inr_eq_zero_of_eq_zero (a : A) (s : Finset ι)
    (z : ι → ℂ) (f : ι → Carrier μ α) (ξ : ι → H)
    (hGram : finiteHilbertGram μ α p σ s z f ξ = 0) :
    finiteHilbertGramCoefficient μ α p σ (a : Unitization ℂ A) s z f ξ = 0 := by
  apply norm_eq_zero.mp
  apply le_antisymm ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
  simpa only [hGram, norm_zero, mul_zero] using
    norm_finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_inr_le μ α p σ a s z f ξ

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Integral.CompactScalarSeparation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CanonicalApproximateUnit
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarIntegratedMultiplierActions
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarCovariantSeminorm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.CanonicalHaarRegularModel
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarRegularCoefficientFaithful
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.CompletedCoefficientMultiplier
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.FullCovariantSeminorm
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap

/-!
# The actual original full coefficient multiplier embedding

Compact scalar Haar tests recover the original coefficient products from a
zero integrated left action. The computed coefficient approximate unit
then recovers the original coefficient. Apply this to the internally
constructed canonical regular pair and its verified faithful coefficient
map: no faithful representation, norm or multiplier model is an input.

The actual full coefficient homomorphism is therefore injective, and the
existing C-star homomorphism theorem gives its original coefficient norm.
This does not assert a group embedding in the zero-coefficient case or
use regular integrated nondegeneracy, quotient surjectivity or a supplied
convolution approximate identity.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped CompactlySupported MultiplierAlgebra CStarAlgebra Topology

noncomputable section

namespace CovariantRepresentation

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual bounded operators on the original complete Hilbert space have their stock C-star data. -/
local instance : CStarAlgebra (H →L[ℂ] H) := inferInstance

variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {α : PointNormCStarAction G A} (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H)

/-- Original compact Haar tests recover each coefficient product from its zero integrated left action. -/
theorem algebra_mul_eq_zero_of_integratedCoefficientLeft_eq_zero (a : A)
    (hZero : ∀ f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α,
      haarIntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.coefficientLeft μ α a f) = 0) (b : A) :
    ρ.algebra (a * b) = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  let F : G → H := fun g => ρ.algebra (a * b) ((ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)
  have hF : Continuous F := (ρ.algebra (a * b)).continuous.comp (ρ.group.continuous_orbit ξ)
  have hTest (ψ : C_c(G, ℂ)) : (∫ g : G, ψ g • F g ∂μ) = 0 := by
    let fc : C_c(G, A) :=
      { toFun g := ψ g • b
        continuous_toFun := (map_continuous ψ).smul continuous_const
        hasCompactSupport' := ψ.hasCompactSupport.comp_left
          (g := fun z : ℂ => z • b) (zero_smul ℂ b) }
    let f := HaarTwistedCore.fromCc μ α fc
    have h := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T ξ) (hZero f)
    rw [haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector] at h
    simp only [zero_apply] at h
    have hValue (g : G) :
        ρ.algebra (HaarTwistedCore.coefficientLeft μ α a f g) ((ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) =
          ψ g • F g := by
      change ρ.algebra (a * (ψ g • b)) ((ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) =
        ψ g • ρ.algebra (a * b) ((ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)
      simp only [mul_smul_comm, map_smul, smul_apply]
    exact (integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun g => (hValue g).symm)).trans h
  have h := hF.eq_zero_of_compactScalar_integrals_eq_zero μ (1 : G) hTest
  simpa only [F, ρ.group.apply_one, zero_apply] using h

/-- The actual coefficient approximate unit recovers a coefficient from all its zero integrated left actions. -/
theorem algebra_eq_zero_of_integratedCoefficientLeft_eq_zero (a : A)
    (hZero : ∀ f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α,
      haarIntegratedHom μ ρ (HaarTwistedCore.coefficientLeft μ α a f) = 0) : ρ.algebra a = 0 := by
  let _ : (CStarAlgebra.canonicalApproximateUnit A).NeBot := CStarAlgebra.canonicalApproximateUnit_neBot A
  have hProduct : Tendsto (fun b : A => a * b) (CStarAlgebra.canonicalApproximateUnit A) (𝓝 a) :=
    CStarAlgebra.tendsto_canonicalApproximateUnit_mul_left A a
  have hLimit := ((map_continuous ρ.algebra).tendsto a).comp hProduct
  have hAll : (fun b : A => ρ.algebra (a * b)) = fun _ : A => (0 : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
    funext b
    exact algebra_mul_eq_zero_of_integratedCoefficientLeft_eq_zero μ ρ a hZero b
  have hLimitZero : Tendsto (fun b : A => ρ.algebra (a * b))
      (CStarAlgebra.canonicalApproximateUnit A) (𝓝 (0 : H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
    rw [hAll]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at hLimit
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hLimit hLimitZero

end CovariantRepresentation

namespace HaarTwistedCore

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

/-- The named actual coefficient star-algebra homomorphism into the full multiplier algebra. -/
def fullCoefficientMultiplierHom : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] 𝓜(ℂ, FullCovariantCompletion μ α) :=
  coefficientMultiplierHom μ α (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The named full coefficient homomorphism is its exact computed same-seminorm specialization. -/
@[simp]
theorem fullCoefficientMultiplierHom_apply (a : A) :
    fullCoefficientMultiplierHom μ α a =
      coefficientMultiplierHom μ α (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α) a := rfl

/-- A zero actual full coefficient multiplier has zero original coefficient. -/
theorem fullCoefficientMultiplier_eq_zero_implies (a : A)
    (hZero : coefficientMultiplierHom μ α (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α) a = 0) : a = 0 := by
  let ρ := PointNormCStarAction.canonicalRegularCovariantRepresentation μ α
  have hCore (f : Carrier μ α) :
      (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α).toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a f) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun T : 𝓜(ℂ, (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α).NonUnitalCompletion) =>
      T.fst ((maximalCStarSeminorm μ α).toNonUnitalCompletion f)) hZero
    simpa only [coefficientMultiplierHom_apply, coefficientMultiplier_fst_apply,
      DoubleCentralizer.zero_fst, zero_apply] using h
  have hRaw (f : Carrier μ α) :
      CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedHom μ ρ (coefficientLeft μ α a f) = 0 := by
    have hGauge : maximalCStarSeminorm μ α (coefficientLeft μ α a f) = 0 := by
      rw [← CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion, hCore f, norm_zero]
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    apply le_antisymm ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
    simpa only [hGauge] using
      CovariantRepresentation.norm_haarIntegratedHom_le_maximalCStarSeminorm μ ρ (coefficientLeft μ α a f)
  have hCoefficient := CovariantRepresentation.algebra_eq_zero_of_integratedCoefficientLeft_eq_zero
    μ ρ a hRaw
  have hInjective : Function.Injective ρ.algebra := by
    change Function.Injective
      (α.regularCoefficientHom (PointNormCStarAction.canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A) μ)
    exact PointNormCStarAction.regularCoefficientHom_injective α
      (PointNormCStarAction.canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A) μ
      (PointNormCStarAction.canonicalCoefficientRepresentation_injective A)
  exact hInjective (hCoefficient.trans (map_zero ρ.algebra).symm)

/-- The computed original full coefficient homomorphism is injective, without a supplied faithful model. -/
theorem fullCoefficientMultiplierHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (fullCoefficientMultiplierHom μ α) := by
  change Function.Injective (coefficientMultiplierHom μ α (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α))
  intro a b hab
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply fullCoefficientMultiplier_eq_zero_implies μ α (a - b)
  rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]

/-- The actual full coefficient multiplier norm is the original coefficient C-star norm. -/
theorem norm_fullCoefficientMultiplierHom (a : A) :
    ‖fullCoefficientMultiplierHom μ α a‖ = ‖a‖ :=
  NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map (fullCoefficientMultiplierHom μ α)
    (fullCoefficientMultiplierHom_injective μ α) a

/-- The named original full coefficient homomorphism is isometric for the original C-star norm. -/
theorem fullCoefficientMultiplierHom_isometry : Isometry (fullCoefficientMultiplierHom μ α) :=
  NonUnitalStarAlgHom.isometry (fullCoefficientMultiplierHom μ α)
    (fullCoefficientMultiplierHom_injective μ α)

/-- The secondary function embedding retains the actual named coefficient star-algebra homomorphism. -/
def fullCoefficientEmbedding : A ↪ 𝓜(ℂ, FullCovariantCompletion μ α) where
  toFun := fullCoefficientMultiplierHom μ α
  inj' := fullCoefficientMultiplierHom_injective μ α

/-- The embedding retains exactly the original computed full coefficient multiplier. -/
@[simp]
theorem fullCoefficientEmbedding_apply (a : A) :
    fullCoefficientEmbedding μ α a = coefficientMultiplierHom μ α (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α) a := rfl

/-- The original full coefficient embedding retains the source coefficient norm. -/
theorem norm_fullCoefficientEmbedding (a : A) : ‖fullCoefficientEmbedding μ α a‖ = ‖a‖ :=
  norm_fullCoefficientMultiplierHom μ α a

/-- Every embedded coefficient still acts on each original full core image by the original left formula. -/
theorem fullCoefficientEmbedding_fst_apply (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    (fullCoefficientEmbedding μ α a).fst (toFullCovariantCompletion μ α f) =
      toFullCovariantCompletion μ α (coefficientLeft μ α a f) :=
  coefficientMultiplier_fst_apply μ α (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α) a f

end HaarTwistedCore

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarCovariantSeminorm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.EssentialNondegeneracy
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.GramIntegratedIdentity

/-!
# The original nondegenerate covariant norm and its actual completion

The family consists of actual integrated seminorms of nondegenerate
covariant pairs in the source-sized Hilbert universe. The constructed
Gram norm model realizes every admissible seminorm by such a pair;
the original Haar coefficient bound gives the converse inclusion.

Reuse the already constructed intrinsic maximal C-star seminorm. Its
values are therefore the literal supremum of this original covariant
family, and every original Hilbert-universe integrated norm belongs to
that family. The same actual separated completion and canonical map
provide the completed C-star object. No new supremum or norm laws are
implemented, and faithfulness on the original source remains separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- Actual seminorms of original nondegenerate covariant pairs in the source-sized Hilbert universe. -/
def nondegenerateCovariantCStarSeminorms : Set (CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)) :=
  {p | ∃ (K : Type (max uG uA)) (_hK1 : NormedAddCommGroup K)
      (_hK2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ K) (_hK3 : CompleteSpace K)
      (π : CovariantRepresentation α K),
      π.algebra.essentialSpace = ⊤ ∧
        CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm μ π = p}

/-- The actual nondegenerate covariant family is exactly the original admissible seminorm family. -/
theorem nondegenerateCovariantCStarSeminorms_eq_admissible :
    nondegenerateCovariantCStarSeminorms μ α = admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α := by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨K, hK1, hK2, hK3, π, _hNondegenerate, hπ⟩
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup K := hK1
    let _ : InnerProductSpace ℂ K := hK2
    let _ : CompleteSpace K := hK3
    rw [← hπ]
    exact CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm_mem_admissible μ π
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨K, hK1, hK2, hK3, π, hNorm, hNondegenerate⟩ :=
      exists_admissibleCovariantNormModel_essentialSpace_eq_top μ α p hp
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup K := hK1
    let _ : InnerProductSpace ℂ K := hK2
    let _ : CompleteSpace K := hK3
    refine ⟨K, hK1, hK2, hK3, π, hNondegenerate, ?_⟩
    apply CStarSeminorm.ext
    intro f
    exact (CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm_apply μ π f).trans (hNorm f)

/-- An original integrated norm in any Hilbert universe has a model in this nondegenerate family. -/
theorem haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm_mem_nondegenerateCovariantFamily
    {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H) :
    CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm μ ρ ∈
      nondegenerateCovariantCStarSeminorms μ α := by
  rw [nondegenerateCovariantCStarSeminorms_eq_admissible]
  exact CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedCStarSeminorm_mem_admissible μ ρ

/-- The original full covariant gauge, using the same already computed maximal seminorm value. -/
def fullCovariantNorm (f : Carrier μ α) : ℝ := maximalCStarSeminorm μ α f

/-- Every full covariant value is the literal real supremum of the actual original pair norms. -/
theorem fullCovariantNorm_eq_sSup (f : Carrier μ α) :
    fullCovariantNorm μ α f =
      SupSet.sSup ((fun p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α) => p f) ''
        nondegenerateCovariantCStarSeminorms μ α) := by
  rw [nondegenerateCovariantCStarSeminorms_eq_admissible]
  exact maximalCStarSeminorm_apply μ α f

/-- The original covariant C-star completion is the same actual maximal seminorm completion. -/
abbrev FullCovariantCompletion := (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α).NonUnitalCompletion

/-- The same constructed nonunital C-star dictionary on the actual full covariant completion. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def fullCovariantCompletionCStarAlgebra : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (FullCovariantCompletion μ α) :=
  (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α).nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

/-- The original canonical full covariant map is the same actual source separation/completion map. -/
def toFullCovariantCompletion :
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (FullCovariantCompletion μ α) :=
      fullCovariantCompletionCStarAlgebra μ α
    Carrier μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] FullCovariantCompletion μ α :=
  (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α).toNonUnitalCompletion

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Each canonical full completion image has the exact original full covariant norm. -/
theorem norm_toFullCovariantCompletion (f : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (FullCovariantCompletion μ α) :=
      fullCovariantCompletionCStarAlgebra μ α
    ‖toFullCovariantCompletion μ α f‖ = fullCovariantNorm μ α f := by
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (FullCovariantCompletion μ α) :=
    fullCovariantCompletionCStarAlgebra μ α
  exact (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α).norm_toNonUnitalCompletion f

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The original canonical core image is dense in this same full covariant completion. -/
theorem denseRange_toFullCovariantCompletion :
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (FullCovariantCompletion μ α) :=
      fullCovariantCompletionCStarAlgebra μ α
    DenseRange (toFullCovariantCompletion μ α) :=
  (maximalCStarSeminorm μ α).denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.GramRepresentationLaws
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.L1Translation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.MaximalSeminorm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PointNormAction.CovariantRepresentation
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
# Actual strongly continuous covariant operators of an admissible Gram model

For an actual L1-bounded source seminorm, compact coefficient translation
continuity controls every original-source Gram generator. Their span has
continuous orbits at the group identity. Density and the proved group
isometry then give continuity on every Hilbert vector. The actual group
composition shifts this continuity to every group element.

The computed coefficient and unitary homomorphisms therefore construct a
strongly continuous covariant representation on the actual essential
Hilbert space. No orbit continuity, unitary law, covariance or desired
covariant model is supplied as an input. The original integrated identity
and its maximal-norm consequence remain separate prerequisites.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace Topology

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
  (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)) (H : Type uH)
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (ρ : p.NonUnitalCompletion →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))

/-- The actual generator orbit difference is controlled by the original Haar L1 translate distance. -/
theorem dist_gramGroupOperator_generator_le
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace) :
    dist (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g
        (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ))
      (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ) ≤
      l1Gauge μ α (groupLeft μ α g f - f) * ‖ξ‖ := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, gramGroupOperator_apply_generator]
  have hDiff :
      ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupLeft μ α g f)) ξ -
        ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ =
      ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupLeft μ α g f - f)) ξ := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub]
    rfl
  rw [hDiff]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupLeft μ α g f - f))‖ * ‖ξ‖ :=
      (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupLeft μ α g f - f))).le_opNorm ξ
    _ ≤ ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupLeft μ α g f - f)‖ * ‖ξ‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le ρ.essentialRepresentation _) (norm_nonneg ξ)
    _ = p (groupLeft μ α g f - f) * ‖ξ‖ := by rw [p.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion]
    _ ≤ l1Gauge μ α (groupLeft μ α g f - f) * ‖ξ‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hp _) (norm_nonneg ξ)

/-- Every actual original-source generator has a continuous group orbit at the identity. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_generator_continuousAt_one
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) (f : Carrier μ α) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace) :
    ContinuousAt (fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g
      (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ)) 1 := by
  have hL1 : Tendsto (fun g : G => l1Gauge μ α (groupLeft μ α g f - f) * ‖ξ‖)
      (𝓝 1) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul] using (tendsto_l1Gauge_groupLeft_sub μ α f).mul_const ‖ξ‖
  change Tendsto _ (𝓝 1)
    (𝓝 (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ 1 (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ)))
  rw [gramGroupOperator_one]
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [hL1.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with g hg
  exact (dist_gramGroupOperator_generator_le μ α p H ρ hp g f ξ).trans_lt hg

/-- Every vector in the actual original-source Gram span has a continuous orbit at the identity. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_span_continuousAt_one
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace)
    (hξ : ξ ∈ p.rawHilbertGramDomain H ρ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ξ) 1 := by
  induction hξ using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem ξ hξ =>
    obtain ⟨⟨f, η⟩, rfl⟩ := hξ
    exact gramGroupOperator_generator_continuousAt_one μ α p H ρ hp f η
  | zero =>
    simpa only [map_zero] using
      (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : G => (0 : ρ.essentialSpace)) 1)
  | add ξ η _ _ hξ hη =>
    have hSum := hξ.add hη
    have hFun : ((fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ξ) +
        fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g η) =
        fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g (ξ + η) := by
      funext g
      rw [Pi.add_apply]
      exact (map_add (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g) ξ η).symm
    rw [hFun] at hSum
    exact hSum
  | smul c ξ _ hξ =>
    have hSmul := hξ.const_smul c
    have hFun : (c • fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ξ) =
        fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g (c • ξ) := by
      funext g
      rw [Pi.smul_apply]
      exact (map_smul (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g) c ξ).symm
    rw [hFun] at hSmul
    exact hSmul

/-- Proved density and group isometry make every actual Hilbert-vector orbit continuous at one. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_continuousAt_one
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace) :
    ContinuousAt (fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ξ) 1 := by
  change Tendsto _ (𝓝 1) (𝓝 (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ 1 ξ))
  rw [gramGroupOperator_one]
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have hεthird : 0 < ε / 3 := div_pos hε (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hApprox⟩ := (p.dense_rawHilbertGramDomain H ρ).exists_dist_lt ξ hεthird
  have hηtendsto : Tendsto (fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g η) (𝓝 1) (𝓝 η) := by
    have h := gramGroupOperator_span_continuousAt_one μ α p H ρ hp η hη
    change Tendsto _ (𝓝 1) (𝓝 (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ 1 η)) at h
    rw [gramGroupOperator_one] at h
    exact h
  filter_upwards [Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hηtendsto (ε / 3) hεthird] with g hg
  have hDist : dist (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ξ) (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g η) =
      dist ξ η := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, map_sub] using norm_gramGroupOperator_apply μ α p H ρ g (ξ - η)
  calc
    dist (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ξ) ξ ≤
        dist (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ξ) (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g η) +
          dist (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g η) ξ := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ dist ξ η + (dist (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g η) η + dist η ξ) := by
      rw [hDist]
      exact add_le_add (le_refl (dist ξ η))
        (dist_triangle (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g η) η ξ)
    _ < ε / 3 + (ε / 3 + ε / 3) :=
      add_lt_add hApprox (add_lt_add hg (by simpa only [dist_comm] using hApprox))
    _ = ε := by ring

/-- Actual group composition shifts the proved orbit continuity from one to every group element. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_continuous
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace) :
    Continuous (fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ξ) := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro g₀
  have hAtOne : Tendsto (fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ξ) (𝓝 1) (𝓝 ξ) := by
    have h := gramGroupOperator_continuousAt_one μ α p H ρ hp ξ
    change Tendsto _ (𝓝 1) (𝓝 (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ 1 ξ)) at h
    rw [gramGroupOperator_one] at h
    exact h
  have hShift : Tendsto (fun g : G => g₀⁻¹ * g) (𝓝 g₀) (𝓝 1) := by
    have hProduct := (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : G => (g₀⁻¹ : G))).mul
      (continuous_id : Continuous (id : G → G))
    have hFun : ((fun _ : G => (g₀⁻¹ : G)) * (id : G → G)) =
        fun g : G => g₀⁻¹ * g := by
      funext g
      rw [Pi.mul_apply]
      rfl
    rw [hFun] at hProduct
    simpa only [inv_mul_cancel] using hProduct.tendsto g₀
  have hOrbit := ((gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g₀).continuous.tendsto ξ).comp (hAtOne.comp hShift)
  have hFun : (fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g₀
      (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ (g₀⁻¹ * g) ξ)) =
      fun g : G => gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ξ := by
    funext g
    have hProduct : gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g₀ *
        gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ (g₀⁻¹ * g) = gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g := by
      rw [← gramGroupOperator_mul, mul_inv_cancel_left]
    exact congrArg (fun T : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace => T ξ) hProduct
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at hOrbit
  rw [hFun] at hOrbit
  exact hOrbit

/-- The computed original-source group operators as an actual strongly continuous unitary representation. -/
def gramStronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) :
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation G ρ.essentialSpace where
  toMonoidHom := gramGroupUnitaryRepresentation μ α p H ρ
  continuous_orbit := gramGroupOperator_continuous μ α p H ρ hp

/-- The actual strongly continuous group representation retains its original computed operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem gramStronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation_apply_coe
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) (g : G) :
    (gramStronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp g :
        ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) = gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g := rfl

/-- The actual strongly continuous covariant model on the computed essential Hilbert space. -/
def gramCovariantRepresentation (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) :
    CovariantRepresentation α ρ.essentialSpace where
  algebra := gramCoefficientRepresentation μ α p H ρ
  group := gramStronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp
  covariance := gramRepresentation_covariance μ α p H ρ

/-- The constructed covariant coefficient map is the original computed coefficient representation. -/
@[simp]
theorem gramCovariantRepresentation_algebra (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) :
    (gramCovariantRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp).algebra =
      gramCoefficientRepresentation μ α p H ρ := rfl

/-- The constructed covariant group map is the actual strongly continuous original-source group. -/
@[simp]
theorem gramCovariantRepresentation_group (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) :
    (gramCovariantRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp).group =
      gramStronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp := rfl

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.GramCovariantRepresentation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.ConvolutionSeminormIntegral
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarIntegratedForm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SeminormHilbertModel
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.EssentialNondegeneracy
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.ContinuousLinearMap

/-!
# The original integrated identity of the actual admissible Gram model

The literal coefficient/group convolution curve has its actual integral
in the same seminorm completion. Applying the completed representation
and each vector evaluation gives the original covariant integrated
identity on the dense source Gram generators, hence on all Hilbert
vectors. A faithful completed representation retains exactly the
original seminorm values.

Each such integral lies in the closed span of the actual coefficient
operator ranges. Density of the original Gram domain then proves
coefficient nondegeneracy. The strict same-p Hilbert construction thus
gives an actual nondegenerate covariant representation realizing every
admissible seminorm. No integrated identity, coefficient nondegeneracy
or desired covariant model is supplied as an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
  (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α))

section HilbertModel

variable (H : Type uH)
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (ρ : p.NonUnitalCompletion →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))

/-- The actual integrated Gram operator has the original convolution action on every source generator. -/
theorem gramCovariant_haarIntegratedHom_apply_generator
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) (f h : Carrier μ α) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace) :
    CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedHom μ (gramCovariantRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp) f
        (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion h) ξ) =
      ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (f * h)) ξ := by
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ p.NonUnitalCompletion := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ ρ.essentialSpace := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  let σ : p.NonUnitalCompletion →L[ℂ] (ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) :=
    ⟨LinearMap.ofClass ρ.essentialRepresentation, map_continuous ρ.essentialRepresentation⟩
  let T : p.NonUnitalCompletion →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ ρ.essentialSpace ξ).comp σ
  have hT (a : p.NonUnitalCompletion) : T a = ρ.essentialRepresentation a ξ := rfl
  let π := gramCovariantRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp
  have hValues (s : G) :
      π.algebra (f s) ((π.group s : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace)
        (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion h) ξ)) =
      T (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h))) := by
    change gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (f s)
      (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ s (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion h) ξ)) = _
    rw [gramGroupOperator_apply_generator, gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator, hT]
  calc
    _ = ∫ s : G, π.algebra (f s)
          ((π.group s : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace)
            (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion h) ξ)) ∂μ :=
      CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector μ π f _
    _ = ∫ s : G, T (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h))) ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall hValues)
    _ = T (∫ s : G, p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α (f s) (groupLeft μ α s h)) ∂μ) :=
      T.integral_comp_comm (integrable_toNonUnitalCompletion_coefficientLeft_groupLeft μ α p hp f h)
    _ = T (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (f * h)) := by
      rw [integral_toNonUnitalCompletion_coefficientLeft_groupLeft μ α p hp f h]
    _ = _ := hT _

/-- The actual integrated Gram homomorphism is the original completed representation on the source. -/
theorem gramCovariant_haarIntegratedHom
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedHom μ (gramCovariantRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp) f =
      ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) := by
  apply gramOperator_ext μ α p H ρ
  intro h ξ
  rw [gramCovariant_haarIntegratedHom_apply_generator μ α p H ρ hp f h ξ]
  have hProduct : ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (f * h)) =
      ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) *
        ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion h) := by
    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
  rw [hProduct]
  rfl

/-- Faithfulness of the actual completed Hilbert representation gives the exact original seminorm. -/
theorem norm_gramCovariant_haarIntegratedHom
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) (hρ : Function.Injective ρ) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    ‖CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedHom μ (gramCovariantRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp) f‖ =
      p f := by
  rw [gramCovariant_haarIntegratedHom μ α p H ρ hp f,
    ρ.norm_essentialRepresentation hρ, p.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion]

/-- The actual Gram coefficient map satisfies the same neutral essential-space condition. -/
theorem gramCovariantRepresentation_essentialSpace_eq_top
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) :
    (gramCovariantRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp).algebra.essentialSpace = ⊤ := by
  let π := gramCovariantRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp
  let S : Submodule ℂ ρ.essentialSpace :=
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun z : A × ρ.essentialSpace => π.algebra z.1 z.2)
  let P : Submodule ℂ ρ.essentialSpace := S.topologicalClosure
  let _ : CompleteSpace P := S.isClosed_topologicalClosure.completeSpace_coe
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ P := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ ρ.essentialSpace := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _
  have hValues (f : Carrier μ α) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace) :
      ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ ∈ P := by
    let Ψ : G → P := fun s =>
      ⟨π.algebra (f s) ((π.group s : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) ξ),
        S.le_topologicalClosure (Submodule.subset_span
          ⟨(f s, (π.group s : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) ξ), rfl⟩)⟩
    have hContinuous : Continuous Ψ :=
      (((map_continuous π.algebra).comp (toCc μ α f).continuous).clm_apply
        (π.group.continuous_orbit ξ)).subtype_mk _
    have hSupport : HasCompactSupport Ψ := by
      apply hasCompactSupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr
      filter_upwards [hasCompactSupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (toCc μ α f).hasCompactSupport] with s hs
      apply Subtype.ext
      change π.algebra (f s) ((π.group s : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) ξ) = 0
      change f s = (0 : A) at hs
      rw [hs, map_zero]
      rfl
    have hIntegral : Integrable Ψ μ := hContinuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hSupport
    have hVectorIntegral :
        (∫ s : G, π.algebra (f s) ((π.group s : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) ξ) ∂μ) =
          ((∫ s : G, Ψ s ∂μ : P) : ρ.essentialSpace) := by
      exact P.subtypeL.integral_comp_comm hIntegral
    have hIntegrated := congrArg (fun T : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace => T ξ)
      (gramCovariant_haarIntegratedHom μ α p H ρ hp f)
    have hFormula := CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector μ π f ξ
    have hSource : ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ =
        ((∫ s : G, Ψ s ∂μ : P) : ρ.essentialSpace) :=
      hIntegrated.symm.trans (hFormula.trans hVectorIntegral)
    rw [hSource]
    exact (∫ s : G, Ψ s ∂μ : P).property
  have hGram : p.rawHilbertGramDomain H ρ ≤ P := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨⟨f, ξ⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hValues f ξ
  have hDense : (p.rawHilbertGramDomain H ρ).topologicalClosure = ⊤ :=
    Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mp (p.dense_rawHilbertGramDomain H ρ)
  change P = ⊤
  apply le_antisymm le_top
  rw [← hDense]
  exact (p.rawHilbertGramDomain H ρ).topologicalClosure_minimal hGram S.isClosed_topologicalClosure


/-- Compatibility with the original dense-span Gram covariant statement. -/
theorem nondegenerate_gramCovariantRepresentation
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) :
    Dense (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun z : A × ρ.essentialSpace =>
      (gramCovariantRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp).algebra z.1 z.2) : Set ρ.essentialSpace) :=
  (gramCovariantRepresentation μ α p H ρ hp).algebra.essentialSpace_eq_top_iff_dense.mp
    (gramCovariantRepresentation_essentialSpace_eq_top μ α p H ρ hp)

end HilbertModel

/-- Every actual admissible seminorm has a same-universe nondegenerate covariant norm model. -/
theorem exists_admissibleCovariantNormModel_essentialSpace_eq_top (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) :
    ∃ (K : Type (max uG uA)) (_hK1 : NormedAddCommGroup K)
      (_hK2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ K) (_hK3 : CompleteSpace K)
      (π : CovariantRepresentation α K),
      (∀ f : Carrier μ α, ‖CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedHom μ π f‖ = p f) ∧
        π.algebra.essentialSpace = ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨H₀, hH1, hH2, hH3, ρ₀, hρ₀, _hNorm, _hSource, _hDense⟩ :=
    p.exists_nonUnitalCompletionHilbertNormModel
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup H₀ := hH1
  let _ : InnerProductSpace ℂ H₀ := hH2
  let _ : CompleteSpace H₀ := hH3
  refine ⟨ρ₀.essentialSpace, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    gramCovariantRepresentation μ α p H₀ ρ₀ hp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact norm_gramCovariant_haarIntegratedHom μ α p H₀ ρ₀ hp hρ₀
  · exact gramCovariantRepresentation_essentialSpace_eq_top μ α p H₀ ρ₀ hp


/-- Compatibility with the original dense-span admissible covariant norm-model statement. -/
theorem exists_admissibleCovariantNormModel (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) :
    ∃ (K : Type (max uG uA)) (_hK1 : NormedAddCommGroup K)
      (_hK2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ K) (_hK3 : CompleteSpace K)
      (π : CovariantRepresentation α K),
      (∀ f : Carrier μ α, ‖CovariantRepresentation.haarIntegratedHom μ π f‖ = p f) ∧
        Dense (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun z : A × K => π.algebra z.1 z.2) : Set K) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK1, hK2, hK3, π, hNorm, hNondegenerate⟩ :=
    exists_admissibleCovariantNormModel_essentialSpace_eq_top μ α p hp
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup K := hK1
  let _ : InnerProductSpace ℂ K := hK2
  let _ : CompleteSpace K := hK3
  exact ⟨K, hK1, hK2, hK3, π, hNorm, π.algebra.essentialSpace_eq_top_iff_dense.mp hNondegenerate⟩

end

end HaarTwistedCore
