module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SeminormGramDomain
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.FiniteHilbertGramCoefficient
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.SeminormGramGroupActions
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Extend
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.LinearCombination

/-!
# Actual coefficient and group operators from the original Haar-core Gram span

Finite formal sums evaluate to the actual source operator values. Their range
is the original-source Gram domain, with its inherited Hilbert norm. The
proved finite coefficient bound and group Gram identity make the corresponding
transformed sums vanish on the actual evaluation kernel.

The stock kernel quotient and range construction descends those actual sums
to the Gram domain. The stock dense extension then constructs the bounded
coefficient operators and isometric group operators on the actual essential
Hilbert space. Their values on every original generator are retained.

No descended operator, norm, isometry or nondegenerate model is an input.
Covariance, group composition, strong continuity and the integrated identity
remain separate required constructions.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators InnerProductSpace

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
  (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)) (H : Type uH)
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (ρ : p.NonUnitalCompletion →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))

/-- Evaluate each finite formal sum in the actual essential Hilbert space. -/
def gramEvaluation : ((Carrier μ α × ρ.essentialSpace) →₀ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace :=
  Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ fun z =>
    ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion z.1) z.2

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual evaluation range is precisely the original-source Gram domain. -/
theorem gramEvaluation_range :
    (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ).range = p.rawHilbertGramDomain H ρ := by
  exact Finsupp.range_linearCombination ℂ

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual finite-sum evaluation map is dense in the essential Hilbert space. -/
theorem denseRange_gramEvaluation : DenseRange (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ) := by
  have hrange : Set.range (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ) =
      (p.rawHilbertGramDomain H ρ : Set ρ.essentialSpace) := by
    change ((gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ).range : Set ρ.essentialSpace) = _
    rw [gramEvaluation_range]
  change Dense (Set.range (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ))
  rw [hrange]
  exact p.dense_rawHilbertGramDomain H ρ

/-- Apply the original coefficient multiplication to each actual finite-sum generator. -/
def gramCoefficientTransform (a : A) :
    ((Carrier μ α × ρ.essentialSpace) →₀ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace :=
  Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ fun z =>
    ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a z.1)) z.2

/-- Apply the original group translation to each actual finite-sum generator. -/
def gramGroupTransform (g : G) :
    ((Carrier μ α × ρ.essentialSpace) →₀ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace :=
  Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ fun z =>
    ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupLeft μ α g z.1)) z.2

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The proved finite Gram coefficient bound applies to every actual free finite sum. -/
theorem norm_gramCoefficientTransform_le (a : A)
    (x : (Carrier μ α × ρ.essentialSpace) →₀ ℂ) :
    ‖gramCoefficientTransform μ α p H ρ a x‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ x‖ := by
  simpa only [finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_inr, finiteHilbertGram,
    gramCoefficientTransform, gramEvaluation, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] using
    norm_finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_inr_le μ α p ρ.essentialRepresentation a x.support x
      (fun z => z.1) (fun z => z.2)

/-- The proved finite group Gram identity applies to every actual free finite sum. -/
theorem norm_gramGroupTransform (g : G)
    (x : (Carrier μ α × ρ.essentialSpace) →₀ ℂ) :
    ‖gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g x‖ = ‖gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ x‖ := by
  simpa only [gramGroupTransform, gramEvaluation, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] using
    norm_sum_completedRepresentation_groupLeft μ α p ρ.essentialSpace
      ρ.essentialRepresentation g x.support x (fun z => z.1) (fun z => z.2)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual coefficient transform vanishes on the original finite-sum evaluation kernel. -/
theorem gramCoefficientTransform_kernel (a : A) :
    (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ).ker ≤ (gramCoefficientTransform μ α p H ρ a).ker := by
  intro x hx
  change gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ x = 0 at hx
  change gramCoefficientTransform μ α p H ρ a x = 0
  have hbase : finiteHilbertGram μ α p ρ.essentialRepresentation x.support x
      (fun z => z.1) (fun z => z.2) = 0 := by
    simpa only [finiteHilbertGram, gramEvaluation,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] using hx
  have hzero := finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_inr_eq_zero_of_eq_zero μ α p
    ρ.essentialRepresentation a x.support x (fun z => z.1) (fun z => z.2) hbase
  simpa only [finiteHilbertGramCoefficient_inr, gramCoefficientTransform,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] using hzero

/-- The actual group transform has exactly the original finite-sum evaluation kernel. -/
theorem gramGroupTransform_kernel (g : G) :
    (gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g).ker = (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ).ker := by
  ext x
  change gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g x = 0 ↔ gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ x = 0
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    have hn := norm_gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g x
    rw [h, norm_zero] at hn
    exact hn.symm
  · intro h
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    exact (norm_gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g x).trans (by rw [h, norm_zero])

/-- The actual coefficient transform descended through the evaluation kernel to its Gram range. -/
def gramCoefficientOnDomain (a : A) :
    (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ).range →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace :=
  (gramCoefficientTransform μ α p H ρ a).compLeftInverse (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The descended coefficient map retains each actual finite-sum value. -/
theorem gramCoefficientOnDomain_apply (a : A)
    (x : (Carrier μ α × ρ.essentialSpace) →₀ ℂ) :
    gramCoefficientOnDomain μ α p H ρ a
      ⟨gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ x, LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x⟩ =
        gramCoefficientTransform μ α p H ρ a x := by
  exact LinearMap.compLeftInverse_apply_of_bdd _ _
    ⟨‖a‖, norm_gramCoefficientTransform_le μ α p H ρ a⟩ x _ rfl

/-- The actual coefficient operator obtained by dense extension of the descended Gram action. -/
def gramCoefficientOperator (a : A) : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace :=
  (gramCoefficientTransform μ α p H ρ a).extendOfNorm (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The extended coefficient operator retains the literal source coefficient action. -/
theorem gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace) :
    gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a
      (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ) =
        ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a f)) ξ := by
  have h := LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq (f := gramCoefficientTransform μ α p H ρ a)
    (e := gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ) (denseRange_gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ)
    ⟨‖a‖, norm_gramCoefficientTransform_le μ α p H ρ a⟩ (Finsupp.single (f, ξ) 1)
  simpa only [gramCoefficientOperator, gramCoefficientTransform, gramEvaluation,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul] using h

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual coefficient bound holds on every Hilbert vector after dense extension. -/
theorem norm_gramCoefficientOperator_apply_le (a : A) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace) :
    ‖gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a ξ‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖ξ‖ :=
  LinearMap.norm_extendOfNorm_apply_le (denseRange_gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ) ‖a‖
    (norm_gramCoefficientTransform_le μ α p H ρ a) ξ

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual extended coefficient operator has the original coefficient operator-norm bound. -/
theorem opNorm_gramCoefficientOperator_le (a : A) :
    ‖gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ :=
  LinearMap.opNorm_extendOfNorm_le (denseRange_gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ) (norm_nonneg a)
    (norm_gramCoefficientTransform_le μ α p H ρ a)

/-- The actual group transform descended through the evaluation kernel to its Gram range. -/
def gramGroupOnDomain (g : G) :
    (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ).range →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace :=
  (gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g).compLeftInverse (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ)

/-- The descended group map retains the literal transform of every original finite source sum. -/
theorem gramGroupOnDomain_apply (g : G)
    (x : (Carrier μ α × ρ.essentialSpace) →₀ ℂ) :
    gramGroupOnDomain μ α p H ρ g
      ⟨gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ x, LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x⟩ =
        gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g x := by
  exact LinearMap.compLeftInverse_apply_of_bdd _ _
    ⟨1, fun z => by simpa only [one_mul] using (norm_gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g z).le⟩ x _ rfl

/-- The actual descended group map preserves the inherited norm of every Gram-domain vector. -/
theorem norm_gramGroupOnDomain_apply (g : G) (x : (gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ).range) :
    ‖gramGroupOnDomain μ α p H ρ g x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  rcases x with ⟨y, ⟨z, hz⟩⟩
  subst y
  rw [gramGroupOnDomain_apply]
  exact norm_gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g z

/-- The actual group operator obtained from the proved finite Gram isometry and dense extension. -/
def gramGroupIsometry (g : G) : ρ.essentialSpace →ₗᵢ[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace :=
  (gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g).extendOfIsometry
    (e := gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ) (denseRange_gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ)
    (norm_gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g)

/-- The actual group isometry viewed as a bounded linear operator. -/
def gramGroupOperator (g : G) : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace :=
  (gramGroupIsometry μ α p H ρ g).toContinuousLinearMap

/-- The extended group operator retains the literal original group translation of every generator. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_apply_generator (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace) :
    gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g
      (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ) =
        ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (groupLeft μ α g f)) ξ := by
  change (gramGroupIsometry μ α p H ρ g).toContinuousLinearMap
    (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ) = _
  rw [gramGroupIsometry, LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap_extendOfIsometry]
  have h := LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq (f := gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g)
    (e := gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ) (denseRange_gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ)
    ⟨1, fun x => by simpa only [one_mul] using (norm_gramGroupTransform μ α p H ρ g x).le⟩
    (Finsupp.single (f, ξ) 1)
  simpa only [gramGroupTransform, gramEvaluation, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul] using h

/-- The actual extended group operator preserves the inherited Hilbert norm of every vector. -/
theorem norm_gramGroupOperator_apply (g : G) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace) :
    ‖gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ξ‖ = ‖ξ‖ :=
  (gramGroupIsometry μ α p H ρ g).norm_map ξ

end

end HaarTwistedCore

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.GramOperatorExtension
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Span.Basic

/-!
# Actual coefficient and unitary representation laws on the original Gram space

The computed bounded coefficient operators and isometric group operators act
on the actual essential Hilbert space. Equality on the original source
generators extends by their proved dense span. The literal Haar coefficient
and group identities then give their algebra laws and covariance.

The source mixed star product gives the coefficient adjoint law. The group
norm preservation and actual inverse composition give the group adjoint law
and unitary membership. These laws construct actual bundled representations.

Strong continuity of the group orbits and the integrated identity remain
separate prerequisites for a strongly continuous covariant model.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators InnerProductSpace

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
  (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)) (H : Type uH)
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (ρ : p.NonUnitalCompletion →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual original-source Gram generators determine every bounded operator. -/
theorem gramOperator_ext (T S : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace)
    (h : ∀ (f : Carrier μ α) (ξ : ρ.essentialSpace),
      T (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ) =
        S (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ)) : T = S := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  refine (p.dense_rawHilbertGramDomain H ρ).induction ?_
    (isClosed_eq T.continuous S.continuous) ξ
  intro η hη
  exact LinearMap.eqOn_span (f := T.toLinearMap) (g := S.toLinearMap)
    (by rintro _ ⟨⟨f, ζ⟩, rfl⟩; exact h f ζ) hη

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual source generators determine the adjoint identity of bounded operators. -/
theorem gramOperator_eq_star_of_inner_generators
    (T S : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace)
    (h : ∀ (f k : Carrier μ α) (ξ η : ρ.essentialSpace),
      ⟪T (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ),
        ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion k) η⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ,
        S (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion k) η)⟫_ℂ) :
    T = star S := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  apply (ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff T S).mpr
  intro ξ η
  refine (denseRange_gramEvaluation μ α p H ρ).induction_on₂
    (isClosed_eq ((T.continuous.comp continuous_fst).inner continuous_snd)
      (continuous_fst.inner (S.continuous.comp continuous_snd))) ?_ ξ η
  intro x y
  simp only [gramEvaluation, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    map_sum, map_smul, sum_inner, inner_sum, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply congrArg (fun z : ℂ => y i * z)
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [h j.1 i.1 j.2 i.2]

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual zero coefficient acts as the zero bounded operator. -/
theorem gramCoefficientOperator_zero :
    gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (0 : A) = 0 := by
  apply gramOperator_ext μ α p H ρ
  intro f ξ
  rw [gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator]
  have hzero : coefficientLeft μ α (0 : A) f = 0 :=
    congrArg (fun L : Module.End ℂ (Carrier μ α) => L f) (map_zero (coefficientLeftHom μ α))
  rw [hzero, map_zero, map_zero]
  rfl

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original coefficient addition is preserved by the computed bounded operators. -/
theorem gramCoefficientOperator_add (a b : A) :
    gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (a + b) =
      gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a + gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ b := by
  apply gramOperator_ext μ α p H ρ
  intro f ξ
  change gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (a + b)
      (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ) =
    gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a
        (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ) +
      gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ b
        (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ)
  rw [gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator, gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator,
    gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator, coefficientLeft_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
    map_add, map_add]
  rfl

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original complex coefficient scaling is preserved by the computed bounded operators. -/
theorem gramCoefficientOperator_smul (c : ℂ) (a : A) :
    gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (c • a) = c • gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a := by
  apply gramOperator_ext μ α p H ρ
  intro f ξ
  change gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (c • a)
      (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ) =
    c • gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a
      (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ)
  rw [gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator, gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator,
    coefficientLeft_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, map_smul]
  rfl

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original coefficient multiplication is preserved by the computed bounded operators. -/
theorem gramCoefficientOperator_mul (a b : A) :
    gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (a * b) =
      gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a * gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ b := by
  apply gramOperator_ext μ α p H ρ
  intro f ξ
  change gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (a * b)
      (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ) =
    gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a
      (gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ b
        (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ))
  rw [gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator, gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator,
    gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator, coefficientLeft_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply]

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual coefficient adjoint law follows from the original mixed star-convolution product. -/
theorem gramCoefficientOperator_star (a : A) :
    gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (star a) = star (gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a) := by
  apply gramOperator_eq_star_of_inner_generators μ α p H ρ
  intro f h ξ η
  rw [gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator, gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator]
  have hGram (u v : Carrier μ α) :
      ⟪ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion u) ξ,
        ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion v) η⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪ξ, ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion (star u * v)) η⟫_ℂ := by
    exact p.rawHilbertGramGenerator_inner H ρ u v ξ η
  rw [hGram, hGram]
  have hStar : star (coefficientLeft μ α (star a) f) =
      coefficientRight μ α a (star f) := by
    change crossedStar μ α (coefficientLeft μ α (star a) f) =
      coefficientRight μ α a (crossedStar μ α f)
    simpa only [star_star] using crossedStar_coefficientLeft μ α (star a) f
  have hRaw : star (coefficientLeft μ α (star a) f) * h =
      star f * coefficientLeft μ α a h := by
    rw [hStar]
    exact (convolution_coefficientLeft μ α a (star f) h).symm
  rw [hRaw]

/-- The computed coefficient operators as their actual nonunital star-algebra representation. -/
def gramCoefficientRepresentation : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) where
  toFun := gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ
  map_zero' := gramCoefficientOperator_zero μ α p H ρ
  map_add' := gramCoefficientOperator_add μ α p H ρ
  map_smul' := gramCoefficientOperator_smul μ α p H ρ
  map_mul' := gramCoefficientOperator_mul μ α p H ρ
  map_star' := gramCoefficientOperator_star μ α p H ρ

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual bundled coefficient representation retains its computed operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem gramCoefficientRepresentation_apply (a : A) :
    gramCoefficientRepresentation μ α p H ρ a = gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a := rfl

/-- The actual group identity acts as the identity bounded operator. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_one : gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ (1 : G) = 1 := by
  apply gramOperator_ext μ α p H ρ
  intro f ξ
  rw [gramGroupOperator_apply_generator, groupLeft_one, LinearMap.id_apply]
  rfl

/-- Original group multiplication is preserved by the computed bounded operators. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_mul (g h : G) :
    gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ (g * h) =
      gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g * gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ h := by
  apply gramOperator_ext μ α p H ρ
  intro f ξ
  change gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ (g * h)
      (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ) =
    gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g
      (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ h
        (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ))
  rw [gramGroupOperator_apply_generator, gramGroupOperator_apply_generator,
    gramGroupOperator_apply_generator, groupLeft_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply]

/-- The actual inverse group operator is a right inverse of the computed group operator. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_mul_inv (g : G) :
    gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g * gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g⁻¹ = 1 := by
  rw [← gramGroupOperator_mul, mul_inv_cancel, gramGroupOperator_one]

/-- The actual inverse group operator is a left inverse of the computed group operator. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_inv_mul (g : G) :
    gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g⁻¹ * gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g = 1 := by
  rw [← gramGroupOperator_mul, inv_mul_cancel, gramGroupOperator_one]

/-- The computed group norm preservation gives its actual left adjoint inverse identity. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_star_mul_self (g : G) :
    star (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g) * gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g = 1 := by
  change (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g).adjoint.comp (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g) = 1
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_map_iff_adjoint_comp_self _).mp
    (norm_gramGroupOperator_apply μ α p H ρ g)

/-- The actual group adjoint is precisely the computed inverse group operator. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_star (g : G) :
    star (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g) = gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g⁻¹ := by
  calc
    _ = star (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
    _ = star (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g) *
        (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g * gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g⁻¹) := by
      rw [gramGroupOperator_mul_inv]
    _ = (star (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g) * gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g) *
        gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g⁻¹ := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g⁻¹ := by rw [gramGroupOperator_star_mul_self, one_mul]

/-- Every computed original-source group operator is genuinely unitary. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_mem_unitary (g : G) :
    gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g ∈ unitary (ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) := by
  exact ⟨gramGroupOperator_star_mul_self μ α p H ρ g,
    by rw [gramGroupOperator_star, gramGroupOperator_mul_inv]⟩

/-- The computed group operators as their actual unitary monoid homomorphism. -/
def gramGroupUnitaryRepresentation : G →* unitary (ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) where
  toFun g := ⟨gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g, gramGroupOperator_mem_unitary μ α p H ρ g⟩
  map_one' := Subtype.ext (gramGroupOperator_one μ α p H ρ)
  map_mul' g h := Subtype.ext (gramGroupOperator_mul μ α p H ρ g h)

/-- The actual bundled unitary representation retains its computed group operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem gramGroupUnitaryRepresentation_apply_coe (g : G) :
    (gramGroupUnitaryRepresentation μ α p H ρ g : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) =
      gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g := rfl

/-- Original group-coefficient covariance is preserved by the computed bounded operators. -/
theorem gramGroupOperator_mul_coefficient (g : G) (a : A) :
    gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g * gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a =
      gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (α g a) * gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g := by
  apply gramOperator_ext μ α p H ρ
  intro f ξ
  change gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g
      (gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a
        (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ)) =
    gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (α g a)
      (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g
        (ρ.essentialRepresentation (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) ξ))
  rw [gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator, gramGroupOperator_apply_generator,
    gramGroupOperator_apply_generator, gramCoefficientOperator_apply_generator]
  have hRaw := congrArg (fun L : Module.End ℂ (Carrier μ α) => L f)
    (groupLeft_coefficientLeft μ α g a)
  change groupLeft μ α g (coefficientLeft μ α a f) =
    coefficientLeft μ α (α g a) (groupLeft μ α g f) at hRaw
  rw [hRaw]

/-- The actual coefficient and unitary operators satisfy the original conjugation covariance. -/
theorem gramRepresentation_covariance (g : G) (a : A) :
    (gramGroupUnitaryRepresentation μ α p H ρ g : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) *
        gramCoefficientRepresentation μ α p H ρ a *
        star (gramGroupUnitaryRepresentation μ α p H ρ g : ρ.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.essentialSpace) =
      gramCoefficientRepresentation μ α p H ρ (α g a) := by
  change gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g * gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ a *
    star (gramGroupOperator μ α p H ρ g) = gramCoefficientOperator μ α p H ρ (α g a)
  rw [gramGroupOperator_mul_coefficient, mul_assoc, gramGroupOperator_star,
    gramGroupOperator_mul_inv, mul_one]

end

end HaarTwistedCore

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.Basic
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Group.ModularCharacterContinuity

/-!
# The original Haar twisted involution

The coefficient at `s` is the positive-real modular weight times the action at `s`
of the adjoint coefficient at `s⁻¹`. The positive-real weight is written through
its canonical complex scalar image, using exactly the original complex module.
Only the additive, involutive and conjugate-linear structures are installed here;
the convolution multiplication has a separate owner.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory
open scoped CompactlySupported NNReal Pointwise CStarAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The literal modularly weighted adjoint coefficient function, with its original
compact support and continuous action. -/
def crossedStarCc (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f : C_c(G, A)) : C_c(G, A) where
  toFun s := ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) • α s (star (f s⁻¹))
  continuous_toFun := by
    have hδ : Continuous (fun s : G => ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp Measure.continuous_modularCharacter)
    exact hδ.smul (α.continuous_apply continuous_id ((map_continuous f).comp continuous_inv).star)
  hasCompactSupport' := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro f.hasCompactSupport.inv ?_
    intro s hs
    have hzero : f s⁻¹ = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      apply hs
      change s⁻¹ ∈ tsupport (f : G → A)
      exact subset_closure hne
    simp only [hzero, star_zero, PointNormCStarAction.apply_zero, smul_zero]

omit [MeasurableSpace G] in
/-- Evaluation of the original compact-support involution retains its Haar modular factor. -/
@[simp]
theorem crossedStarCc_apply (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    crossedStarCc α f s = ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) • α s (star (f s⁻¹)) :=
  rfl

omit [MeasurableSpace G] in
/-- Involuting a coefficient can only invert its original topological support. -/
theorem tsupport_crossedStarCc_subset (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f : C_c(G, A)) :
    tsupport (crossedStarCc α f : G → A) ⊆ (tsupport (f : G → A))⁻¹ := by
  refine closure_minimal ?_ (isClosed_tsupport (f : G → A)).inv
  intro s hs
  have hne : f s⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hs
    simp only [crossedStarCc_apply, hzero, star_zero, PointNormCStarAction.apply_zero, smul_zero]
  change s⁻¹ ∈ tsupport (f : G → A)
  exact subset_closure hne

variable (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The Haar twisted involution on the same measure- and action-indexed coefficient carrier. -/
def crossedStar (f : Carrier μ α) : Carrier μ α :=
  fromCc μ α (crossedStarCc α (toCc μ α f))

/-- The indexed involution has the exact original modularly weighted coefficient value. -/
@[simp]
theorem crossedStar_apply (f : Carrier μ α) (s : G) :
    crossedStar μ α f s = ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) • α s (star (f s⁻¹)) :=
  rfl

/-- The original twisted involution preserves addition of coefficient functions. -/
theorem crossedStar_add (f g : Carrier μ α) :
    crossedStar μ α (f + g) = crossedStar μ α f + crossedStar μ α g := by
  apply (equivCc μ α).injective
  change toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α (f + g)) =
    toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α f + crossedStar μ α g)
  rw [toCc_add]
  apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  simp only [crossedStar, toCc_fromCc, crossedStarCc_apply, toCc_add,
    CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply, star_add, PointNormCStarAction.apply_add, smul_add]

/-- The original twisted involution is conjugate-linear for the original complex module. -/
theorem crossedStar_smul (c : ℂ) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    crossedStar μ α (c • f) = star c • crossedStar μ α f := by
  apply (equivCc μ α).injective
  change toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α (c • f)) = toCc μ α (star c • crossedStar μ α f)
  rw [toCc_smul]
  apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  simp only [crossedStar, toCc_fromCc, crossedStarCc_apply, toCc_smul,
    CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, star_smul, PointNormCStarAction.apply_smul]
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

/-- Applying the source involution twice restores the original coefficient function. -/
theorem crossedStar_crossedStar (f : Carrier μ α) :
    crossedStar μ α (crossedStar μ α f) = f := by
  apply (equivCc μ α).injective
  change toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α (crossedStar μ α f)) = toCc μ α f
  apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  have hδ : ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ((Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) = 1 := by
    have h : Measure.modularCharacter s * Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one]
    have hreal : (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) *
        (Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ : ℝ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast h
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  have hstarδ : star ((Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ((Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simp
  simp only [crossedStar, toCc_fromCc, crossedStarCc_apply, inv_inv]
  change ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    α s (star (((Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • α s⁻¹ (star (f s)))) = f s
  rw [star_smul, hstarδ, ← PointNormCStarAction.apply_star, star_star,
    PointNormCStarAction.apply_smul, PointNormCStarAction.apply_apply_inv, ← mul_smul, hδ, one_smul]

/-- The core's star is the original Haar twisted involution. -/
instance instStarCarrier : Star (Carrier μ α) :=
  ⟨crossedStar μ α⟩

/-- The original modular character and inverse action make the core's star involutive. -/
instance instInvolutiveStarCarrier : InvolutiveStar (Carrier μ α) where
  star_involutive := crossedStar_crossedStar μ α

/-- The original additive coefficient group has its source twisted star structure. -/
instance instStarAddMonoidCarrier : StarAddMonoid (Carrier μ α) where
  star_add := crossedStar_add μ α

/-- The original complex module has its source conjugate-linear twisted star structure. -/
instance instStarModuleCarrier : StarModule ℂ (Carrier μ α) where
  star_smul := crossedStar_smul μ α

end

end HaarTwistedCore

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.L1Seminorm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Algebra.NonUnitalStarCompletion.Scalar
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.StarAlgHom

/-!
# The ordinary L1 completion of the original Haar core

Only the source norm and pseudometric are computed from the literal
coefficient-norm integral. The original Haar convolution, modular star
and complex scalar action remain unchanged. Their ordinary completion is
an actual complete nonunital normed star algebra. The canonical map retains
every L1 norm and has dense range. No C-star square identity is imposed
on the source or its L1 completion.

All dictionaries are explicit local factories. An approximate identity
and the comparison with the full covariant norm are separate obligations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The original nonunital core ring with only norm and pseudometric computed from literal L1. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def sourceL1SeminormedRing : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) where
  __ := (inferInstance : NonUnitalRing (Carrier μ α))
  __ := (l1RingSeminorm μ α).toAddGroupSeminorm.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
  norm_mul_le := (l1RingSeminorm μ α).mul_le'

/-- The original complex module is normed by the same coefficient-norm integral. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def sourceL1NormedSpace :
    let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
    NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  exact
    { toModule := inferInstance
      norm_smul_le := fun c f => by
        change l1Gauge μ α (c • f) ≤ ‖c‖ * l1Gauge μ α f
        exact (l1Gauge_smul μ α c f).le }

/-- The original modular involution is isometric in the computed L1 source norm. -/
theorem sourceL1NormedStarGroup :
    let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
    NormedStarGroup (Carrier μ α) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  refine { norm_star_le := ?_ }
  intro f
  change l1Gauge μ α (star f) ≤ l1Gauge μ α f
  exact (l1Gauge_star μ α f).le

/-- The ordinary uniform completion of the same core in its literal L1 pseudometric. -/
abbrev L1Completion : Type (max uG uA) :=
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  UniformSpace.Completion (Carrier μ α)

/-- The same dense nonunital multiplication supplies the completed normed ring. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.nonUnitalCompletionNormedRing (Carrier μ α)

/-- The ordinary L1 completion retains the stock complex scalar action and norm. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def l1CompletionNormedSpace :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  exact inferInstance

/-- The completion star is the completion map of the original modular involution. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def l1CompletionStarRing :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.nonUnitalCompletionStarRing (Carrier μ α)

/-- The canonical completed modular involution preserves the completed L1 norm. -/
theorem l1CompletionNormedStarGroup :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    NormedStarGroup (L1Completion μ α) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  let _ : ContinuousStar (L1Completion μ α) :=
    UniformSpace.Completion.nonUnitalCompletionStarRing_continuousStar (Carrier μ α)
  refine { norm_star_le := ?_ }
  intro x
  have hnorm : ‖star x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
    refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on
      (α := Carrier μ α) (p := fun x : L1Completion μ α => ‖star x‖ = ‖x‖) x
      (isClosed_eq (continuous_norm.comp continuous_star) continuous_norm) ?_
    intro f
    rw [UniformSpace.Completion.nonUnitalCompletionStarRing_star_coe,
      UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe, UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe, norm_star]
  exact hnorm.le

/-- The completed star respects the same stock complex scalar action. -/
theorem l1CompletionStarModule :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    StarModule ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.nonUnitalCompletionStarRing_starModule (R := ℂ) (Carrier μ α)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The original complex scalar-tower law holds for completed convolution. -/
theorem l1CompletionIsScalarTower :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    IsScalarTower ℂ (L1Completion μ α) (L1Completion μ α) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.nonUnitalCompletionIsScalarTower (𝕜 := ℂ) (Carrier μ α)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Complex scaling commutes with completed right convolution. -/
theorem l1CompletionSMulCommClass :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    SMulCommClass ℂ (L1Completion μ α) (L1Completion μ α) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.nonUnitalCompletionSMulCommClass (𝕜 := ℂ) (Carrier μ α)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The original uniform completion is complete in its computed L1 normed-ring uniformity. -/
theorem l1CompletionCompleteSpace :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    CompleteSpace (L1Completion μ α) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  exact inferInstance

/-- The canonical nonunital star-algebra map is the ordinary completion coercion. -/
def toL1Completion :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    Carrier μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] L1Completion μ α := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  exact
    { (UniformSpace.Completion.coeNonUnitalAlgHom (𝕜 := ℂ) (Carrier μ α)) with
      map_star' := fun f =>
        (UniformSpace.Completion.nonUnitalCompletionStarRing_star_coe (Carrier μ α) f).symm }

/-- The same canonical map retains the original completion coefficient values. -/
@[simp]
theorem toL1Completion_apply (f : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    toL1Completion μ α f = (f : L1Completion μ α) :=
  rfl

/-- The canonical completed norm is exactly the original coefficient-norm integral. -/
theorem norm_toL1Completion (f : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    ‖toL1Completion μ α f‖ = l1Gauge μ α f := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  change ‖(f : UniformSpace.Completion (Carrier μ α))‖ = l1Gauge μ α f
  rw [UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe]
  rfl

/-- Every original L1 coefficient class has dense image in the same ordinary completion. -/
theorem denseRange_toL1Completion :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    DenseRange (toL1Completion μ α) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  change DenseRange ((↑) : Carrier μ α → UniformSpace.Completion (Carrier μ α))
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.denseRange_coe

end

end HaarTwistedCore

/-!
# The original Haar-core L1 gauge

The auxiliary gauge is the integral of the norm of the original compactly
supported coefficient function. It uses the original coefficient norm and
complex module; no norm or metric is installed on the raw Haar core.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped CompactlySupported

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Monoid G] [TopologicalSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The literal integral of the original coefficient norm on the indexed Haar core. -/
def l1Gauge (f : Carrier μ α) : ℝ :=
  ∫ s : G, ‖f s‖ ∂μ

/-- The original coefficient-norm integral is nonnegative. -/
theorem l1Gauge_nonneg (f : Carrier μ α) : 0 ≤ l1Gauge μ α f :=
  integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _

/-- The indexed zero coefficient function has zero auxiliary L1 gauge. -/
@[simp]
theorem l1Gauge_zero : l1Gauge μ α (0 : Carrier μ α) = 0 := by
  simp only [l1Gauge, toCc_zero, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.zero_apply, norm_zero,
    integral_zero]

/-- Original complex coefficient scaling multiplies the gauge by the scalar norm. -/
theorem l1Gauge_smul (c : ℂ) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    l1Gauge μ α (c • f) = ‖c‖ * l1Gauge μ α f := by
  have hfun : (fun s : G => ‖(c • f) s‖) = fun s : G => ‖c‖ * ‖f s‖ := by
    funext s
    rw [toCc_smul, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, norm_smul]
  unfold l1Gauge
  rw [hfun, integral_const_mul]

/-- Taking the additive inverse preserves the same coefficient-norm integral. -/
@[simp]
theorem l1Gauge_neg (f : Carrier μ α) : l1Gauge μ α (-f) = l1Gauge μ α f := by
  rw [← neg_one_smul ℂ f, l1Gauge_smul, norm_neg, norm_one, one_mul]

variable [BorelSpace G] [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]

omit [Monoid G] in
/-- The norm of a genuine compactly supported continuous coefficient is integrable. -/
private theorem l1NormIntegrable (f : C_c(G, A)) :
    Integrable (fun s : G => ‖f s‖) μ := by
  have hcomp : HasCompactSupport (fun s : G => ‖f s‖) :=
    f.hasCompactSupport.comp_left (g := fun a : A => ‖a‖) norm_zero
  exact (map_continuous f).norm.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcomp

/-- The original additive coefficient functions satisfy the L1 triangle inequality. -/
theorem l1Gauge_add_le (f g : Carrier μ α) :
    l1Gauge μ α (f + g) ≤ l1Gauge μ α f + l1Gauge μ α g := by
  have hf := l1NormIntegrable μ (toCc μ α f)
  have hg := l1NormIntegrable μ (toCc μ α g)
  have hfg := l1NormIntegrable μ (toCc μ α (f + g))
  have hpoint (s : G) : ‖(f + g) s‖ ≤ ‖f s‖ + ‖g s‖ := by
    rw [toCc_add, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  calc
    l1Gauge μ α (f + g) ≤ ∫ s : G, (‖f s‖ + ‖g s‖) ∂μ :=
      integral_mono hfg (hf.add hg) hpoint
    _ = l1Gauge μ α f + l1Gauge μ α g := integral_add hf hg

/-- The literal coefficient-norm integral is an actual complex seminorm on the same raw core. -/
def l1Seminorm : Seminorm ℂ (Carrier μ α) :=
  Seminorm.of (l1Gauge μ α) (l1Gauge_add_le μ α) (l1Gauge_smul μ α)

/-- The complex seminorm retains the exact original coefficient-norm integral. -/
@[simp]
theorem l1Seminorm_apply (f : Carrier μ α) : l1Seminorm μ α f = l1Gauge μ α f :=
  rfl

end

end HaarTwistedCore

/-!
# The original Haar-core L1 ring seminorm

Compact-support Fubini and individual left Haar translations give the literal
coefficient-norm integral its convolution bound. The adopted weighted Haar
inversion formula gives star isometry with the original modular factor.
These are the auxiliary Banach star-algebra data used by the later completion;
no C-star square identity or raw normed ring is imposed on this gauge.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped CompactlySupported Pointwise NNReal

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual left-Haar twisted convolution is submultiplicative for the original L1 gauge. -/
theorem l1Gauge_convolution_le (f g : Carrier μ α) :
    l1Gauge μ α (convolution μ α f g) ≤ l1Gauge μ α f * l1Gauge μ α g := by
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  let F : C_c(G, A) := toCc μ α f
  let Q : C_c(G, A) := toCc μ α g
  let K : G → G → ℝ := fun s t => ‖F t‖ * ‖Q (t⁻¹ * s)‖
  let S : Set G := tsupport F * tsupport Q
  have hScompact : IsCompact S := F.hasCompactSupport.mul Q.hasCompactSupport
  have hSclosed : IsClosed S :=
    (isClosed_tsupport Q).mul_left_of_isCompact F.hasCompactSupport
  have hKcont : Continuous K.uncurry :=
    ((map_continuous F).comp continuous_snd).norm.mul
      (((map_continuous Q).comp (continuous_snd.inv.mul continuous_fst)).norm)
  have hKzeroLeft (s t : G) (ht : t ∉ tsupport F) : K s t = 0 := by
    simp only [K, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport ht, norm_zero, zero_mul]
  have hKzero (s t : G) (hs : s ∉ S) : K s t = 0 := by
    by_cases ht : t ∈ tsupport F
    · have hq : t⁻¹ * s ∉ tsupport Q := by
        intro hqs
        apply hs
        change s ∈ tsupport F * tsupport Q
        simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using Set.mul_mem_mul ht hqs
      simp only [K, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hq, norm_zero, mul_zero]
    · exact hKzeroLeft s t ht
  have hKcomp : HasCompactSupport K.uncurry := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro' (hScompact.prod F.hasCompactSupport)
      (hSclosed.prod (isClosed_tsupport F)) ?_
    rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hst
    by_cases hs : s ∈ S
    · exact hKzeroLeft s t (fun ht => hst ⟨hs, ht⟩)
    · exact hKzero s t hs
  have hKslice (s : G) : Integrable (K s) μ := by
    have hc : Continuous (K s) := hKcont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have hcomp : HasCompactSupport (K s) :=
      HasCompactSupport.intro' F.hasCompactSupport (isClosed_tsupport F) (hKzeroLeft s)
    exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcomp
  let J : G → ℝ := fun s => ∫ t : G, K s t ∂μ
  have hJcont : Continuous J := by
    let L : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ
    have hq : IntegrableOn (fun _ : G => (1 : ℝ)) (tsupport F) μ :=
      integrableOn_const F.hasCompactSupport.measure_ne_top
    have hc :=
      _root_.continuousOn_integral_bilinear_of_locally_integrable_of_compact_support
        L F.hasCompactSupport hKcont.continuousOn
        (fun s t _ ht => hKzeroLeft s t ht) hq (s := Set.univ)
    have hfun : (fun s : G => ∫ t : G, L (1 : ℝ) (K s t) ∂μ) = J := by
      funext s
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with t
      change (1 : ℝ) • K s t = K s t
      exact one_smul ℝ _
    rw [hfun] at hc
    exact continuousOn_univ.mp hc
  have hJzero (s : G) (hs : s ∉ S) : J s = 0 := by
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => hKzero s t hs
  have hJcomp : HasCompactSupport J :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro' hScompact hSclosed hJzero
  have hJint : Integrable J μ := hJcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hJcomp
  have hJvalue : (∫ s : G, J s ∂μ) = l1Gauge μ α f * l1Gauge μ α g := by
    calc
      (∫ s : G, J s ∂μ) = ∫ t : G, (∫ s : G, K s t ∂μ) ∂μ :=
        integral_integral_swap_of_hasCompactSupport hKcont hKcomp
      _ = ∫ t : G, ‖F t‖ * l1Gauge μ α g ∂μ := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [] with t
        change (∫ s : G, ‖F t‖ * ‖Q (t⁻¹ * s)‖ ∂μ) = ‖F t‖ * l1Gauge μ α g
        rw [integral_const_mul,
          integral_mul_left_eq_self (μ := μ) (fun s : G => ‖Q s‖) t⁻¹]
        rfl
      _ = l1Gauge μ α f * l1Gauge μ α g :=
        integral_mul_const (l1Gauge μ α g) (fun t : G => ‖F t‖)
  have hConvInt : Integrable (fun s : G => ‖convolution μ α f g s‖) μ := by
    change Integrable (fun s : G => ‖ccConvolution μ α F Q s‖) μ
    have hcomp : HasCompactSupport (fun s : G => ‖ccConvolution μ α F Q s‖) :=
      (ccConvolution μ α F Q).hasCompactSupport.comp_left
        (g := fun a : A => ‖a‖) norm_zero
    exact (map_continuous (ccConvolution μ α F Q)).norm.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcomp
  have hPoint (s : G) : ‖convolution μ α f g s‖ ≤ J s := by
    change ‖∫ t : G, kernel α F Q s t ∂μ‖ ≤ ∫ t : G, K s t ∂μ
    calc
      ‖∫ t : G, kernel α F Q s t ∂μ‖ ≤ ∫ t : G, ‖kernel α F Q s t‖ ∂μ :=
        norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
      _ ≤ ∫ t : G, K s t ∂μ := by
        apply integral_mono (integrable_kernel μ α F Q s).norm (hKslice s)
        intro t
        calc
          ‖kernel α F Q s t‖ ≤ ‖F t‖ * ‖α t (Q (t⁻¹ * s))‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
          _ = K s t := by rw [PointNormCStarAction.norm_apply]
  calc
    l1Gauge μ α (convolution μ α f g) ≤ ∫ s : G, J s ∂μ :=
      integral_mono hConvInt hJint hPoint
    _ = l1Gauge μ α f * l1Gauge μ α g := hJvalue

/-- The original modular involution is isometric for the same auxiliary L1 gauge. -/
@[simp]
theorem l1Gauge_star (f : Carrier μ α) : l1Gauge μ α (star f) = l1Gauge μ α f := by
  have hPoint (s : G) : ‖(star f) s‖ = (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) * ‖f s⁻¹‖ := by
    change ‖crossedStar μ α f s‖ = (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) * ‖f s⁻¹‖
    rw [crossedStar_apply, norm_smul, PointNormCStarAction.norm_apply, norm_star]
    simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg (Measure.modularCharacter s))]
  have hcont : Continuous (fun s : G => ‖f s‖) := (map_continuous (toCc μ α f)).norm
  have hcomp : HasCompactSupport (fun s : G => ‖f s‖) :=
    (toCc μ α f).hasCompactSupport.comp_left (g := fun a : A => ‖a‖) norm_zero
  calc
    l1Gauge μ α (star f) = ∫ s : G, (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) • ‖f s⁻¹‖ ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Eventually.of_forall hPoint
    _ = l1Gauge μ α f :=
      integral_modularCharacter_smul_inv_of_hasCompactSupport μ hcont hcomp

/-- The original coefficient-norm integral is an actual ring seminorm for Haar convolution. -/
def l1RingSeminorm : RingSeminorm (Carrier μ α) where
  __ := (l1Seminorm μ α).toAddGroupSeminorm
  mul_le' := fun f g => l1Gauge_convolution_le μ α f g

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The auxiliary ring seminorm retains every original coefficient-norm integral value. -/
@[simp]
theorem l1RingSeminorm_apply (f : Carrier μ α) : l1RingSeminorm μ α f = l1Gauge μ α f :=
  rfl

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.L1Completion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.MaximalSeminorm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SeminormNonUnitalCompletion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Algebra.NonUnitalStarCompletion.Hom

/-!
# The original Haar L1 completion maps to every admissible seminorm completion

The canonical map for the actual seminorm is bounded by the literal L1
coefficient integral. Extend that same nonunital star-algebra map through
the existing completion factory. Its canonical coefficient values and
contractive complex linear map supply the integral transport used to build
the original covariant representation of an admissible seminorm.

The seminorm and coefficient algebra may be zero. No covariant norm
comparison or integrated identity is an input to these constructed data.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)
variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)) (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α)

/-- The original canonical seminorm map is bounded in the actual source L1 norm. -/
def sourceToSeminormCompletionCLM :
    let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    Carrier μ α →L[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  let L : Carrier μ α →ₗ[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion :=
    { toFun := p.toNonUnitalCompletion
      map_add' := map_add p.toNonUnitalCompletion
      map_smul' := fun c f => map_smul p.toNonUnitalCompletion c f }
  exact L.mkContinuous 1 (by
    intro f
    change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion f‖ ≤ 1 * l1Gauge μ α f
    rw [p.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion, one_mul]
    exact hp f)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The bounded raw map retains the original quotient-and-completion value. -/
theorem sourceToSeminormCompletionCLM_apply (f : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    sourceToSeminormCompletionCLM μ α p hp f = p.toNonUnitalCompletion f :=
  rfl

/-- Extend the same canonical star map to the actual ordinary L1 completion. -/
def l1ToSeminormCompletion :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    L1Completion μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.fromCompletion p.toNonUnitalCompletion
    (sourceToSeminormCompletionCLM μ α p hp).continuous

/-- Every original coefficient has the same actual seminorm-completion image. -/
theorem l1ToSeminormCompletion_apply (f : Carrier μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    l1ToSeminormCompletion μ α p hp (toL1Completion μ α f) = p.toNonUnitalCompletion f := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.fromCompletion_apply_coe p.toNonUnitalCompletion
    (sourceToSeminormCompletionCLM μ α p hp).continuous f

/-- The same star map is continuous in the original L1 completion topology. -/
theorem continuous_l1ToSeminormCompletion :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    Continuous (l1ToSeminormCompletion μ α p hp) := by
  let _ : NonUnitalSeminormedRing (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1SeminormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedSpace μ α
  let _ : NormedStarGroup (Carrier μ α) := sourceL1NormedStarGroup μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.continuous_fromCompletion p.toNonUnitalCompletion
    (sourceToSeminormCompletionCLM μ α p hp).continuous

/-- The original L1 bound extends to every element of the same completion. -/
theorem norm_l1ToSeminormCompletion_le (x : L1Completion μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    ‖l1ToSeminormCompletion μ α p hp x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  have hcont := continuous_l1ToSeminormCompletion μ α p hp
  refine (denseRange_toL1Completion μ α).induction_on x
    (isClosed_le hcont.norm continuous_norm) ?_
  intro f
  change ‖l1ToSeminormCompletion μ α p hp (toL1Completion μ α f)‖ ≤
    ‖toL1Completion μ α f‖
  rw [l1ToSeminormCompletion_apply, p.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion]
  change p f ≤ ‖toL1Completion μ α f‖
  rw [norm_toL1Completion]
  exact hp f

/-- The same actual comparison function as a contractive complex linear map. -/
def l1ToSeminormCompletionCLM :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    L1Completion μ α →L[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion := by
  let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
  let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  let L : L1Completion μ α →ₗ[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion :=
    { toFun := l1ToSeminormCompletion μ α p hp
      map_add' := map_add (l1ToSeminormCompletion μ α p hp)
      map_smul' := fun c x => map_smul (l1ToSeminormCompletion μ α p hp) c x }
  exact L.mkContinuous 1 (by
    intro x
    change ‖l1ToSeminormCompletion μ α p hp x‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖
    simpa only [one_mul] using norm_l1ToSeminormCompletion_le μ α p hp x)

/-- The comparison's linear and star-algebra views have the same values. -/
theorem l1ToSeminormCompletionCLM_apply (x : L1Completion μ α) :
    let _ : NonUnitalNormedRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNonUnitalNormedRing μ α
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionNormedSpace μ α
    let _ : StarRing (L1Completion μ α) := l1CompletionStarRing μ α
    let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
    l1ToSeminormCompletionCLM μ α p hp x = l1ToSeminormCompletion μ α p hp x :=
  rfl

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.L1Gauge
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.MultiplierActions
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Set
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Group.Integral
public import Mathlib.Topology.Compactness.LocallyCompact

/-!
# L1 continuity of the original compact-support group translates

The literal inverse left translate with the coefficient action preserves the
Haar coefficient integral. On a compact neighborhood of each group element,
all translated supports lie in one compact set. Joint point-norm continuity
and the support-local integral continuity theorem give the L1 orbit limit.
This supplies a strict continuity prerequisite for the actual covariant group
representation; no normed or C-star structure is installed on the raw core.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped CompactlySupported Pointwise Topology

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

section HaarIsometry

variable [μ.IsHaarMeasure]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] in
/-- The original inverse left translate is isometric for the literal Haar L1 gauge. -/
theorem l1Gauge_groupLeft (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    l1Gauge μ α (groupLeft μ α g f) = l1Gauge μ α f := by
  calc
    l1Gauge μ α (groupLeft μ α g f) = ∫ s : G, ‖f (g⁻¹ * s)‖ ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun s => by
        change ‖(toCc μ α (groupLeft μ α g f)) s‖ = ‖(toCc μ α f) (g⁻¹ * s)‖
        rw [groupLeft_apply, PointNormCStarAction.norm_apply]
    _ = l1Gauge μ α f := integral_mul_left_eq_self (μ := μ) (fun s : G => ‖f s‖) g⁻¹

end HaarIsometry

variable [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]

/-- The original compact translates vary continuously in the coefficient-integral distance. -/
theorem continuous_l1Gauge_groupLeft_sub (f : Carrier μ α) :
    Continuous fun g : G => l1Gauge μ α (groupLeft μ α g f - f) := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro g₀
  obtain ⟨V, hVcompact, hVnhds⟩ := exists_compact_mem_nhds g₀
  let F : C_c(G, A) := toCc μ α f
  let K : Set G := (V * tsupport F) ∪ tsupport F
  have hKcompact : IsCompact K := (hVcompact.mul F.hasCompactSupport).union F.hasCompactSupport
  let D : G → G → ℝ := fun g s => ‖α g (F (g⁻¹ * s)) - F s‖
  have hDcont : Continuous D.uncurry :=
    ((α.continuous_apply continuous_fst
      ((map_continuous F).comp (continuous_fst.inv.mul continuous_snd))).sub
        ((map_continuous F).comp continuous_snd)).norm
  have hDzero (g s : G) (hg : g ∈ V) (hs : s ∉ K) : D g s = 0 := by
    have hFzero : F s = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport fun hfs => hs (Or.inr hfs)
    have hTransZero : F (g⁻¹ * s) = 0 := by
      apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      intro hfs
      apply hs
      apply Or.inl
      simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using Set.mul_mem_mul hg hfs
    simp only [D, hFzero, hTransZero, PointNormCStarAction.apply_zero, sub_self, norm_zero]
  let L : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ
  have hOne : IntegrableOn (fun _ : G => (1 : ℝ)) K μ :=
    integrableOn_const hKcompact.measure_ne_top
  have hIntegral :=
    _root_.continuousOn_integral_bilinear_of_locally_integrable_of_compact_support
      L hKcompact hDcont.continuousOn hDzero hOne
  have hfun : (fun g : G => ∫ s : G, L (1 : ℝ) (D g s) ∂μ) =
      fun g : G => l1Gauge μ α (groupLeft μ α g f - f) := by
    funext g
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun s => by
      change (1 : ℝ) • ‖α g (f (g⁻¹ * s)) - f s‖ = ‖α g (f (g⁻¹ * s)) - f s‖
      exact one_smul ℝ _
  rw [hfun] at hIntegral
  exact (hIntegral g₀ (mem_of_mem_nhds hVnhds)).continuousAt hVnhds

/-- The literal coefficient-integral distance of a translate from its source tends to zero at one. -/
theorem tendsto_l1Gauge_groupLeft_sub (f : Carrier μ α) :
    Tendsto (fun g : G => l1Gauge μ α (groupLeft μ α g f - f)) (𝓝 1) (𝓝 0) := by
  simpa only [groupLeft_one, LinearMap.id_apply, sub_self, l1Gauge_zero] using
    (continuous_l1Gauge_groupLeft_sub μ α f).tendsto (1 : G)

end

end HaarTwistedCore

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Seminorm
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.StarRing
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.L1Gauge

/-!
# The intrinsic L1-bounded C-star seminorm on the original Haar core

The family consists of actual C-star seminorms on Carrier μ α bounded by the
literal coefficient-norm integral. Zero belongs to this family. Its actual
pointwise real L1 bound supplies the checked CStarSeminorm.sSup construction,
which retains the original multiplication, star and complex scalar data.

Identification with Blackadar's supremum of actual covariant norms is a
separate construction obligation. This owner supplies the intrinsic gauge
and its bounds for that reconciliation and the same-gauge completion.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The actual C-star seminorms bounded by the literal source L1 coefficient integral. -/
def admissibleCStarSeminorms : Set (CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)) :=
  {p | ∀ f : Carrier μ α, p f ≤ l1Gauge μ α f}

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual zero C-star seminorm is admissible, including for a zero coefficient algebra. -/
theorem zero_mem_admissibleCStarSeminorms :
    (0 : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)) ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α := by
  intro f
  simpa only [CStarSeminorm.zero_apply] using l1Gauge_nonneg μ α f

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The literal admissible family contains its actual zero seminorm. -/
theorem admissibleCStarSeminorms_nonempty : (admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α).Nonempty :=
  ⟨0, zero_mem_admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α⟩

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The original coefficient-norm integral bounds every admissible value at each source element. -/
theorem admissibleCStarSeminorms_bddAbove (f : Carrier μ α) :
    BddAbove ((fun p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α) => p f) '' admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) := by
  refine ⟨l1Gauge μ α f, ?_⟩
  rintro r ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  exact hp f

/-- The computed intrinsic supremum of the actual L1-bounded C-star seminorm family. -/
def maximalCStarSeminorm : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α) :=
  CStarSeminorm.sSup (admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α)
    (admissibleCStarSeminorms_nonempty μ α) (admissibleCStarSeminorms_bddAbove μ α)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The intrinsic gauge is the literal real supremum of the admissible original values. -/
theorem maximalCStarSeminorm_apply (f : Carrier μ α) :
    maximalCStarSeminorm μ α f =
      SupSet.sSup ((fun p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α) => p f) '' admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) :=
  CStarSeminorm.sSup_apply (admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α)
    (admissibleCStarSeminorms_nonempty μ α) (admissibleCStarSeminorms_bddAbove μ α) f

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Each actual admissible gauge is bounded by the computed intrinsic maximum. -/
theorem le_maximalCStarSeminorm {p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)}
    (hp : p ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    p f ≤ maximalCStarSeminorm μ α f :=
  CStarSeminorm.le_sSup (admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α)
    (admissibleCStarSeminorms_nonempty μ α) (admissibleCStarSeminorms_bddAbove μ α) hp f

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The same literal L1 coefficient integral bounds the computed intrinsic maximum. -/
theorem maximalCStarSeminorm_le_l1Gauge (f : Carrier μ α) :
    maximalCStarSeminorm μ α f ≤ l1Gauge μ α f :=
  CStarSeminorm.sSup_le (admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α)
    (admissibleCStarSeminorms_nonempty μ α) (admissibleCStarSeminorms_bddAbove μ α)
    (x := f) (C := l1Gauge μ α f) (fun _ hp => hp f)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The computed maximum is itself an admissible candidate on the same original Haar core. -/
theorem maximalCStarSeminorm_mem_admissible :
    maximalCStarSeminorm μ α ∈ admissibleCStarSeminorms μ α :=
  maximalCStarSeminorm_le_l1Gauge μ α

end

end HaarTwistedCore
