Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.DirectLimit
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.NonUnitalCompletion
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom

/-!
# Completed limits of norm-preserving C-star systems

The input contains actual complete coefficient algebras and coherent
norm-preserving nonunital star homomorphisms. The carrier is the ordinary
uniform completion of Mathlib's algebraic direct limit with the descended
stage norm. Its inclusions, C-star dictionary, dense union and universal
property are constructed from that carrier.

No completed carrier or universal-property witness is selected from an
existence theorem. The limit may be the zero algebra and its maps need not
be unital.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Set

namespace CStarAlgebra.DirectLimit

universe uI uA uC

/-- Raw input for an isometric directed C-star system. -/
structure IsometricSystem (I : Type uI) [Preorder I] where
  /-- Actual stage carriers. -/
  Stage : I → Type uA
  /-- The original complete C-star dictionaries. -/
  [stageCStarAlgebra : ∀ i, NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (Stage i)]
  /-- Actual nonunital star homomorphisms. -/
  map : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → Stage i →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] Stage j
  /-- Reflexivity of the input maps. -/
  map_refl : ∀ i, map i i le_rfl = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (Stage i)
  /-- Coherence of the input maps. -/
  map_trans : ∀ {i j k} (hij : i ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k),
    (map j k hjk).comp (map i j hij) = map i k (hij.trans hjk)
  /-- The norm used on the algebraic limit is the actual stage norm. -/
  norm_map : ∀ i j (hij : i ≤ j) x, ‖map i j hij x‖ = ‖x‖

attribute [instance] IsometricSystem.stageCStarAlgebra

namespace IsometricSystem

variable {I : Type uI} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I] [Nonempty I]

instance directedSystem (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) :
    DirectedSystem S.Stage (S.map · · ·) where
  map_self := fun {i} x => DFunLike.congr_fun (S.map_refl i) x
  map_map := fun {_k _j _i} hij hjk x => DFunLike.congr_fun (S.map_trans hij hjk) x

/-- Mathlib's original algebraic direct-limit carrier. -/
abbrev Raw (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) :=
  _root_.DirectLimit S.Stage S.map

noncomputable instance rawNormedRing (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) :
    NonUnitalNormedRing S.Raw :=
  _root_.DirectLimit.nonUnitalNormedRingOfNormPreserving S.map S.norm_map

noncomputable instance rawNormedSpace (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) :
    NormedSpace ℂ S.Raw :=
  _root_.DirectLimit.normedSpaceOfNormPreserving (𝕜 := ℂ) S.map S.norm_map

noncomputable instance rawCStarRing (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) :
    CStarRing S.Raw :=
  _root_.DirectLimit.cstar_ring_of_norm_preserving S.map S.norm_map

/-- The ordinary completion, with the input system's descended norm. -/
abbrev Completed (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) :=
  UniformSpace.Completion S.Raw

noncomputable instance completedCStarAlgebra (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) :
    NonUnitalCStarAlgebra S.Completed :=
  CStarAlgebra.completionNonUnitalCStarAlgebra S.Raw

/-- The algebraic coefficient map with its original star operation. -/
def rawOf (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) (i : I) : S.Stage i →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] S.Raw where
  toNonUnitalAlgHom := _root_.DirectLimit.NonUnitalAlgebra.of S.Stage S.map i
  map_star' x := (_root_.DirectLimit.star_def (f := S.map) i x).symm

/-- The actual stage inclusion into the completed direct limit. -/
def of (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) (i : I) : S.Stage i →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] S.Completed where
  toFun x := (S.rawOf i x : S.Completed)
  map_zero' := by
    rw [map_zero, UniformSpace.Completion.coe_zero]
  map_add' x y := by
    rw [map_add, UniformSpace.Completion.coe_add]
  map_mul' x y := by
    rw [map_mul, UniformSpace.Completion.nonUnitalCompletion_coe_mul S.Raw]
  map_smul' c x := by
    simp only [map_smul, UniformSpace.Completion.coe_smul, MonoidHom.coe_id, id]
  map_star' x := by
    rw [map_star, CStarAlgebra.completionNonUnitalCStarAlgebra_star_coe S.Raw]

/-- Each stage inclusion retains its original norm. -/
@[simp]
theorem norm_of (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) (i : I) (x : S.Stage i) :
    ‖S.of i x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  change ‖(S.rawOf i x : S.Completed)‖ = ‖x‖
  rw [UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe]
  exact _root_.DirectLimit.normedAddCommGroupOfNormPreserving_norm_mk S.map S.norm_map i x

/-- No element of an original stage is lost by completion. -/
theorem of_injective (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) (i : I) :
    Function.Injective (S.of i) := by
  intro x y hxy
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply norm_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← S.norm_of i (x - y), map_sub, hxy, sub_self, norm_zero]

/-- The canonical inclusions commute with the actual connecting maps. -/
@[simp]
theorem of_map (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) {i j : I}
    (hij : i ≤ j) (x : S.Stage i) : S.of j (S.map i j hij x) = S.of i x := by
  change ((_root_.DirectLimit.NonUnitalAlgebra.of S.Stage S.map j
      (S.map i j hij x) : S.Raw) : S.Completed) =
    ((_root_.DirectLimit.NonUnitalAlgebra.of S.Stage S.map i x : S.Raw) : S.Completed)
  exact congrArg (fun z : S.Raw => (z : S.Completed))
    (_root_.DirectLimit.NonUnitalAlgebra.of_f (G := S.Stage) (f := S.map) hij x)

/-- The completed algebra is the closure of its actual coefficient images. -/
theorem dense_union_range (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I) :
    Dense (⋃ i, Set.range (S.of i)) := by
  have hset : (⋃ i, Set.range (S.of i)) =
      Set.range (fun z : S.Raw => (z : S.Completed)) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hi
      exact ⟨S.rawOf i x, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      refine _root_.DirectLimit.induction (f := S.map) (fun i a => ?_) x
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [hset]
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.denseRange_coe

section Universal

-- Keep raw linear maps on the topology of their constructed norm uniformity.
attribute [local instance 2000] UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace

variable (S : IsometricSystem.{uI, uA} I)
  {C : Type uC} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
  (g : ∀ i, S.Stage i →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
  (hg : ∀ {i j : I} (hij : i ≤ j), (g j).comp (S.map i j hij) = g i)

/-- The algebraic universal map, before taking the ordinary completion. -/
def rawLift : S.Raw →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C where
  toNonUnitalAlgHom := _root_.DirectLimit.NonUnitalAlgebra.lift S.Stage S.map C
    (fun i => (g i).toNonUnitalAlgHom)
    (fun i j hij x => DFunLike.congr_fun (hg hij) x)
  map_star' x := by
    refine _root_.DirectLimit.induction (f := S.map) (fun i a => ?_) x
    rw [_root_.DirectLimit.star_def]
    change g i (star a) = star (g i a)
    exact map_star (g i) a

@[simp]
theorem rawLift_rawOf (i : I) (x : S.Stage i) : S.rawLift g hg (S.rawOf i x) = g i x :=
  rfl

/-- The algebraic universal map has the same contraction bound as the
original C-star stage maps. -/
theorem norm_rawLift_le (x : S.Raw) : ‖S.rawLift g hg x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  refine _root_.DirectLimit.induction (f := S.map) (fun i a => ?_) x
  change ‖g i a‖ ≤ ‖(⟦⟨i, a⟩⟧ : S.Raw)‖
  rw [_root_.DirectLimit.normedAddCommGroupOfNormPreserving_norm_mk S.map S.norm_map]
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le (g i) a

/-- The canonical contractive raw limit map as a continuous linear map in its norm topology. -/
def rawLiftCLM : S.Raw →L[ℂ] C :=
  (LinearMap.ofClass (S.rawLift g hg)).mkContinuous 1 fun x => by
    simpa only [one_mul, LinearMap.coe_ofClass] using S.norm_rawLift_le g hg x

/-- Extend the actual contractive universal map to the ordinary completion. -/
def lift : S.Completed →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C := by
  let L := rawLiftCLM S g hg
  let F : S.Completed → C := UniformSpace.Completion.extension L
  have hF : Continuous F := UniformSpace.Completion.continuous_extension
  have hcoe (a : S.Raw) : F (a : S.Completed) = S.rawLift g hg a := by
    exact UniformSpace.Completion.extension_coe L.uniformContinuous a
  exact
    { toFun := F
      map_zero' := by
        rw [← UniformSpace.Completion.coe_zero, hcoe, map_zero]
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on₂ x y
          (isClosed_eq (hF.comp (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd))
            ((hF.comp continuous_fst).add (hF.comp continuous_snd))) ?_
        intro a b
        rw [← UniformSpace.Completion.coe_add, hcoe, hcoe, hcoe, map_add]
      map_mul' := by
        intro x y
        refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on₂ x y
          (isClosed_eq (hF.comp (continuous_fst.mul continuous_snd))
            ((hF.comp continuous_fst).mul (hF.comp continuous_snd))) ?_
        intro a b
        rw [← UniformSpace.Completion.nonUnitalCompletion_coe_mul S.Raw,
          hcoe, hcoe, hcoe, map_mul]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c x
        refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x
          (isClosed_eq (hF.comp (continuous_const_smul c)) (hF.const_smul c)) ?_
        intro a
        simp only [← UniformSpace.Completion.coe_smul, hcoe, map_smul, MonoidHom.coe_id, id]
      map_star' := by
        intro x
        refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x
          (isClosed_eq (hF.comp continuous_star) (continuous_star.comp hF)) ?_
        intro a
        rw [CStarAlgebra.completionNonUnitalCStarAlgebra_star_coe S.Raw,
          hcoe, hcoe, map_star] }

@[simp]
theorem lift_coe (a : S.Raw) : S.lift g hg (a : S.Completed) = S.rawLift g hg a := by
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.extension_coe (rawLiftCLM S g hg).uniformContinuous a

/-- The extension has exactly the prescribed stage values. -/
@[simp]
theorem lift_of (i : I) (x : S.Stage i) : S.lift g hg (S.of i x) = g i x := by
  change S.lift g hg (S.rawOf i x : S.Completed) = g i x
  rw [S.lift_coe g hg, S.rawLift_rawOf g hg]

/-- Compatible stage values determine the completed map uniquely. -/
theorem lift_unique (H : S.Completed →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (hH : ∀ i, H.comp (S.of i) = g i) : H = S.lift g hg := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro x
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x
    (isClosed_eq (map_continuous H) (map_continuous (S.lift g hg))) ?_
  intro a
  refine _root_.DirectLimit.induction (f := S.map) (fun i z => ?_) a
  change H (S.of i z) = S.lift g hg (S.of i z)
  calc
    H (S.of i z) = g i z := by
      simpa only [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply] using DFunLike.congr_fun (hH i) z
    _ = S.lift g hg (S.of i z) := (S.lift_of g hg i z).symm

include hg in
/-- The actual completed carrier satisfies the C-star universal property. -/
theorem universal : ∃! H : S.Completed →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C, ∀ i, H.comp (S.of i) = g i := by
  refine ⟨S.lift g hg, ?_, fun H hH => S.lift_unique g hg H hH⟩
  intro i
  ext x
  exact S.lift_of g hg i x

/-- A map preserving every original stage norm preserves the completed norm. -/
theorem norm_lift_of_norm_preserving
    (hgnorm : ∀ i (x : S.Stage i), ‖g i x‖ = ‖x‖) (x : S.Completed) :
    ‖S.lift g hg x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x
    (isClosed_eq (map_continuous (S.lift g hg)).norm continuous_norm) ?_
  intro a
  refine _root_.DirectLimit.induction (f := S.map) (fun i z => ?_) a
  change ‖S.lift g hg (S.of i z)‖ = ‖S.of i z‖
  rw [S.lift_of g hg, S.norm_of]
  exact hgnorm i z

/-- No original stage norm is lost by the extended universal map. -/
theorem lift_injective_of_norm_preserving
    (hgnorm : ∀ i (x : S.Stage i), ‖g i x‖ = ‖x‖) :
    Function.Injective (S.lift g hg) := by
  intro x y hxy
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply norm_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← S.norm_lift_of_norm_preserving g hg hgnorm (x - y),
    map_sub, hxy, sub_self, norm_zero]

/-- An injective completed map whose original coefficient images are dense
is onto the fixed original target algebra. -/
theorem lift_surjective_of_dense_range
    (hinj : Function.Injective (S.lift g hg))
    (hdense : Dense (⋃ i, Set.range (g i))) : Function.Surjective (S.lift g hg) := by
  have hclosed : IsClosed (Set.range (S.lift g hg)) :=
    (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.isometry (S.lift g hg) hinj).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
  have hsubset : (⋃ i, Set.range (g i)) ⊆ Set.range (S.lift g hg) := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp ha
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hi
    exact ⟨S.of i x, S.lift_of g hg i x⟩
  have hrange : Set.range (S.lift g hg) = Set.univ := by
    rw [← hclosed.closure_eq]
    exact (hdense.mono hsubset).closure_eq
  exact Set.range_eq_univ.mp hrange

end Universal

end IsometricSystem

end CStarAlgebra.DirectLimit

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Functoriality
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.BusbyRelations
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.UnitaryStarAlgAut

/-!
# Exact asymptotic lifts through the multiplier quotient

Manuilov--Thomsen, The Connes--Higson construction is an isomorphism,
arXiv:math/0004181v3, §2, calls a Busby map asymptotically split when it has
an asymptotic morphism into the actual multiplier algebra with the exact
quotient identity at every time in [1,∞).

Individual slices remain arbitrary nonlinear functions. No finite-time
linearity, coefficient continuity, stable sum, extension group or inverse
construction is imposed. Ordinary split maps give constant examples; the
existing ordinary `IsTrivial` relation is preserved.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
open scoped CStarAlgebra MultiplierAlgebra

noncomputable section
namespace CStarExtension

universe uA uB uC
variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
attribute [local instance] CStarExtension.outerCStarAlgebra

/-- An actual nonlinear asymptotic family lifting the fixed Busby map exactly
at every time, including the initial time one. -/
structure ExactAsymptoticLift (tau : BusbyHom A B) where
  /-- The existing arbitrary-slice family with its genuine time topology and defects. -/
  family : AsymptoticMorphism A 𝓜(ℂ, B)
  /-- The identity is exact for every coefficient at every time, rather than a norm limit. -/
  quotient_eq : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A), outerQuotientMap (family t a) = tau a

/-- The source asymptotically split property, separate from an ordinary hom lift. -/
def IsAsymptoticallySplit (tau : BusbyHom A B) : Prop := Nonempty (ExactAsymptoticLift tau)

/-- The defining source quantifiers, with the actual multiplier quotient. -/
theorem isAsymptoticallySplit_iff (tau : BusbyHom A B) :
    IsAsymptoticallySplit tau ↔ ∃ phi : AsymptoticMorphism A 𝓜(ℂ, B),
      ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A), outerQuotientMap (phi t a) = tau a := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L⟩
    exact ⟨L.family, L.quotient_eq⟩
  · rintro ⟨phi, hphi⟩
    exact ⟨⟨phi, hphi⟩⟩

namespace ExactAsymptoticLift

/-- The family determines a lift; its remaining field is a proof. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {tau : BusbyHom A B} {L K : ExactAsymptoticLift tau}
    (h : L.family = K.family) : L = K := by
  cases L
  cases K
  cases h
  rfl

/-- A genuine multiplier-valued homomorphism gives its constant exact lift. -/
def ofHom (rho : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] 𝓜(ℂ, B)) :
    ExactAsymptoticLift ((outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp rho) where
  family := AsymptoticMorphism.ofHom rho
  quotient_eq _ _ := rfl

/-- The literal zero family lifts the zero Busby homomorphism. -/
def zero : ExactAsymptoticLift (0 : BusbyHom A B) where
  family := AsymptoticMorphism.zero
  quotient_eq t a := by simp

/-- Pullback by a true coefficient homomorphism preserves every exact time identity. -/
def precomp {tau : BusbyHom A B} (L : ExactAsymptoticLift tau) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    ExactAsymptoticLift (tau.comp f) where
  family := AsymptoticMorphism.precomp L.family f
  quotient_eq t a := L.quotient_eq t (f a)

/-- Continuous cofinal changes of the genuine half-line time preserve exactness. -/
def reparam {tau : BusbyHom A B} (L : ExactAsymptoticLift tau)
    (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime) (hr : Continuous r)
    (hrTop : Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) : ExactAsymptoticLift tau where
  family := AsymptoticMorphism.reparam L.family r hr hrTop
  quotient_eq t a := L.quotient_eq (r t) a

/-- Canonical multiplier and corona transport through a coefficient equivalence. -/
def coefficientEquiv {tau : BusbyHom A B} (L : ExactAsymptoticLift tau) (e : B ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] C) :
    ExactAsymptoticLift ((DoubleCentralizer.outerCongr e).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp tau) where
  family := AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp L.family (DoubleCentralizer.congr e).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
  quotient_eq t a := by
    change outerQuotientMap (DoubleCentralizer.congr e (L.family t a)) =
      DoubleCentralizer.outerCongr e (tau a)
    rw [← DoubleCentralizer.outerCongr_outerQuotientMap, L.quotient_eq]

end ExactAsymptoticLift

/-- Every ordinary split lift is an example of an asymptotic splitting. -/
theorem IsTrivial.isAsymptoticallySplit {tau : BusbyHom A B} (h : IsTrivial tau) :
    IsAsymptoticallySplit tau := by
  obtain ⟨rho, hrho⟩ := h
  rw [← hrho]
  exact ⟨ExactAsymptoticLift.ofHom rho⟩

/-- The zero extension has the exact zero asymptotic lift. -/
theorem zero_isAsymptoticallySplit : IsAsymptoticallySplit (0 : BusbyHom A B) :=
  ⟨ExactAsymptoticLift.zero⟩

/-- Conjugating by an actual multiplier unitary preserves the exact lift.
The family is postcomposed only by the genuine inner star automorphism. -/
theorem StronglyUnitaryEquivalent.isAsymptoticallySplit
    {tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B} (h : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent tau₁ tau₂)
    (h₁ : IsAsymptoticallySplit tau₁) : IsAsymptoticallySplit tau₂ := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨L⟩ := h₁
  refine ⟨{
    family := AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp L.family
      (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (𝓜(ℂ, B)) u).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    quotient_eq := ?_ }⟩
  intro t a
  change outerQuotientMap ((u : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) * L.family t a * star (u : 𝓜(ℂ, B))) = tau₂ a
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_star, L.quotient_eq]
  exact (hu a).symm

/-- Strong multiplier-unitary equivalence preserves the source splitting property in both directions. -/
theorem isAsymptoticallySplit_iff_of_stronglyUnitaryEquivalent
    {tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B} (h : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent tau₁ tau₂) :
    IsAsymptoticallySplit tau₁ ↔ IsAsymptoticallySplit tau₂ :=
  ⟨h.isAsymptoticallySplit, (strongly_unitary_equivalent_symm h).isAsymptoticallySplit⟩

end CStarExtension

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.Basic
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.BusbyDefs
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Multiplier.Outer
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Pullback

/-!
# Busby invariants of C-star extensions

For a concrete extension of `A` by `B`, the middle algebra acts on its
distinguished ideal and therefore maps canonically into the multiplier
algebra of `B`.  Passing to the quotient gives the Busby invariant
`A → Q(B)`.  Conversely, a homomorphism `A → Q(B)` defines a concrete
extension by the literal pullback along `M(B) → Q(B)`.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open Set
open scoped CStarAlgebra MultiplierAlgebra

namespace CStarExtension

universe uA uB uE

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

attribute [local instance] CStarExtension.outerCStarAlgebra

/-- The canonical action of the middle algebra on the distinguished ideal,
viewed as a multiplier of the coefficient algebra. -/
noncomputable def multiplierMap
    (X : CStarExtension.{uA, uB, uE} A B) :
    X.Middle →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] 𝓜(ℂ, B) :=
  DoubleCentralizer.multiplierExtension X.ideal X.idealEquiv

/-- The multiplier action restricts to the canonical coefficient embedding
on the distinguished ideal. -/
theorem multiplierMap_inclusion
    (X : CStarExtension.{uA, uB, uE} A B) (b : B) :
    X.multiplierMap (X.inclusion b) =
      DoubleCentralizer.coeHom (𝕜 := ℂ) b := by
  change DoubleCentralizer.multiplierExtension X.ideal X.idealEquiv
      (X.idealEquiv b : X.Middle) =
    DoubleCentralizer.coeHom (𝕜 := ℂ) b
  exact DoubleCentralizer.multiplierExtension_idealEquiv
    X.ideal X.idealEquiv b

/-- The canonical multiplier action on literal ideal representatives. -/
@[simp]
theorem multiplierMap_idealEquiv_coe
    (X : CStarExtension.{uA, uB, uE} A B) (b : B) :
    X.multiplierMap (X.idealEquiv b : X.Middle) =
      DoubleCentralizer.coeHom (𝕜 := ℂ) b := by
  exact X.multiplierMap_inclusion b

/-- The quotient of the canonical multiplier action vanishes on the
distinguished ideal. -/
theorem outerQuotient_multiplierMap_eq_zero
    (X : CStarExtension.{uA, uB, uE} A B)
    (e : X.Middle) (he : e ∈ X.ideal) :
    outerQuotientMap (X.multiplierMap e) = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := X.idealEquiv.surjective ⟨e, he⟩
  have heq : X.inclusion b = e := congrArg Subtype.val hb
  rw [← heq, multiplierMap_inclusion, outerQuotientMap_coe]

/-- The Busby invariant of a concrete extension. -/
noncomputable def busby
    (X : CStarExtension.{uA, uB, uE} A B) :
    BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B) := by
  let _ : X.ideal.carrier.IsTwoSided := X.ideal.isTwoSided
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra X.ideal.Quotient :=
    X.ideal.quotientCStarAlgebra
  let rho : X.Middle →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] OuterMultiplier B :=
    (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp X.multiplierMap
  let descended : X.ideal.Quotient →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] OuterMultiplier B :=
    NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.lift X.ideal.carrier rho
      fun e he ↦ outerQuotient_multiplierMap_eq_zero X e he
  exact descended.comp X.quotientEquiv.symm.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom

/-- The Busby invariant is characterized by the quotient of the canonical
multiplier action. -/
theorem busby_quotient
    (X : CStarExtension.{uA, uB, uE} A B) (e : X.Middle) :
    X.busby (X.quotient e) =
      outerQuotientMap (X.multiplierMap e) := by
  let _ : X.ideal.carrier.IsTwoSided := X.ideal.isTwoSided
  let _ : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra X.ideal.Quotient :=
    X.ideal.quotientCStarAlgebra
  change (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.lift X.ideal.carrier
      ((outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp
        X.multiplierMap)
      (fun e he ↦ outerQuotient_multiplierMap_eq_zero X e he))
      (X.quotientEquiv.symm (X.quotientEquiv
        (X.ideal.quotientMap e))) = _
  rw [X.quotientEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

/-- The Busby formula on literal quotient representatives. -/
@[simp]
theorem busby_quotientEquiv_mk
    (X : CStarExtension.{uA, uB, uE} A B) (e : X.Middle) :
    X.busby (X.quotientEquiv (Submodule.Quotient.mk e)) =
      outerQuotientMap (X.multiplierMap e) := by
  exact X.busby_quotient e

/-- A Busby map belongs to an extension when it has the characteristic
quotient formula. -/
def IsBusbyInvariant
    (X : CStarExtension.{uA, uB, uE} A B)
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) : Prop :=
  ∀ e : X.Middle,
    τ (X.quotient e) = outerQuotientMap (X.multiplierMap e)

/-- The canonical Busby invariant satisfies its characteristic formula. -/
theorem busby_isBusbyInvariant
    (X : CStarExtension.{uA, uB, uE} A B) :
    IsBusbyInvariant X X.busby :=
  X.busby_quotient

/-- The characteristic quotient formula uniquely determines the Busby
invariant. -/
theorem busby_unique
    (X : CStarExtension.{uA, uB, uE} A B)
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B))
    (hτ : IsBusbyInvariant X τ) :
    τ = X.busby := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := X.quotient_surjective a
  rw [hτ, busby_quotient]

/-! ## Pullback construction -/

/-- The literal pullback algebra associated to a Busby map. -/
abbrev BusbyPullback (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) :=
  NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback τ
    (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom

/-- The coefficient inclusion into the Busby pullback. -/
noncomputable def pullbackInclusion
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) :
    B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] BusbyPullback τ := by
  let π := (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
  let zero : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A := 0
  have h : τ.comp zero = π.comp
      (DoubleCentralizer.coeHom (𝕜 := ℂ) (A := B)) := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro b
    change τ 0 = outerQuotientMap
      (DoubleCentralizer.coeHom (𝕜 := ℂ) b)
    rw [map_zero, outerQuotientMap_coe]
  exact NonUnitalCStarPullback.lift τ π zero
    (DoubleCentralizer.coeHom (𝕜 := ℂ) (A := B)) h

/-- The quotient projection from the Busby pullback. -/
noncomputable def pullbackQuotient
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) :
    BusbyPullback τ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A :=
  NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom τ
    (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom

@[simp]
theorem pullbackInclusion_fst
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) (b : B) :
    NonUnitalCStarPullback.fst τ
        (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
        (pullbackInclusion τ b) = 0 :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem pullbackInclusion_snd
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) (b : B) :
    NonUnitalCStarPullback.snd τ
        (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
        (pullbackInclusion τ b) =
      DoubleCentralizer.coeHom (𝕜 := ℂ) b :=
  rfl

theorem pullbackInclusion_injective
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) :
    Function.Injective (pullbackInclusion τ) := by
  intro b c hbc
  apply DoubleCentralizer.coeHom_injective
  exact congrArg
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.snd τ
      (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) hbc

theorem pullbackQuotient_surjective
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) :
    Function.Surjective (pullbackQuotient τ) := by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := outerQuotientMap_surjective (τ a)
  exact ⟨NonUnitalCStarPullback.mk τ
      (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
      a T hT.symm, rfl⟩

theorem pullback_exact
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) :
    Function.Exact (pullbackInclusion τ) (pullbackQuotient τ) := by
  intro p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hcondition := NonUnitalCStarPullback.condition τ
      (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom p
    have hπ : outerQuotientMap
        (NonUnitalCStarPullback.snd τ
          (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom p) = 0 := by
      calc
        outerQuotientMap
            (NonUnitalCStarPullback.snd τ
              (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom p) =
          τ (pullbackQuotient τ p) := hcondition.symm
        _ = 0 := by rw [hp, map_zero]
    have hmem := (outerQuotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).1 hπ
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ :=
      (DoubleCentralizer.mem_coefficientIdeal_iff _).1 hmem
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    apply NonUnitalCStarPullback.ext τ
      (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    · change (0 : A) = pullbackQuotient τ p
      exact hp.symm
    · exact hb
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
    rfl

/-- The concrete extension defined by a Busby map. -/
noncomputable def ofBusby
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) :
    CStarExtension A B :=
  CStarExtension.ofExact
    (pullbackInclusion τ) (pullbackQuotient τ)
    (pullbackInclusion_injective τ)
    (pullbackQuotient_surjective τ)
    (pullback_exact τ)

theorem ofBusby_inclusion
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) (b : B) :
    (ofBusby τ).inclusion b = pullbackInclusion τ b :=
  CStarExtension.ofExact_inclusion_apply _ _ _ _ _ b

/-- The ideal-equivalence inclusion of the literal Busby pullback. -/
@[simp]
theorem ofBusby_idealEquiv_coe
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) (b : B) :
    ((ofBusby τ).idealEquiv b : (ofBusby τ).Middle) =
      pullbackInclusion τ b := by
  exact ofBusby_inclusion τ b

@[simp]
theorem ofBusby_quotient
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) (p : BusbyPullback τ) :
    (ofBusby τ).quotient p = pullbackQuotient τ p :=
  CStarExtension.ofExact_quotient_apply _ _ _ _ _ p

/-- The Busby invariant of the pullback extension is the original map:
`ofBusby` is the converse of `busby`. -/
theorem ofBusby_busby
    (τ : BusbyMap (A := A) (B := B)) :
    (ofBusby τ).busby = τ := by
  have hM : ∀ p : BusbyPullback τ,
      (ofBusby τ).multiplierMap p =
        NonUnitalCStarPullback.snd τ
          (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom p := by
    intro p
    have h1 := DoubleCentralizer.multiplierExtension_fst
      (ofBusby τ).ideal (ofBusby τ).idealEquiv p
    have h2 := DoubleCentralizer.multiplierExtension_snd
      (ofBusby τ).ideal (ofBusby τ).idealEquiv p
    apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ B
    apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext <;> intro a
    · apply DoubleCentralizer.coeHom_injective
      have h1' : pullbackInclusion τ (((ofBusby τ).multiplierMap p).fst a) =
          p * pullbackInclusion τ a := h1 a
      have hcongr := congrArg (NonUnitalCStarPullback.snd τ
        (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) h1'
      rw [pullbackInclusion_snd] at hcongr
      have hmul := map_mul (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom τ
        (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom)
        p (pullbackInclusion τ a)
      simp only [NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom_apply,
        pullbackInclusion_snd] at hmul
      rw [hmul] at hcongr
      rw [hcongr]
      exact DoubleCentralizer.mul_coe _ _
    · apply DoubleCentralizer.coeHom_injective
      have h2' : pullbackInclusion τ (((ofBusby τ).multiplierMap p).snd a) =
          pullbackInclusion τ a * p := h2 a
      have hcongr := congrArg (NonUnitalCStarPullback.snd τ
        (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) h2'
      rw [pullbackInclusion_snd] at hcongr
      have hmul := map_mul (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom τ
        (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom)
        (pullbackInclusion τ a) p
      simp only [NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom_apply,
        pullbackInclusion_snd] at hmul
      rw [hmul] at hcongr
      rw [hcongr]
      exact DoubleCentralizer.coe_mul _ _
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := (ofBusby τ).quotient_surjective a
  rw [busby_quotient _ p, hM p, ofBusby_quotient τ p]
  exact (NonUnitalCStarPullback.condition τ _ p).symm

end CStarExtension

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.UnitaryHomClasses
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CStarMatrix.DiagonalPair
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CStarMatrix

/-!
# Literal diagonal lifts of multiplier-quotient homomorphisms

Entrywise matrix maps commute with the actual algebraic diagonal pairing.
Two real multiplier-valued lifts therefore give a real diagonal matrix lift;
no source fold or quotient class operation is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra Matrix MultiplierAlgebra

universe uC uM uQ uP

namespace NonUnitalStarAlgHom

variable {C : Type uC} {M : Type uM} {Q : Type uQ}
variable [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C] [DistribMulAction ℂ C] [Star C]
variable [Semiring M] [StarRing M] [Algebra ℂ M]
variable [Semiring Q] [StarRing Q] [Algebra ℂ Q]

/-- Actual entrywise projection commutes with the literal two-hom diagonal pairing. -/
theorem map_diagonalPair (q : M →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] Q) (rho₀ rho₁ : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] M) :
    (CStarMatrix.mapₙₐ (n := Fin 2) q).comp (diagonalPair rho₀ rho₁) =
      diagonalPair (q.comp rho₀) (q.comp rho₁) := by
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  change q (diagonalPair rho₀ rho₁ a i j) =
    diagonalPair (q.comp rho₀) (q.comp rho₁) a i j
  rw [diagonalPair_apply, diagonalPair_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [ite_true]
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · simp only [ite_eq_left hi, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]
    · simp only [ite_eq_right hi, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]
  · simp only [ite_eq_right hij, map_zero]

end NonUnitalStarAlgHom

namespace CStarExtension

variable {C : Type uC} {P : Type uP}
variable [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C] [DistribMulAction ℂ C] [StarAddMonoid C]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra P]

attribute [local instance] CStarExtension.outerCStarAlgebra

/-- Literal multiplier lifts of two Busby maps give their literal diagonal matrix lift.
The matrix projection is the actual map induced by the outer quotient. -/
theorem diagonalPair_hasLift
    {tau₀ tau₁ : BusbyHom C P} (h₀ : IsTrivial tau₀) (h₁ : IsTrivial tau₁) :
    ∃ rhoPair : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (DoubleCentralizer ℂ P),
      (CStarMatrix.mapₙₐ (n := Fin 2)
        (outerQuotientMap (A := P)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom).comp rhoPair =
        NonUnitalStarAlgHom.diagonalPair tau₀ tau₁ := by
  let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier P) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra P
  obtain ⟨rho₀, hrho₀⟩ := h₀
  obtain ⟨rho₁, hrho₁⟩ := h₁
  refine ⟨NonUnitalStarAlgHom.diagonalPair rho₀ rho₁, ?_⟩
  rw [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.map_diagonalPair, hrho₀, hrho₁]

end CStarExtension

Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.Busby

/-!
# Literal precomposition of normalized Busby extensions

Precomposition produces an actual Busby map and its normalized closed pullback.
The comparison to the original normalized Busby pullback is the literal pair
map `(a,T) ↦ (f a,T)`. Its ideal and quotient squares are derived, not supplied.
There is no operation on stable extension classes or arbitrary extension model.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra MultiplierAlgebra

namespace CStarExtension

universe uA₁ uA₂ uB

variable {A₁ : Type uA₁} {A₂ : Type uA₂} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A₁] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A₂]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
attribute [local instance] outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra

variable (f : A₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A₂) (τ : BusbyMap (A := A₂) (B := B))

/-- Normalize the literal precomposed Busby invariant. -/
def pullback : CStarExtension.{uA₁, uB, max uA₁ uB} A₁ B :=
  ofBusby (τ.comp f)

@[simp]
theorem pullback_busby : (pullback f τ).busby = τ.comp f :=
  ofBusby_busby (τ.comp f)

/-- The middle algebra is exactly the closed pullback of the precomposed map. -/
theorem pullback_middle :
    (pullback f τ).Middle = (BusbyPullback (τ.comp f) : Type (max uA₁ uB)) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem pullback_inclusion (b : B) :
    (pullback f τ).inclusion b = pullbackInclusion (τ.comp f) b :=
  ofBusby_inclusion (τ.comp f) b

@[simp]
theorem pullback_quotient (p : BusbyPullback (τ.comp f)) :
    (pullback f τ).quotient p = pullbackQuotient (τ.comp f) p :=
  ofBusby_quotient (τ.comp f) p

/-- The literal middle-algebra comparison applies `f` only to the first coordinate. -/
def pullbackMiddleMap : BusbyPullback (τ.comp f) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] BusbyPullback τ := by
  apply NonUnitalCStarPullback.lift τ
    (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    (f.comp (pullbackQuotient (τ.comp f)))
    (NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (τ.comp f)
      (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom)
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro p
  exact NonUnitalCStarPullback.condition (τ.comp f)
    (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom p

@[simp]
theorem pullbackMiddleMap_fst (p : BusbyPullback (τ.comp f)) :
    NonUnitalCStarPullback.fst τ
        (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom (pullbackMiddleMap f τ p) =
      f (pullbackQuotient (τ.comp f) p) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem pullbackMiddleMap_snd (p : BusbyPullback (τ.comp f)) :
    NonUnitalCStarPullback.snd τ
        (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom (pullbackMiddleMap f τ p) =
      NonUnitalCStarPullback.snd (τ.comp f)
        (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom p := rfl

/-- The actual pair formula, including the unchanged multiplier coordinate. -/
theorem pullbackMiddleMap_coe (p : BusbyPullback (τ.comp f)) :
    ((pullbackMiddleMap f τ p : BusbyPullback τ) : A₂ × 𝓜(ℂ, B)) =
      (f p.1.1, p.1.2) := rfl

theorem pullbackMiddleMap_inclusion (b : B) :
    pullbackMiddleMap f τ ((pullback f τ).inclusion b) = (ofBusby τ).inclusion b := by
  rw [pullback_inclusion, ofBusby_inclusion]
  apply NonUnitalCStarPullback.ext τ
    (outerQuotientMap (A := B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
  · rw [pullbackMiddleMap_fst, pullbackInclusion_fst]
    change f 0 = 0
    exact map_zero f
  · rw [pullbackMiddleMap_snd, pullbackInclusion_snd, pullbackInclusion_snd]

theorem pullbackMiddleMap_quotient (p : BusbyPullback (τ.comp f)) :
    (ofBusby τ).quotient (pullbackMiddleMap f τ p) = f ((pullback f τ).quotient p) := by
  rw [ofBusby_quotient, pullback_quotient]
  exact pullbackMiddleMap_fst f τ p

/-- The pair comparison is a normalized extension morphism with identity ideal map. -/
def pullbackHom : Hom (pullback f τ) (ofBusby τ) where
  idealMap := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B
  middleMap := pullbackMiddleMap f τ
  quotientMap := f
  inclusion_commutes := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro b
    exact pullbackMiddleMap_inclusion f τ b
  quotient_commutes := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro p
    exact pullbackMiddleMap_quotient f τ p

@[simp]
theorem pullbackHom_idealMap : (pullbackHom f τ).idealMap = NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B := rfl

@[simp]
theorem pullbackHom_middleMap : (pullbackHom f τ).middleMap = pullbackMiddleMap f τ := rfl

@[simp]
theorem pullbackHom_quotientMap : (pullbackHom f τ).quotientMap = f := rfl

end CStarExtension

Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.Basic
public import Mathlib.Topology.Bases

import MathlibExt.Topology.Maps.Separable
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Spectrum
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Banach

/-!
# Separability of actual C-star quotients and extensions

The quotient uses the existing canonical normed-module quotient. For an
extension, the actual quotient is open by Banach open mapping and its
kernel is the continuous image of the actual ideal coefficient. No
splitting, nuclearity, or separable-middle result field is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

open TopologicalSpace
open scoped CStarAlgebra

universe uA uB uM

namespace ClosedStarIdeal

/-- The actual quotient of a separable C-star algebra by a closed star ideal
is separable, with the existing scoped quotient dictionary. -/
theorem separable_quotient {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [SeparableSpace A]
    (I : ClosedStarIdeal A) :
    letI : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.quotientCStarAlgebra;
    SeparableSpace I.Quotient := by
  let : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact I.quotientMap_surjective.denseRange.separableSpace (map_continuous I.quotientMap)

end ClosedStarIdeal

namespace CStarExtension

/-- In a genuine normalized extension, separable endpoints imply that its
actual middle algebra is separable. There is no section hypothesis. -/
theorem separable_middle {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [SeparableSpace A] [SeparableSpace B]
    (X : CStarExtension.{uA, uB, uM} A B) : SeparableSpace X.Middle := by
  let qAdd : X.Middle →+ A :=
    { toFun := X.quotient
      map_zero' := map_zero X.quotient
      map_add' := map_add X.quotient }
  let qL : X.Middle →L[ℂ] A :=
    { toLinearMap := LinearMap.ofClass X.quotient
      cont := map_continuous X.quotient }
  have hOpen : IsOpenMap qAdd := qL.isOpenMap X.quotient_surjective
  let j : B → qAdd.ker := fun b ↦
    ⟨X.inclusion b, (AddMonoidHom.mem_ker).2 (X.exact.apply_apply_eq_zero b)⟩
  have hjContinuous : Continuous j := (map_continuous X.inclusion).subtype_mk _
  have hjSurjective : Function.Surjective j := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (X.exact z.val).1 ((AddMonoidHom.mem_ker).1 z.property)
    exact ⟨b, Subtype.ext hb⟩
  let : SeparableSpace qAdd.ker :=
    hjSurjective.denseRange.separableSpace hjContinuous
  exact IsOpenMap.separableSpace_of_separable_ker qAdd hOpen

end CStarExtension

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.StableSum.Equivalence

/-!
# The parameterized stable extension-class commutative monoid

For supplied stable-sum data with an actual assoc/comm coherence proof,
stable strong equivalence gives an actual quotient. The literal
sum descends to that quotient and the class of the zero Busby map is its
identity. The unit laws are stable-relation witnesses with extra trivial
summands; no representative-level strong unit law is used.

The weak algebraic source requires no norm, topology, unit or completeness.
The coefficient retains the genuine C-star multiplier/quotient structures.
This is a conditional quotient attached to `S` and `hS`, not source `Ext(A,B)`:
that identification still needs the standard
stabilization construction and its assoc/comm theorem.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra Matrix MultiplierAlgebra

namespace CStarExtension

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] [DistribMulAction ℂ A] [StarAddMonoid A]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- The literal stable strong relation, with its actual strict equivalence proof. -/
def StableSumData.setoid (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent) :
    Setoid (BusbyHom A B) where
  r := StablyStrongEquivalent S
  iseqv := by exact stably_strong_equivalent_equivalence S hS

/-- Busby-homomorphism classes for the supplied coherent sum, not source-canonical Ext. -/
abbrev StableClass (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent) :=
  Quotient (S.setoid hS)

/-- Strong unitary equivalence gives stable strong equivalence by adding the
same zero trivial summand on both sides. -/
theorem StableSumData.stably_strong_equivalent_of_strong
    (S : StableSumData A B)
    {tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B}
    (h : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent tau₁ tau₂) :
    StablyStrongEquivalent S tau₁ tau₂ := by
  refine ⟨0, 0, zero_is_trivial, zero_is_trivial, ?_⟩
  exact S.sum_congr_strong h
    (strongly_unitary_equivalent_refl
      (0 : BusbyHom A B))

/-- Assoc/comm coherence interchanges the two middle summands. -/
theorem StableSumData.sum_interchange_strong
    (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent)
    (tau₁ tau₂ sigma₁ sigma₂ :
      BusbyHom A B) :
    StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) (S.sum sigma₁ sigma₂))
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₁ sigma₁) (S.sum tau₂ sigma₂)) := by
  have h₀ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) (S.sum sigma₁ sigma₂))
      (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum tau₂ (S.sum sigma₁ sigma₂))) :=
    hS.1 tau₁ tau₂ (S.sum sigma₁ sigma₂)
  have h₁ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum tau₂ (S.sum sigma₁ sigma₂)))
      (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum (S.sum tau₂ sigma₁) sigma₂)) :=
    S.sum_congr_strong (strongly_unitary_equivalent_refl tau₁)
      (strongly_unitary_equivalent_symm (hS.1 tau₂ sigma₁ sigma₂))
  have h₂ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum (S.sum tau₂ sigma₁) sigma₂))
      (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum (S.sum sigma₁ tau₂) sigma₂)) :=
    S.sum_congr_strong (strongly_unitary_equivalent_refl tau₁)
      (S.sum_congr_strong (hS.2 tau₂ sigma₁)
        (strongly_unitary_equivalent_refl sigma₂))
  have h₃ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum (S.sum sigma₁ tau₂) sigma₂))
      (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum sigma₁ (S.sum tau₂ sigma₂))) :=
    S.sum_congr_strong (strongly_unitary_equivalent_refl tau₁)
      (hS.1 sigma₁ tau₂ sigma₂)
  have h₄ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum sigma₁ (S.sum tau₂ sigma₂)))
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₁ sigma₁) (S.sum tau₂ sigma₂)) :=
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_symm
      (hS.1 tau₁ sigma₁ (S.sum tau₂ sigma₂))
  exact strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans h₀ <|
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans h₁ <|
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans h₂ <|
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans h₃ h₄

/-- Stable strong equivalence is a congruence for the supplied sum. -/
theorem StableSumData.sum_congr_stable
    (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent)
    {tau₁ tau₁' tau₂ tau₂' :
      BusbyHom A B}
    (h₁ : StablyStrongEquivalent S tau₁ tau₁')
    (h₂ : StablyStrongEquivalent S tau₂ tau₂') :
    StablyStrongEquivalent S (S.sum tau₁ tau₂)
      (S.sum tau₁' tau₂') := by
  obtain ⟨sigma₁, sigma₁', hsigma₁, hsigma₁', hcompare₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨sigma₂, sigma₂', hsigma₂, hsigma₂', hcompare₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨S.sum sigma₁ sigma₂, S.sum sigma₁' sigma₂',
    S.sum_trivial hsigma₁ hsigma₂,
    S.sum_trivial hsigma₁' hsigma₂', ?_⟩
  have hleft := S.sum_interchange_strong hS tau₁ tau₂ sigma₁ sigma₂
  have hmiddle := S.sum_congr_strong hcompare₁ hcompare₂
  have hright := strongly_unitary_equivalent_symm
    (S.sum_interchange_strong hS tau₁' tau₂' sigma₁' sigma₂')
  exact strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans hleft
    (strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans hmiddle hright)

/-- Right addition by zero is an identity only after passing to stable strong
equivalence. The right-side extra summand is `0 ⊕ 0`. -/
theorem StableSumData.sum_zero_stable
    (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent)
    (tau : BusbyHom A B) :
    StablyStrongEquivalent S (S.sum tau 0) tau := by
  refine ⟨0, S.sum 0 0, zero_is_trivial,
    S.sum_trivial zero_is_trivial zero_is_trivial, ?_⟩
  exact hS.1 tau 0 0

/-- Left addition by zero is an identity only after passing to stable strong
equivalence. It uses commutativity, congruence and associativity, not a strong
unit law. -/
theorem StableSumData.zero_sum_stable
    (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent)
    (tau : BusbyHom A B) :
    StablyStrongEquivalent S (S.sum 0 tau) tau := by
  refine ⟨0, S.sum 0 0, zero_is_trivial,
    S.sum_trivial zero_is_trivial zero_is_trivial, ?_⟩
  have hswap : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum (S.sum 0 tau) 0) (S.sum (S.sum tau 0) 0) :=
    S.sum_congr_strong (hS.2 0 tau)
      (strongly_unitary_equivalent_refl
        (0 : BusbyHom A B))
  exact strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans hswap (hS.1 tau 0 0)

/-- Every trivial Busby map represents the same stable class as zero. -/
theorem StableSumData.trivial_stably_strong_equivalent_zero
    (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent)
    {sigma : BusbyHom A B}
    (hsigma : IsTrivial sigma) :
    StablyStrongEquivalent S sigma 0 := by
  refine ⟨0, sigma, zero_is_trivial, hsigma, ?_⟩
  exact hS.2 sigma 0

namespace StableClass

/-- Place a Busby map in the conditional stable quotient. -/
def mk (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent)
    (tau : BusbyHom A B) :
    StableClass S hS :=
  Quotient.mk (S.setoid hS) tau

/-- Equality of representatives is exactly the original stable relation.
It is not literal triviality, raw strong conjugacy, or an enlarged closure. -/
theorem mk_eq_mk_iff (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent)
    (tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B) :
    mk S hS tau₁ = mk S hS tau₂ ↔ StablyStrongEquivalent S tau₁ tau₂ :=
  ⟨fun h => Quotient.exact h, fun h => Quotient.sound h⟩

/-- The class of the actual zero Busby map. -/
def zero (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent) : StableClass S hS :=
  mk S hS 0

/-- Diagonal sum descended through stable strong equivalence. -/
def add (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent) :
    StableClass S hS → StableClass S hS → StableClass S hS :=
  Quotient.lift₂
    (fun tau₁ tau₂ => mk S hS (S.sum tau₁ tau₂))
    (fun _tau₁ _tau₂ _tau₁' _tau₂' h₁ h₂ =>
      Quotient.sound (S.sum_congr_stable hS h₁ h₂))

@[simp]
theorem add_mk (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent)
    (tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B) :
    add S hS (mk S hS tau₁) (mk S hS tau₂) =
      mk S hS (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) :=
  rfl

end StableClass

/-- The parameterized stable strong quotient is a commutative additive
monoid. Its zero is the stable class of the zero Busby map. -/
noncomputable instance instStableClassAddCommMonoid
    (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent) :
    AddCommMonoid (StableClass S hS) where
  zero := StableClass.zero S hS
  add := StableClass.add S hS
  add_assoc := by
    intro x y z
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    intro tau₁
    refine Quotient.inductionOn y ?_
    intro tau₂
    refine Quotient.inductionOn z ?_
    intro tau₃
    change StableClass.mk S hS (S.sum (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) tau₃) =
      StableClass.mk S hS (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum tau₂ tau₃))
    exact Quotient.sound
      (S.stably_strong_equivalent_of_strong (hS.1 tau₁ tau₂ tau₃))
  zero_add := by
    intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    intro tau
    change StableClass.mk S hS (S.sum 0 tau) = StableClass.mk S hS tau
    exact Quotient.sound (S.zero_sum_stable hS tau)
  add_zero := by
    intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    intro tau
    change StableClass.mk S hS (S.sum tau 0) = StableClass.mk S hS tau
    exact Quotient.sound (S.sum_zero_stable hS tau)
  add_comm := by
    intro x y
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
    intro tau₁ tau₂
    change StableClass.mk S hS (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) =
      StableClass.mk S hS (S.sum tau₂ tau₁)
    exact Quotient.sound
      (S.stably_strong_equivalent_of_strong (hS.2 tau₁ tau₂))
  nsmul :=
    letI : Zero (StableClass S hS) := ⟨StableClass.zero S hS⟩
    letI : Add (StableClass S hS) := ⟨StableClass.add S hS⟩
    nsmulRec
  nsmul_zero := by intro; rfl
  nsmul_succ := by intro n x; rfl

@[simp]
theorem StableClass.mk_add_mk
    (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent)
    (tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B) :
    StableClass.mk S hS tau₁ + StableClass.mk S hS tau₂ =
      StableClass.mk S hS (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem StableClass.zero_eq_mk
    (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent) :
    (0 : StableClass S hS) = StableClass.mk S hS 0 :=
  rfl

/-- Every trivial extension has the zero class in the stable quotient. -/
theorem StableClass.mk_eq_zero_of_trivial
    (S : StableSumData A B) (hS : S.IsCoherent)
    {sigma : BusbyHom A B}
    (hsigma : IsTrivial sigma) :
    StableClass.mk S hS sigma = 0 := by
  change StableClass.mk S hS sigma = StableClass.mk S hS 0
  exact Quotient.sound
    (S.trivial_stably_strong_equivalent_zero hS hsigma)

end CStarExtension

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.AsymptoticLift
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Prod
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.StableSum.Basic
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CStarMatrix.DiagonalPair
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases

/-!
# Exact asymptotic lifts of supplied stable sums

For arbitrary compatible stable-sum data, product pairing and actual diagonal
postcomposition combine two nonlinear exact asymptotic lifts. The multiplier
matrix equivalence preserves each time-continuous orbit and all four defect
limits. Its compatibility with the actual quotient gives the exact Busby-sum
identity at every time in [1, infinity), including the initial time.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
open scoped BigOperators CStarAlgebra Matrix MultiplierAlgebra Topology
noncomputable section

namespace CStarExtension

universe uA uB
variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
attribute [local instance] CStarExtension.outerCStarAlgebra


section Lifts

variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- Sum two actual nonlinear exact lifts, by true diagonal/fold postcomposition. -/
def StableSumData.asymptoticLift (S : StableSumData A B) {tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B}
    (L₁ : ExactAsymptoticLift tau₁) (L₂ : ExactAsymptoticLift tau₂) :
    ExactAsymptoticLift (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) := by
  letI : PartialOrder 𝓜(ℂ, B) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder 𝓜(ℂ, B)
  letI : StarOrderedRing 𝓜(ℂ, B) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing 𝓜(ℂ, B)
  let diagonal : (𝓜(ℂ, B) × 𝓜(ℂ, B)) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) 𝓜(ℂ, B) :=
    (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.fst ℂ 𝓜(ℂ, B) 𝓜(ℂ, B)).diagonalPair
      (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.snd ℂ 𝓜(ℂ, B) 𝓜(ℂ, B))
  let matrixFamily : AsymptoticMorphism A (CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) 𝓜(ℂ, B)) :=
    AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp (AsymptoticMorphism.prod L₁.family L₂.family) diagonal
  let resultFamily : AsymptoticMorphism A 𝓜(ℂ, B) :=
    AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp matrixFamily S.multiplierMatrixEquiv.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
  refine ⟨resultFamily, ?_⟩
  intro t a
  change outerQuotientMap (AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp matrixFamily
    S.multiplierMatrixEquiv.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom t a) = S.sum tau₁ tau₂ a
  rw [AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp_apply]
  change outerQuotientMap (S.multiplierMatrixEquiv
    (AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp (AsymptoticMorphism.prod L₁.family L₂.family) diagonal t a)) =
      S.sum tau₁ tau₂ a
  rw [AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp_apply, AsymptoticMorphism.prod_apply,
    ← S.quotient_compatible, S.sum_apply]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp only [CStarMatrix.map_apply, diagonal, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.diagonalPair_apply,
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.fst_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.snd_apply, twoDiagonal]
  split_ifs <;> simp [L₁.quotient_eq, L₂.quotient_eq]

/-- The actual generic matrix family, before the fixed multiplier fold. -/
theorem StableSumData.asymptoticLift_apply (S : StableSumData A B)
    {tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B} (L₁ : ExactAsymptoticLift tau₁) (L₂ : ExactAsymptoticLift tau₂)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    (S.asymptoticLift L₁ L₂).family t a = S.multiplierMatrixEquiv
      (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (Matrix.diagonal ![L₁.family t a, L₂.family t a])) := by
  let : PartialOrder 𝓜(ℂ, B) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder 𝓜(ℂ, B)
  let : StarOrderedRing 𝓜(ℂ, B) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing 𝓜(ℂ, B)
  rw [StableSumData.asymptoticLift, AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp_apply,
    AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp_apply, AsymptoticMorphism.prod_apply]
  change S.multiplierMatrixEquiv
    ((NonUnitalStarAlgHom.fst ℂ 𝓜(ℂ, B) 𝓜(ℂ, B)).diagonalPair
      (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.snd ℂ 𝓜(ℂ, B) 𝓜(ℂ, B)) (L₁.family t a, L₂.family t a)) = _
  apply congrArg S.multiplierMatrixEquiv
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  simp only [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.diagonalPair_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.fst_apply,
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.snd_apply, CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> rfl

/-- Asymptotic splitting is closed under the actual compatible stable sum. -/
theorem StableSumData.sum_isAsymptoticallySplit (S : StableSumData A B)
    {tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B}
    (h₁ : IsAsymptoticallySplit tau₁) (h₂ : IsAsymptoticallySplit tau₂) :
    IsAsymptoticallySplit (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) := by
  obtain ⟨L₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨L₂⟩ := h₂
  exact ⟨S.asymptoticLift L₁ L₂⟩

end Lifts
end CStarExtension

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.BusbyRelations
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CStarMatrix

/-!
# Supplied matrix sums of Busby homomorphisms

The data consist of genuine compatible multiplier/corona matrix equivalences
and a Busby sum fixed by its literal diagonal formula. The source algebra
needs only the algebraic operations of BusbyHom; it need not be a complete,
normed or unital C-star algebra. The coefficient remains a genuine C-star
algebra for the existing multiplier and quotient APIs.

No standard stabilization, associativity, strong zero identity, quotient
class or inverse is manufactured by this carrier. Coherence and stable
relations are literal predicates, separate from their proof calculus.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra Matrix MultiplierAlgebra

namespace CStarExtension

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] [DistribMulAction ℂ A] [StarAddMonoid A]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- The literal two-by-two outer-multiplier diagonal, on the existing matrix carrier. -/
def twoDiagonal (x y : OuterMultiplier B) :
    CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (OuterMultiplier B) :=
  let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
  fun i j => if i = j then if i = 0 then x else y else 0

@[simp]
theorem twoDiagonal_zero_zero (x y : OuterMultiplier B) :
    twoDiagonal x y 0 0 = x :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem twoDiagonal_one_one (x y : OuterMultiplier B) :
    twoDiagonal x y 1 1 = y :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem twoDiagonal_zero_one (x y : OuterMultiplier B) :
    let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
    twoDiagonal x y 0 1 = 0 := by
  let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem twoDiagonal_one_zero (x y : OuterMultiplier B) :
    let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
    twoDiagonal x y 1 0 = 0 := by
  let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
  rfl

/-- Actual supplied matrix identifications and a sum constrained by its diagonal action. -/
structure StableSumData (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] [DistribMulAction ℂ A] [StarAddMonoid A]
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] where
  /-- The supplied equivalence from two-by-two multiplier matrices. -/
  multiplierMatrixEquiv :
    CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) 𝓜(ℂ, B) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] 𝓜(ℂ, B)
  /-- The compatible equivalence on outer-multiplier matrices. -/
  matrixEquiv :
    let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
    CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (OuterMultiplier B) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] OuterMultiplier B
  quotient_compatible :
    let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
    ∀ M : CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) 𝓜(ℂ, B),
      matrixEquiv (M.map outerQuotientMap) =
        outerQuotientMap (multiplierMatrixEquiv M)
  /-- The Busby-homomorphism sum with the stated diagonal evaluation rule. -/
  sum : BusbyHom A B → BusbyHom A B → BusbyHom A B
  sum_apply :
    let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
    ∀ (tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B) (a : A),
      sum tau₁ tau₂ a = matrixEquiv (twoDiagonal (tau₁ a) (tau₂ a))

/-- Sum relative to the actual supplied matrix identifications. -/
abbrev busbySum (S : StableSumData A B) := S.sum

/-- The original associativity/strong-commutativity conjunction; no strong zero law. -/
def StableSumData.IsCoherent (S : StableSumData A B) : Prop :=
  (∀ tau₁ tau₂ tau₃ : BusbyHom A B,
    StronglyUnitaryEquivalent (S.sum (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) tau₃)
      (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum tau₂ tau₃))) ∧
  (∀ tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B,
    StronglyUnitaryEquivalent (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) (S.sum tau₂ tau₁))

/-- Stable strong equivalence compares sums with two actual trivial homomorphisms. -/
def StablyStrongEquivalent (S : StableSumData A B)
    (tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B) : Prop :=
  ∃ sigma₁ sigma₂,
    IsTrivial sigma₁ ∧ IsTrivial sigma₂ ∧
      StronglyUnitaryEquivalent (S.sum tau₁ sigma₁) (S.sum tau₂ sigma₂)

/-- The literal stable weak relation, with the same actual trivial summands. -/
def StablyWeakEquivalent (S : StableSumData A B)
    (tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B) : Prop :=
  ∃ sigma₁ sigma₂,
    IsTrivial sigma₁ ∧ IsTrivial sigma₂ ∧
      WeaklyUnitaryEquivalent (S.sum tau₁ sigma₁) (S.sum tau₂ sigma₂)

end CStarExtension

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.StableSum.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ConjTranspose
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases

/-!
# Strict calculus for supplied matrix sums

The sum respects strong unitary equivalence and takes two actual multiplier
lifts to an actual lift. The unitary/lift witnesses are constructed from the
given matrix identifications; source-standard associativity is not assumed
without an explicit hypothesis. The source algebra keeps the weak BusbyHom
telescope, and all quotient structures are the existing explicit factories.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra Matrix MultiplierAlgebra

namespace CStarExtension

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] [DistribMulAction ℂ A] [StarAddMonoid A]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

section Diagonal

variable (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D]

/-- The two entries of a product as a function on `Fin 2`. -/
@[no_expose]
private def pairToFinTwoStarAlgHom : D × D →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (Fin 2 → D) where
  toFun p := ![p.1, p.2]
  map_one' := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  map_mul' p q := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  map_zero' := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  map_add' p q := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  commutes' z := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  map_star' p := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl

/-- The existing matrix diagonal algebra map, with its star law. -/
@[no_expose]
private def diagonalStarAlgHom :
    (Fin 2 → D) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) D :=
  (CStarMatrix.ofMatrixStarAlgEquiv (n := Fin 2) (A := D)).toStarAlgHom.comp
    ({ Matrix.diagonalAlgHom ℂ with
      map_star' := fun x => (Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose x).symm } :
      (Fin 2 → D) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) D)

/-- The proof-private bundled two-entry diagonal map. -/
@[no_expose]
private def pairDiagonalStarAlgHom :
    D × D →⋆ₐ[ℂ] CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) D :=
  (diagonalStarAlgHom D).comp (pairToFinTwoStarAlgHom D)

/-- The literal generic two-entry diagonal matrix. -/
@[no_expose]
private def pairDiagonal (x y : D) : CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) D :=
  pairDiagonalStarAlgHom D (x, y)

@[simp]
private theorem pairDiagonal_apply (x y : D) :
    pairDiagonal D x y = CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (Matrix.diagonal ![x, y]) := by
  dsimp only [pairDiagonal, pairDiagonalStarAlgHom, diagonalStarAlgHom,
    pairToFinTwoStarAlgHom, StarAlgHom.comp_apply]
  change CStarMatrix.ofMatrixStarAlgEquiv (Matrix.diagonal ![x, y]) =
    CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (Matrix.diagonal ![x, y])
  exact (congrFun CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_eq_ofMatrixStarAlgEquiv
    (Matrix.diagonal ![x, y])).symm

private theorem pairDiagonal_map
    {E : Type*} [CStarAlgebra E] (f : D →⋆ₐ[ℂ] E) (x y : D) :
    (pairDiagonal D x y).map f = pairDiagonal E (f x) (f y) := by
  rw [pairDiagonal_apply, pairDiagonal_apply]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [CStarMatrix.map_apply, CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_apply]

/-- The product unitary with the two prescribed components. -/
@[no_expose]
private def pairUnitary (u v : unitary D) : unitary (D × D) :=
  ⟨((u : D), (v : D)), Prod.mem_unitary_iff.2 ⟨u.property, v.property⟩⟩

/-- The actual diagonal matrix unitary. -/
@[no_expose]
private def pairDiagonalUnitary (u v : unitary D) :
    unitary (CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) D) :=
  Unitary.map (StarMonoidHom.ofClass (pairDiagonalStarAlgHom D)) (pairUnitary D u v)

@[simp]
private theorem pairDiagonalUnitary_coe (u v : unitary D) :
    (pairDiagonalUnitary D u v : CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) D) =
      pairDiagonal D (u : D) (v : D) :=
  rfl

private theorem pairDiagonal_conjugate (u v : unitary D) (x y : D) :
    (pairDiagonalUnitary D u v : CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) D) *
          pairDiagonal D x y *
          star (pairDiagonalUnitary D u v :
            CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) D) =
      pairDiagonal D ((u : D) * x * star (u : D))
        ((v : D) * y * star (v : D)) := by
  change pairDiagonalStarAlgHom D ((u : D), (v : D)) *
        pairDiagonalStarAlgHom D (x, y) *
        star (pairDiagonalStarAlgHom D ((u : D), (v : D))) =
      pairDiagonalStarAlgHom D
        (((u : D) * x * star (u : D)),
          ((v : D) * y * star (v : D)))
  rw [← map_star, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
  rfl

end Diagonal

private theorem pairDiagonal_eq_twoDiagonal (x y : OuterMultiplier B) :
    let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
    pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B) x y = twoDiagonal x y := by
  let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
  change pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B) x y = twoDiagonal x y
  rw [pairDiagonal_apply]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [twoDiagonal, CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_apply]

/-- The supplied stable sum respects strong unitary equivalence in both
variables. -/
theorem StableSumData.sum_congr_strong (S : StableSumData A B)
    {tau₁ tau₁' tau₂ tau₂' : BusbyHom A B}
    (h₁ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent tau₁ tau₁')
    (h₂ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent tau₂ tau₂') :
    StronglyUnitaryEquivalent (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) (S.sum tau₁' tau₂') := by
  let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
  obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨u₂, hu₂⟩ := h₂
  let q := outerQuotientMap (A := B)
  let qU₁ : unitary (OuterMultiplier B) := Unitary.map (StarMonoidHom.ofClass q) u₁
  let qU₂ : unitary (OuterMultiplier B) := Unitary.map (StarMonoidHom.ofClass q) u₂
  let diagonalU : unitary (CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) 𝓜(ℂ, B)) :=
    pairDiagonalUnitary 𝓜(ℂ, B) u₁ u₂
  let w : unitary 𝓜(ℂ, B) :=
    Unitary.map (StarMonoidHom.ofClass S.multiplierMatrixEquiv.toStarAlgHom) diagonalU
  have hw : q (w : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) =
      S.matrixEquiv
        (pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B) (q (u₁ : 𝓜(ℂ, B)))
          (q (u₂ : 𝓜(ℂ, B)))) := by
    calc
      q (w : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) =
          q (S.multiplierMatrixEquiv
            (pairDiagonal 𝓜(ℂ, B) (u₁ : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) (u₂ : 𝓜(ℂ, B)))) := by
        rfl
      _ = S.matrixEquiv
          ((pairDiagonal 𝓜(ℂ, B) (u₁ : 𝓜(ℂ, B))
            (u₂ : 𝓜(ℂ, B))).map q) :=
        (S.quotient_compatible _).symm
      _ = S.matrixEquiv
          (pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B) (q (u₁ : 𝓜(ℂ, B)))
            (q (u₂ : 𝓜(ℂ, B)))) := by
        rw [pairDiagonal_map]
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  intro a
  calc
    S.sum tau₁' tau₂' a =
        S.matrixEquiv (twoDiagonal (tau₁' a) (tau₂' a)) :=
      S.sum_apply tau₁' tau₂' a
    _ = S.matrixEquiv
        (pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B) (tau₁' a) (tau₂' a)) := by
      rw [pairDiagonal_eq_twoDiagonal]
    _ = S.matrixEquiv
        (pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B)
          ((qU₁ : OuterMultiplier B) * tau₁ a * star (qU₁ : OuterMultiplier B))
          ((qU₂ : OuterMultiplier B) * tau₂ a * star (qU₂ : OuterMultiplier B))) := by
      rw [hu₁ a, hu₂ a]
      rfl
    _ = S.matrixEquiv
        ((pairDiagonalUnitary (OuterMultiplier B) qU₁ qU₂ :
            CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (OuterMultiplier B)) *
          pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B) (tau₁ a) (tau₂ a) *
          star (pairDiagonalUnitary (OuterMultiplier B) qU₁ qU₂ :
            CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (OuterMultiplier B))) := by
      rw [pairDiagonal_conjugate]
    _ = S.matrixEquiv
          (pairDiagonalUnitary (OuterMultiplier B) qU₁ qU₂ :
            CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (OuterMultiplier B)) *
        S.matrixEquiv (pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B) (tau₁ a) (tau₂ a)) *
        star (S.matrixEquiv
          (pairDiagonalUnitary (OuterMultiplier B) qU₁ qU₂ :
            CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (OuterMultiplier B))) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_star]
    _ = q (w : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) * S.sum tau₁ tau₂ a *
        star (q (w : 𝓜(ℂ, B))) := by
      rw [hw, S.sum_apply, ← pairDiagonal_eq_twoDiagonal, pairDiagonalUnitary_coe]
      simp only [qU₁, qU₂, Unitary.coe_map, StarMonoidHom.ofClass_coe]

/-- The supplied stable sum of two trivial Busby maps is trivial. -/
theorem StableSumData.sum_trivial (S : StableSumData A B)
    {tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B}
    (h₁ : IsTrivial tau₁) (h₂ : IsTrivial tau₂) :
    IsTrivial (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) := by
  let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
  obtain ⟨rho₁, hrho₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨rho₂, hrho₂⟩ := h₂
  let diagonalLift :
      A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) 𝓜(ℂ, B) :=
    (pairDiagonalStarAlgHom 𝓜(ℂ, B)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp
      (rho₁.prod rho₂)
  let lift : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] 𝓜(ℂ, B) :=
    S.multiplierMatrixEquiv.toStarAlgHom.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp diagonalLift
  refine ⟨lift, ?_⟩
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro a
  let q := outerQuotientMap (A := B)
  have hrho₁a : q (rho₁ a) = tau₁ a := by
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hrho₁ a
  have hrho₂a : q (rho₂ a) = tau₂ a := by
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hrho₂ a
  change q (S.multiplierMatrixEquiv
      (pairDiagonal 𝓜(ℂ, B) (rho₁ a) (rho₂ a))) = S.sum tau₁ tau₂ a
  calc
    q (S.multiplierMatrixEquiv
        (pairDiagonal 𝓜(ℂ, B) (rho₁ a) (rho₂ a))) =
      S.matrixEquiv
        ((pairDiagonal 𝓜(ℂ, B) (rho₁ a) (rho₂ a)).map q) :=
      (S.quotient_compatible _).symm
    _ = S.matrixEquiv
        (pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B) (q (rho₁ a)) (q (rho₂ a))) := by
      rw [pairDiagonal_map]
    _ = S.matrixEquiv
        (pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B) (tau₁ a) (tau₂ a)) := by
      rw [hrho₁a, hrho₂a]
    _ = S.matrixEquiv (twoDiagonal (tau₁ a) (tau₂ a)) := by
      rw [pairDiagonal_eq_twoDiagonal]
    _ = S.sum tau₁ tau₂ a := (S.sum_apply tau₁ tau₂ a).symm

section Swap

variable (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D]

/-- The literal multiplier-matrix swap used only inside the strong-equivalence proof. -/
@[no_expose]
private def swapMatrix : CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) D :=
  fun i j => if i = j then 0 else 1

private theorem swapMatrix_star :
    star (swapMatrix D) = swapMatrix D := by
  ext i j
  simp only [CStarMatrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, CStarMatrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  unfold swapMatrix
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp

private theorem swapMatrix_sq :
    swapMatrix D * swapMatrix D = 1 := by
  ext i j
  simp only [CStarMatrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, CStarMatrix.one_apply]
  unfold swapMatrix
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp

/-- A genuinely unitary swap, with both unitary equations proved. -/
@[no_expose]
private def swapUnitary : unitary (CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) D) :=
  ⟨swapMatrix D, by
    change star (swapMatrix D) * swapMatrix D = 1 ∧
      swapMatrix D * star (swapMatrix D) = 1
    constructor
    · rw [swapMatrix_star]
      exact swapMatrix_sq D
    · rw [swapMatrix_star]
      exact swapMatrix_sq D⟩

private theorem swapMatrix_map {E : Type*} [CStarAlgebra E]
    (f : D →⋆ₐ[ℂ] E) :
    (swapMatrix D).map f = swapMatrix E := by
  ext i j
  simp only [CStarMatrix.map_apply]
  unfold swapMatrix
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp

private theorem swapMatrix_conjugate (x y : D) :
    swapMatrix D * pairDiagonal D x y * star (swapMatrix D) =
      pairDiagonal D y x := by
  rw [swapMatrix_star, pairDiagonal_apply, pairDiagonal_apply]
  ext i j
  simp only [CStarMatrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_apply]
  unfold swapMatrix
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal]

end Swap

/-- Any actual compatible matrix sum is strongly commutative via the finite multiplier swap.
No associativity, standard stabilization, source norm or nontriviality is assumed. -/
theorem StableSumData.sum_comm_strong (S : StableSumData A B)
    (tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B) :
    StronglyUnitaryEquivalent (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) (S.sum tau₂ tau₁) := by
  let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
  let q := outerQuotientMap (A := B)
  let w : unitary 𝓜(ℂ, B) :=
    Unitary.map (StarMonoidHom.ofClass S.multiplierMatrixEquiv.toStarAlgHom)
      (swapUnitary 𝓜(ℂ, B))
  have hw : q (w : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) = S.matrixEquiv (swapMatrix (OuterMultiplier B)) := by
    calc
      q (w : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) =
          q (S.multiplierMatrixEquiv (swapMatrix 𝓜(ℂ, B))) := by rfl
      _ = S.matrixEquiv ((swapMatrix 𝓜(ℂ, B)).map q) :=
        (S.quotient_compatible _).symm
      _ = S.matrixEquiv (swapMatrix (OuterMultiplier B)) := by rw [swapMatrix_map]
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  intro a
  calc
    S.sum tau₂ tau₁ a = S.matrixEquiv (twoDiagonal (tau₂ a) (tau₁ a)) :=
      S.sum_apply tau₂ tau₁ a
    _ = S.matrixEquiv
        (swapMatrix (OuterMultiplier B) *
          pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B) (tau₁ a) (tau₂ a) *
          star (swapMatrix (OuterMultiplier B))) := by
      rw [swapMatrix_conjugate, pairDiagonal_eq_twoDiagonal]
    _ = S.matrixEquiv (swapMatrix (OuterMultiplier B)) *
        S.matrixEquiv (pairDiagonal (OuterMultiplier B) (tau₁ a) (tau₂ a)) *
        star (S.matrixEquiv (swapMatrix (OuterMultiplier B))) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_star]
    _ = q (w : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) * S.sum tau₁ tau₂ a *
        star (q (w : 𝓜(ℂ, B))) := by
      rw [hw, S.sum_apply, pairDiagonal_eq_twoDiagonal]

/-- The original coherence predicate needs only a supplied associativity law,
because strong commutativity follows from the actual matrix data. -/
theorem StableSumData.coherent_of_associative (S : StableSumData A B)
    (hAssoc : ∀ tau₁ tau₂ tau₃ : BusbyHom A B,
      StronglyUnitaryEquivalent (S.sum (S.sum tau₁ tau₂) tau₃)
        (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum tau₂ tau₃))) :
    S.IsCoherent :=
  ⟨hAssoc, S.sum_comm_strong⟩

end CStarExtension

module


public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.StableSum.Calculus

/-!
# Stable strong equivalence is an equivalence relation

The actual stable relation becomes an equivalence relation from the supplied
associativity and commutativity coherence. Reflexivity uses a directly
constructed zero trivial Busby map; transitivity uses only strict
strong-unitary calculus and the proved stable-sum congruence/triviality laws.
The source algebra keeps the weak BusbyHom telescope; no source completeness,
strong zero law, or source-standard stabilization is assumed. The equivalence
proof is reused strictly, not supplied by a source placeholder.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra Matrix MultiplierAlgebra

namespace CStarExtension

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] [DistribMulAction ℂ A] [StarAddMonoid A]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

private theorem stably_strong_equivalent_refl (S : StableSumData A B)
    (tau : BusbyHom A B) :
    StablyStrongEquivalent S tau tau := by
  let _ : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
  refine ⟨0, 0, zero_is_trivial, zero_is_trivial, ?_⟩
  exact strongly_unitary_equivalent_refl (S.sum tau 0)

private theorem stably_strong_equivalent_symm (S : StableSumData A B)
    {tau₁ tau₂ : BusbyHom A B}
    (h : StablyStrongEquivalent S tau₁ tau₂) :
    StablyStrongEquivalent S tau₂ tau₁ := by
  obtain ⟨sigma₁, sigma₂, hsigma₁, hsigma₂, hcompare⟩ := h
  exact ⟨sigma₂, sigma₁, hsigma₂, hsigma₁,
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_symm hcompare⟩

private theorem stably_strong_equivalent_trans (S : StableSumData A B)
    (hS : S.IsCoherent)
    {tau₁ tau₂ tau₃ : BusbyHom A B}
    (h₁₂ : StablyStrongEquivalent S tau₁ tau₂)
    (h₂₃ : StablyStrongEquivalent S tau₂ tau₃) :
    StablyStrongEquivalent S tau₁ tau₃ := by
  obtain ⟨sigma₁, sigma₂, hsigma₁, hsigma₂, hcompare₁₂⟩ := h₁₂
  obtain ⟨sigma₃, sigma₄, hsigma₃, hsigma₄, hcompare₂₃⟩ := h₂₃
  have htrivialLeft : IsTrivial (S.sum sigma₁ sigma₃) :=
    S.sum_trivial hsigma₁ hsigma₃
  have htrivialRight : IsTrivial (S.sum sigma₄ sigma₂) :=
    S.sum_trivial hsigma₄ hsigma₂
  have hstep₀ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum tau₁ (S.sum sigma₁ sigma₃))
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₁ sigma₁) sigma₃) :=
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_symm (hS.1 tau₁ sigma₁ sigma₃)
  have hstep₁ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₁ sigma₁) sigma₃)
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₂ sigma₂) sigma₃) :=
    S.sum_congr_strong hcompare₁₂
      (strongly_unitary_equivalent_refl sigma₃)
  have hstep₂ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₂ sigma₂) sigma₃)
      (S.sum tau₂ (S.sum sigma₂ sigma₃)) :=
    hS.1 tau₂ sigma₂ sigma₃
  have hstep₃ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum tau₂ (S.sum sigma₂ sigma₃))
      (S.sum tau₂ (S.sum sigma₃ sigma₂)) :=
    S.sum_congr_strong (strongly_unitary_equivalent_refl tau₂)
      (hS.2 sigma₂ sigma₃)
  have hstep₄ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum tau₂ (S.sum sigma₃ sigma₂))
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₂ sigma₃) sigma₂) :=
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_symm (hS.1 tau₂ sigma₃ sigma₂)
  have hstep₅ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₂ sigma₃) sigma₂)
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₃ sigma₄) sigma₂) :=
    S.sum_congr_strong hcompare₂₃
      (strongly_unitary_equivalent_refl sigma₂)
  have hstep₆ : StronglyUnitaryEquivalent
      (S.sum (S.sum tau₃ sigma₄) sigma₂)
      (S.sum tau₃ (S.sum sigma₄ sigma₂)) :=
    hS.1 tau₃ sigma₄ sigma₂
  refine ⟨S.sum sigma₁ sigma₃, S.sum sigma₄ sigma₂,
    htrivialLeft, htrivialRight, ?_⟩
  exact strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans hstep₀ <|
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans hstep₁ <|
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans hstep₂ <|
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans hstep₃ <|
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans hstep₄ <|
    strongly_unitary_equivalent_trans hstep₅ hstep₆

/-- The stable strong relation is an equivalence relation. -/
theorem stably_strong_equivalent_equivalence (S : StableSumData A B)
    (hS : S.IsCoherent) :
    _root_.Equivalence (StablyStrongEquivalent S) := by
  constructor
  · exact stably_strong_equivalent_refl S
  · intro tau₁ tau₂ h
    exact stably_strong_equivalent_symm S h
  · intro tau₁ tau₂ tau₃ h₁₂ h₂₃
    exact stably_strong_equivalent_trans S hS h₁₂ h₂₃

end CStarExtension
