module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.DirectSum.Completion

/-!
# Direct sums of right C-star modules

This is the public import surface for the literal finite-support construction
and its Hilbert-module completion.
-/

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Right
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Synonym
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.DFinsupp

/-!
# Algebraic direct sums of right C-star modules

For an arbitrary family `E i` of right pre-Hilbert modules over one
coefficient C-star algebra `B`, this file equips the finite-support dependent
sum with the coefficient inner product

`<x,y> = ∑ i, <x i,y i>`.

The norm is the norm induced by that inner product, not a pre-existing
`DFinsupp` norm.  The construction needs neither component completeness nor a
nonempty index type.  Completion is performed separately.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators RightActions

namespace CStarModule.DirectSum

universe uB uI uE

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {I : Type uI} {E : I → Type uE}
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (E i)]
variable [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]

/-- The finite-support algebraic direct sum, kept in a coefficient-indexed
synonym so its inner-product norm cannot be confused with another `DFinsupp`
norm. -/
abbrev Algebraic (B : Type uB) {I : Type uI} (E : I → Type uE)
    [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] :=
  WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (Π₀ i, E i)

/-- The underlying dependent finite-support function. -/
def toDFinsupp : Algebraic B E ≃ₗ[ℂ] (Π₀ i, E i) :=
  WithCStarModule.linearEquiv ℂ Bᵐᵒᵖ (Π₀ i, E i)

omit [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
  [(i : I) → SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
  [(i : I) → CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] in
@[simp]
theorem toDFinsupp_apply (x : Algebraic B E) (i : I) :
    toDFinsupp x i = (WithCStarModule.equiv Bᵐᵒᵖ (Π₀ i, E i) x) i :=
  rfl

/-- The underlying classical finite-support coordinate vector.  Classical
decidable equality is an implementation detail, not an API hypothesis. -/
def rawSingle (i : I) (x : E i) : Π₀ i, E i := by
  classical
  exact DFinsupp.single i x

/-- The finite support of an algebraic direct-sum vector. -/
def support (x : Algebraic B E) : Finset I := by
  classical
  exact (toDFinsupp x).support

omit [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
  [(i : I) → SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
  [(i : I) → CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] in
theorem mem_support_iff (x : Algebraic B E) (i : I) :
    i ∈ support x ↔ toDFinsupp x i ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  simp only [support, DFinsupp.mem_support_toFun]

omit [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
  [(i : I) → SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
  [(i : I) → CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] in
theorem not_mem_support_iff (x : Algebraic B E) (i : I) :
    i ∉ support x ↔ toDFinsupp x i = 0 := by
  rw [mem_support_iff]
  exact not_ne_iff

/-- The algebraic coordinate inclusion as a complex-linear map. -/
def singleLinear (i : I) : E i →ₗ[ℂ] Algebraic B E := by
  classical
  exact
    (WithCStarModule.linearEquiv ℂ Bᵐᵒᵖ (Π₀ i, E i)).symm.toLinearMap.comp
      (DFinsupp.lsingle i)

omit [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
  [(i : I) → SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
  [(i : I) → CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] in
@[simp]
theorem toDFinsupp_singleLinear (i : I) (x : E i) :
    toDFinsupp (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x) = rawSingle i x :=
  by
    classical
    rfl

omit [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
  [(i : I) → SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
  [(i : I) → CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] in
@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem singleLinear_apply_same (i : I) (x : E i) :
    toDFinsupp (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x) i = x := by
  classical
  change rawSingle i x i = x
  simp only [rawSingle, DFinsupp.single_eq_same]

omit [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
  [(i : I) → SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
  [(i : I) → CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] in
@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem singleLinear_apply_ne {i j : I} (h : j ≠ i) (x : E i) :
    toDFinsupp (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x) j = 0 := by
  classical
  change rawSingle i x j = 0
  simp only [rawSingle, DFinsupp.single_eq_of_ne h]

omit [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
  [(i : I) → SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
  [(i : I) → CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] in
/-- Induction on algebraic direct sums, expressed through the public
coefficient-indexed carrier rather than exposing raw `DFinsupp`. -/
protected theorem induction {p : Algebraic B E → Prop} (x : Algebraic B E)
    (h0 : p 0)
    (ha : ∀ (i : I) (b : E i) (y : Algebraic B E),
      toDFinsupp y i = 0 → b ≠ 0 → p y →
        p (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i b + y)) : p x := by
  classical
  let q : (Π₀ i, E i) → Prop := fun f ↦ p (toDFinsupp.symm f)
  have hq0 : q 0 := by simpa [q] using h0
  have hqa : ∀ (i : I) (b : E i) (f : Π₀ i, E i),
      f i = 0 → b ≠ 0 → q f → q (DFinsupp.single i b + f) := by
    intro i b f hfi hb hf
    let y : Algebraic B E := toDFinsupp.symm f
    have hyi : toDFinsupp y i = 0 := by simpa [y] using hfi
    have hpy : p y := by simpa [q, y] using hf
    have hp := ha i b y hyi hb hpy
    have heq : toDFinsupp.symm (DFinsupp.single i b + f) =
        singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i b + y := by
      apply toDFinsupp.injective
      simp [map_add, toDFinsupp_singleLinear, rawSingle, y]
    simpa [q, heq]
  have hx := DFinsupp.induction (toDFinsupp x) hq0 hqa
  simpa [q] using hx

/-- The coefficient-valued inner product, as a complex-linear map in its
second variable. -/
def algebraicInnerSL (x : Algebraic B E) : Algebraic B E →ₗ[ℂ] Bᵐᵒᵖ := by
  classical
  exact
    (DFinsupp.lsum ℂ fun i ↦
        CStarModule.innerₛₗ (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (E := E i) (toDFinsupp x i)).comp
      (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := E)).toLinearMap

/-- The literal finite sum of component inner products. -/
def algebraicInner (x y : Algebraic B E) : Bᵐᵒᵖ :=
  algebraicInnerSL x y

@[simp]
theorem algebraicInner_zero_right (x : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInner x 0 = 0 :=
  (algebraicInnerSL x).map_zero

@[simp]
theorem algebraicInner_add_right (x y z : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInner x (y + z) = algebraicInner x y + algebraicInner x z :=
  (algebraicInnerSL x).map_add y z

@[simp]
theorem algebraicInner_smul_right (c : ℂ) (x y : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInner x (c • y) = c • algebraicInner x y :=
  (algebraicInnerSL x).map_smul c y

@[simp]
theorem algebraicInner_single_right (x : Algebraic B E) (i : I) (y : E i) :
    algebraicInner x (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i y) =
      inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (toDFinsupp x i) y := by
  classical
  change (DFinsupp.lsum ℂ fun j ↦
      CStarModule.innerₛₗ (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (E := E j) (toDFinsupp x j))
        (toDFinsupp (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i y)) = _
  rw [toDFinsupp_singleLinear]
  simp [rawSingle, CStarModule.innerₛₗ_apply]

/-- Evaluation as the finite sum over the support of the second vector. -/
theorem algebraicInner_eq_sum (x y : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInner x y =
      ∑ i ∈ support y,
        inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (toDFinsupp x i) (toDFinsupp y i) := by
  classical
  change algebraicInner x y =
    ∑ i ∈ (toDFinsupp y).support,
      inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (toDFinsupp x i) (toDFinsupp y i)
  change (DFinsupp.lsum ℂ fun i ↦
      CStarModule.innerₛₗ (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (E := E i) (toDFinsupp x i))
        (toDFinsupp y) = _
  rw [DFinsupp.lsum_apply_apply, DFinsupp.sumAddHom_apply]
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem algebraicInner_zero_left (y : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInner (0 : Algebraic B E) y = 0 := by
  rw [algebraicInner_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i hi
  exact CStarModule.inner_zero_left

@[simp]
theorem algebraicInner_add_left (x y z : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInner (x + y) z = algebraicInner x z + algebraicInner y z := by
  classical
  rw [algebraicInner_eq_sum, algebraicInner_eq_sum, algebraicInner_eq_sum]
  simp only [map_add, DFinsupp.add_apply, CStarModule.inner_add_left,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib]

@[simp]
theorem algebraicInner_smul_left (c : ℂ) (x y : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInner (c • x) y = star c • algebraicInner x y := by
  classical
  rw [algebraicInner_eq_sum, algebraicInner_eq_sum]
  simp only [map_smul, DFinsupp.smul_apply, CStarModule.inner_smul_left_complex,
    Finset.smul_sum]

@[simp]
theorem algebraicInner_single_left (i : I) (x : E i) (y : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInner (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x) y =
      inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x (toDFinsupp y i) := by
  classical
  induction y using CStarModule.DirectSum.induction with
  | h0 => simp
  | ha j z y hj hz ih =>
      rw [algebraicInner_add_right, map_add]
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j
        rw [algebraicInner_single_right, ih]
        rw [singleLinear_apply_same, DFinsupp.add_apply,
          singleLinear_apply_same, CStarModule.inner_add_right]
      · rw [algebraicInner_single_right, ih]
        rw [singleLinear_apply_ne hji, CStarModule.inner_zero_left, zero_add,
          DFinsupp.add_apply, singleLinear_apply_ne (Ne.symm hji), zero_add]

@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem algebraicInner_single_single (i : I) (x y : E i) :
    algebraicInner (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x)
        (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i y) = inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x y := by
  rw [algebraicInner_single_right, singleLinear_apply_same]

/-- Conjugate symmetry of the finite-sum inner product. -/
theorem star_algebraicInner (x y : Algebraic B E) :
    star (algebraicInner x y) = algebraicInner y x := by
  classical
  induction x using CStarModule.DirectSum.induction with
  | h0 => simp
  | ha i z x hi hz ih =>
      rw [algebraicInner_add_left, star_add, ih, algebraicInner_add_right,
        algebraicInner_single_left, algebraicInner_single_right,
        CStarModule.star_inner]

/-- Pointwise right multiplication as a complex-linear endomorphism of the
algebraic direct sum. -/
def algebraicRightSMul (b : B) : Algebraic B E →ₗ[ℂ] Algebraic B E := by
  classical
  exact
    (WithCStarModule.linearEquiv ℂ Bᵐᵒᵖ (Π₀ i, E i)).symm.toLinearMap.comp
      ((DFinsupp.mapRange.linearMap fun i ↦
        (CStarModule.rightSMulLinear (B := B) (E := E i)).flip b).comp
          (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := E)).toLinearMap)

@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem toDFinsupp_algebraicRightSMul (b : B) (x : Algebraic B E) (i : I) :
    toDFinsupp (algebraicRightSMul (E := E) b x) i = toDFinsupp x i <• b := by
  classical
  let e := WithCStarModule.linearEquiv ℂ Bᵐᵒᵖ (Π₀ i, E i)
  let z := DFinsupp.mapRange (fun i x ↦ x <• b)
    (fun i ↦ CStarModule.zero_right_smul b) (toDFinsupp x)
  have hz : e (e.symm z) = z := e.apply_symm_apply z
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hz i

/-- The exact pointwise right coefficient action. -/
instance algebraicSMul : SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (Algebraic B E) where
  smul b x := algebraicRightSMul (E := E) b.unop x

@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem toDFinsupp_right_smul (x : Algebraic B E) (b : B) (i : I) :
    toDFinsupp (x <• b) i = toDFinsupp x i <• b :=
  toDFinsupp_algebraicRightSMul b x i

@[simp]
theorem singleLinear_right_smul (i : I) (x : E i) (b : B) :
    singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i (x <• b) =
      singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x <• b := by
  classical
  apply (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := E)).injective
  ext j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    rw [singleLinear_apply_same, toDFinsupp_right_smul, singleLinear_apply_same]
  · rw [singleLinear_apply_ne hji, toDFinsupp_right_smul,
      singleLinear_apply_ne hji, CStarModule.zero_right_smul]

/-- The finite-sum inner product is right coefficient-linear. -/
theorem algebraicInner_right_smul (x y : Algebraic B E) (b : Bᵐᵒᵖ) :
    algebraicInner x (b • y) = b * algebraicInner x y := by
  classical
  induction y using CStarModule.DirectSum.induction with
  | h0 =>
      change algebraicInner x (algebraicRightSMul (E := E) b.unop 0) = _
      rw [map_zero, algebraicInner_zero_right]
      simp
  | ha i z y hi hz ih =>
      change algebraicInner x
          (algebraicRightSMul (E := E) b.unop
            (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i z + y)) = _
      rw [map_add, algebraicInner_add_right]
      change algebraicInner x
          (algebraicRightSMul (E := E) b.unop (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i z)) +
        algebraicInner x (b • y) =
          b * algebraicInner x (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i z + y)
      have hs : algebraicRightSMul (E := E) b.unop
          (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i z) =
          singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i (z <• b.unop) :=
        (singleLinear_right_smul (B := B) (E := E) i z b.unop).symm
      rw [ih, algebraicInner_add_right, mul_add, hs,
        algebraicInner_single_right, algebraicInner_single_right,
        CStarModule.inner_op_smul_right]
      simp only [MulOpposite.op_unop]

/-- The direct-sum norm before completion. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def algebraicNorm : Norm (Algebraic B E) where
  norm x := Real.sqrt ‖algebraicInner x x‖

variable [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]

/-- The literal finite-support pre-Hilbert module. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def algebraicCStarModule :
    letI : Norm (Algebraic B E) := algebraicNorm (B := B) (E := E)
    CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (Algebraic B E) := by
  letI : Norm (Algebraic B E) := algebraicNorm (B := B) (E := E)
  refine
    { inner := algebraicInner
      inner_add_right := by
        intro x y z
        exact algebraicInner_add_right (B := B) (E := E) x y z
      inner_self_nonneg := ?_
      inner_self := ?_
      inner_op_smul_right := by
        intro b x y
        exact algebraicInner_right_smul (B := B) (E := E) x y b
      inner_smul_right_complex := by
        intro c x y
        exact algebraicInner_smul_right (B := B) (E := E) c x y
      star_inner := by
        intro x y
        exact star_algebraicInner (B := B) (E := E) x y
      norm_eq_sqrt_norm_inner_self := ?_ }
  · intro x
    rw [algebraicInner_eq_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ CStarModule.inner_self_nonneg
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rw [algebraicInner_eq_sum] at hx
      have hz : ∀ i ∈ support x,
          inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (toDFinsupp x i) (toDFinsupp x i) = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
          (fun i _ ↦ CStarModule.inner_self_nonneg)).mp hx
      apply (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := E)).injective
      ext i
      by_cases hi : i ∈ support x
      · exact (CStarModule.inner_self (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
          (x := toDFinsupp x i)).mp (hz i hi)
      · exact (not_mem_support_iff x i).mp hi
    · rintro rfl
      exact algebraicInner_zero_left 0
  · intro x
    rfl

/-- The stock C-star-module core derives the normed group and complex normed
space laws from the constructed inner product. -/
theorem algebraicNormedSpaceCore :
    letI : Norm (Algebraic B E) := algebraicNorm (B := B) (E := E)
    NormedSpace.Core ℂ (Algebraic B E) := by
  let : Norm (Algebraic B E) := algebraicNorm (B := B) (E := E)
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (Algebraic B E) :=
    algebraicCStarModule (B := B) (E := E)
  exact CStarModule.normedSpaceCore Bᵐᵒᵖ (E := Algebraic B E)

@[instance_reducible]
noncomputable instance algebraicNormedAddCommGroup :
    NormedAddCommGroup (Algebraic B E) := by
  letI : Norm (Algebraic B E) := algebraicNorm (B := B) (E := E)
  exact NormedAddCommGroup.ofCore (algebraicNormedSpaceCore (B := B) (E := E))

@[instance_reducible]
noncomputable instance algebraicNormedSpace : NormedSpace ℂ (Algebraic B E) :=
  NormedSpace.ofCore (algebraicNormedSpaceCore (B := B) (E := E))

@[instance_reducible]
noncomputable instance algebraicCStarModuleInstance :
    CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (Algebraic B E) :=
  algebraicCStarModule (B := B) (E := E)

@[simp]
theorem inner_eq_algebraicInner (x y : Algebraic B E) :
    inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x y = algebraicInner x y :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem norm_algebraic (x : Algebraic B E) :
    ‖x‖ = Real.sqrt ‖algebraicInner x x‖ :=
  rfl

/-- Coordinate inclusion into the algebraic sum as a complex-linear isometry. -/
def single (i : I) : E i →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Algebraic B E where
  toLinearMap := singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i
  norm_map' x := by
    rw [norm_algebraic, algebraicInner_single_single]
    exact (CStarModule.norm_eq_sqrt_norm_inner_self (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) x).symm

@[simp]
theorem single_apply_eq_singleLinear (i : I) (x : E i) :
    single (B := B) (E := E) i x = singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x :=
  rfl

@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem single_apply_same (i : I) (x : E i) :
    toDFinsupp (single (B := B) (E := E) i x) i = x :=
  singleLinear_apply_same i x

@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem single_apply_ne {i j : I} (h : j ≠ i) (x : E i) :
    toDFinsupp (single (B := B) (E := E) i x) j = 0 :=
  singleLinear_apply_ne h x

@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem inner_single_same (i : I) (x y : E i) :
    inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (single (B := B) (E := E) i x)
        (single (B := B) (E := E) i y) = inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x y :=
  by
    rw [inner_eq_algebraicInner, single_apply_eq_singleLinear,
      single_apply_eq_singleLinear]
    exact algebraicInner_single_single i x y

@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem inner_single_ne {i j : I} (h : i ≠ j) (x : E i) (y : E j) :
    inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (single (B := B) (E := E) i x)
        (single (B := B) (E := E) j y) = 0 := by
  rw [inner_eq_algebraicInner, single_apply_eq_singleLinear,
    single_apply_eq_singleLinear]
  rw [algebraicInner_single_right, singleLinear_apply_ne (Ne.symm h)]
  exact CStarModule.inner_zero_left

/-- Every algebraic direct-sum vector belongs to the complex linear span of
the coordinate singles. -/
theorem span_range_single_eq_top :
    Submodule.span ℂ
        (Set.range fun p : Σ i, E i ↦ single (B := B) (E := E) p.1 p.2) = ⊤ := by
  classical
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  induction x using CStarModule.DirectSum.induction with
  | h0 => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | ha i z x hi hz ih =>
      exact Submodule.add_mem _
        (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨i, z⟩, rfl⟩) (ih trivial)

end CStarModule.DirectSum

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.DirectSum.Algebraic
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Adjointable

/-!
# Algebraic diagonals of rectangular adjointable families

The forward complex-linear map is the literal coordinate map on the existing
finite-support direct sum. Applying the same constructor to the given adjoint
family produces its algebraic adjoint. The pairing law uses the actual
coefficient-valued finite inner product, before the direct-sum norm instance.

No completeness, nonempty index, uniform bound or scalar squared-norm sum is
assumed. Continuity and extension to the completed direct sum are separate.
-/

public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace CStarModule.DirectSum

universe uB uI uE uF

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {I : Type uI} {E : I → Type uE} {F : I → Type uF}
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (E i)]
  [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (F i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (F i)]
  [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (F i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (F i)]

/-- The literal complex-linear diagonal on the actual algebraic direct sum.
The same constructor on the given adjoint family is its algebraic adjoint. -/
@[expose]
def algebraicDiagonal (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i)) :
    Algebraic B E →ₗ[ℂ] Algebraic B F :=
  (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := F)).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    ((DFinsupp.mapRange.linearMap fun i ↦
        (T i).toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap).comp
      (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := E)).toLinearMap)

private theorem algebraicDiagonal_raw
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i)) (x : Algebraic B E) :
    toDFinsupp (algebraicDiagonal T x) =
      DFinsupp.mapRange.linearMap
        (fun i ↦ (T i).toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap) (toDFinsupp x) := by
  let e := toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := F)
  let z : Π₀ i, F i := DFinsupp.mapRange.linearMap
    (fun i ↦ (T i).toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap) (toDFinsupp x)
  change e (e.symm z) = z
  exact e.apply_symm_apply z

/-- Every coordinate is the action of the given component operator. -/
theorem algebraicDiagonal_apply
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i)) (x : Algebraic B E) (i : I) :
    toDFinsupp (algebraicDiagonal T x) i = T i (toDFinsupp x i) := by
  rw [algebraicDiagonal_raw]
  rfl

/-- A coordinate inclusion is sent to the inclusion of its component image. -/
theorem algebraicDiagonal_singleLinear
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i)) (i : I) (x : E i) :
    algebraicDiagonal T (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x) =
      singleLinear (B := B) (E := F) i (T i x) := by
  classical
  apply (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := F)).injective
  rw [algebraicDiagonal_raw, toDFinsupp_singleLinear, toDFinsupp_singleLinear]
  change DFinsupp.mapRange (fun j z ↦ T j z)
    (fun j ↦ (T j).toContinuousLinearMap.map_zero) (DFinsupp.single i x) =
      DFinsupp.single i (T i x)
  exact DFinsupp.mapRange_single

/-- A diagonal creates no new support; kernels may make the support smaller. -/
theorem support_algebraicDiagonal_subset
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i)) (x : Algebraic B E) :
    support (algebraicDiagonal T x) ⊆ support x := by
  classical
  change (toDFinsupp (algebraicDiagonal T x)).support ⊆ (toDFinsupp x).support
  rw [algebraicDiagonal_raw]
  change (DFinsupp.mapRange (fun i z ↦ T i z)
    (fun i ↦ (T i).toContinuousLinearMap.map_zero) (toDFinsupp x)).support ⊆ _
  exact DFinsupp.support_mapRange

/-- The given adjoint family satisfies the genuine finite coefficient pairing.
No equality of the two finite supports is required. -/
theorem algebraicDiagonal_adjoint_inner
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i))
    (x : Algebraic B E) (y : Algebraic B F) :
    algebraicInner (algebraicDiagonal T x) y =
      algebraicInner x (algebraicDiagonal (fun i ↦ (T i).adjointOperator) y) := by
  induction y using CStarModule.DirectSum.induction with
  | h0 =>
      rw [(algebraicDiagonal (fun i ↦ (T i).adjointOperator)).map_zero,
        algebraicInner_zero_right, algebraicInner_zero_right]
  | ha i z y _hi _hz ih =>
      have hCoefficient : inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (T i (toDFinsupp x i)) z =
          inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (toDFinsupp x i) ((T i).adjoint z) := by
        have h := (T i).adjoint_inner (toDFinsupp x i) z
        change MulOpposite.unop (inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (T i (toDFinsupp x i)) z) =
          MulOpposite.unop (inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (toDFinsupp x i) ((T i).adjoint z)) at h
        exact MulOpposite.unop_injective h
      calc
        algebraicInner (algebraicDiagonal T x)
            (singleLinear (B := B) (E := F) i z + y) =
            inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (T i (toDFinsupp x i)) z +
              algebraicInner (algebraicDiagonal T x) y := by
          rw [algebraicInner_add_right, algebraicInner_single_right,
            algebraicDiagonal_apply]
        _ = inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (toDFinsupp x i) ((T i).adjoint z) +
            algebraicInner x
              (algebraicDiagonal (fun i ↦ (T i).adjointOperator) y) := by
          rw [hCoefficient, ih]
        _ = algebraicInner x
            (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i ((T i).adjoint z) +
              algebraicDiagonal (fun i ↦ (T i).adjointOperator) y) := by
          rw [algebraicInner_add_right, algebraicInner_single_right]
        _ = algebraicInner x
            (algebraicDiagonal (fun i ↦ (T i).adjointOperator)
              (singleLinear (B := B) (E := F) i z + y)) := by
          rw [(algebraicDiagonal (fun i ↦ (T i).adjointOperator)).map_add,
            algebraicDiagonal_singleLinear,
            AdjointableOperator.adjointOperator_apply]

end CStarModule.DirectSum

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.DirectSum.AlgebraicDiagonal
import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Adjointable.Completion
import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Adjointable.GramBound
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Order

/-!
# Finite coefficient bounds for algebraic diagonals

A uniformly bounded given rectangular family satisfies the genuine coefficient
Gram bound and norm bound on the actual algebraic direct sum. Component
completion is used only in proofs; the original fibers may be incomplete.

The fixed source support is used even when the diagonal kills coordinates.
The numeric bound changes no operator value. No scalar sum of squared fiber
norms, continuous/completed diagonal, compactness or action is asserted.
-/

public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators CStarAlgebra RightActions

namespace CStarModule.DirectSum

universe uB uI uE uF

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {I : Type uI} {E : I → Type uE} {F : I → Type uF}
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (E i)]
  [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (F i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (F i)]
  [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (F i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (F i)]

attribute [local instance] CStarModule.completionCStarModule

omit [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ] in
private theorem gram_smul_nonneg (i : I) (x : E i) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    0 ≤ r • inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x x := by
  have h := CStarModule.inner_self_nonneg (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (E := E i)
    (x := Real.sqrt r • x)
  rw [CStarModule.inner_smul_left_real, CStarModule.inner_smul_right_real,
    smul_smul, Real.mul_self_sqrt hr] at h
  exact h

private theorem component_gram_bound (i : I)
    (T : AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i)) (c : ℝ) (hT : ‖T‖ ≤ c) (x : E i) :
    inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (T x) (T x) ≤ (c ^ 2 : ℝ) • inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x x := by
  have hGram : inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (T x) (T x) ≤
      (‖T.completion‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x x := by
    simpa only [AdjointableOperator.completion_apply_coe,
      CStarModule.completionCStarModule_inner_coe_coe] using
      (T.completion.inner_apply_self_le_norm_sq_smul
        (x : UniformSpace.Completion (E i)))
  have hNorm : ‖T.completion‖ ≤ c := T.completion_norm_le.trans hT
  have hSquare : ‖T.completion‖ ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [pow_two] using
      mul_self_le_mul_self (_root_.norm_nonneg T.completion) hNorm
  have hRemainder : 0 ≤
      ((c ^ 2 - ‖T.completion‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x x) :=
    gram_smul_nonneg i x _ (sub_nonneg.mpr hSquare)
  have hDifference : 0 ≤ (c ^ 2 : ℝ) • inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x x -
      (‖T.completion‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x x := by
    simpa only [sub_smul] using hRemainder
  exact hGram.trans (sub_nonneg.mp hDifference)

omit [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ] in
private theorem diagonal_inner_fixed_support
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i)) (x : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInner (algebraicDiagonal T x) (algebraicDiagonal T x) =
      ∑ i ∈ support x, inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (T i (toDFinsupp x i)) (T i (toDFinsupp x i)) := by
  classical
  rw [algebraicInner_eq_sum]
  simp_rw [algebraicDiagonal_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_subset (support_algebraicDiagonal_subset T x) ?_
  intro i _hi hni
  have hz := (not_mem_support_iff (algebraicDiagonal T x) i).mp hni
  rw [algebraicDiagonal_apply] at hz
  rw [hz]
  exact CStarModule.inner_zero_left

/-- The actual finite coefficient Gram bound over the unchanged source support.
The original source and target component modules need not be complete. -/
theorem algebraicDiagonal_inner_self_le
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i)) (c : ℝ)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ‖T i‖ ≤ c) (x : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInner (algebraicDiagonal T x) (algebraicDiagonal T x) ≤
      (c ^ 2 : ℝ) • algebraicInner x x := by
  classical
  calc
    algebraicInner (algebraicDiagonal T x) (algebraicDiagonal T x) =
        ∑ i ∈ support x,
          inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (T i (toDFinsupp x i)) (T i (toDFinsupp x i)) :=
      diagonal_inner_fixed_support T x
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ support x, (c ^ 2 : ℝ) •
        inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (toDFinsupp x i) (toDFinsupp x i) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _hi ↦ component_gram_bound i (T i) c (hBound i) _
    _ = (c ^ 2 : ℝ) • algebraicInner x x := by
      rw [algebraicInner_eq_sum, Finset.smul_sum]

/-- A given nonnegative uniform operator bound bounds the actual algebraic
diagonal norm, with no original fiber completeness or nonempty-index premise. -/
theorem algebraicDiagonal_norm_le
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i)) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ‖T i‖ ≤ c) (x : Algebraic B E) :
    ‖algebraicDiagonal T x‖ ≤ c * ‖x‖ := by
  have hPositive : 0 ≤
      algebraicInner (algebraicDiagonal T x) (algebraicDiagonal T x) := by
    rw [algebraicInner_eq_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _hi ↦ CStarModule.inner_self_nonneg
  have hCoefficient := CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_le_of_nonneg
    (algebraicDiagonal_inner_self_le T c hBound x) hPositive
  have hScaledNorm : ‖(c ^ 2 : ℝ) • algebraicInner x x‖ =
      c ^ 2 * ‖algebraicInner x x‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg c)]
  have hCoefficientNorm : ‖algebraicInner (algebraicDiagonal T x)
      (algebraicDiagonal T x)‖ ≤ c ^ 2 * ‖algebraicInner x x‖ :=
    hCoefficient.trans_eq hScaledNorm
  calc
    ‖algebraicDiagonal T x‖ =
        Real.sqrt ‖algebraicInner (algebraicDiagonal T x)
          (algebraicDiagonal T x)‖ := norm_algebraic _
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 * ‖algebraicInner x x‖) :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hCoefficientNorm
    _ = c * ‖x‖ := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq hc, ← norm_algebraic x]

end CStarModule.DirectSum

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Completion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.DirectSum.Algebraic

/-!
# Completed direct sums of right C-star modules

The Hilbert-module direct sum of an arbitrary family is the stock completion
of its literal finite-support pre-Hilbert direct sum.  Coordinate inclusions
are isometries, distinct coordinates are orthogonal, and their complex linear
span is dense.

No component completeness is needed: this construction also completes a
family of pre-Hilbert modules.  For finite complete families, later comparison
lemmas may identify this carrier with the usual finite product model.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Set
open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule.DirectSum

universe uB uI uE uX

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {I : Type uI} {E : I → Type uE}
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (E i)]
variable [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]

/-- The actual completed Hilbert-module direct sum. -/
abbrev Completed (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]
    {I : Type uI} (E : I → Type uE)
    [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (E i)]
    [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] :=
  UniformSpace.Completion (Algebraic B E)

/-- The completed direct sum inherits the extended coefficient-valued inner
product and the stock completion norm. -/
noncomputable instance completedCStarModule : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (Completed B E) :=
  CStarModule.completionCStarModule (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (E := Algebraic B E)

/-- The canonical inclusion of the algebraic finite-support sum. -/
def algebraicInclusion : Algebraic B E →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Completed B E :=
  UniformSpace.Completion.toComplₗᵢ

@[simp]
theorem algebraicInclusion_apply (x : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInclusion x = (x : Completed B E) := by
  exact congrFun (UniformSpace.Completion.coe_toComplₗᵢ
    (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := Algebraic B E)) x

/-- A coordinate inclusion into the completed direct sum. -/
def completedSingle (i : I) : E i →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Completed B E :=
  algebraicInclusion.comp (single (B := B) (E := E) i)

@[simp]
theorem completedSingle_apply (i : I) (x : E i) :
    completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x =
      ((single (B := B) (E := E) i x : Algebraic B E) : Completed B E) := by
  change algebraicInclusion (single (B := B) (E := E) i x) = _
  rw [algebraicInclusion_apply]

@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem completedSingle_right_smul (i : I) (x : E i) (b : B) :
    completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i (x <• b) =
      completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x <• b := by
  rw [completedSingle_apply, completedSingle_apply,
    ← CStarModule.coe_completion_coeff_smul
      (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (E := Algebraic B E)]
  congr 1
  exact singleLinear_right_smul (B := B) (E := E) i x b

@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem inner_completedSingle_same (i : I) (x y : E i) :
    inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x)
        (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i y) = inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x y := by
  rw [completedSingle_apply, completedSingle_apply,
    CStarModule.completionCStarModule_inner_coe_coe]
  exact inner_single_same i x y

@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem inner_completedSingle_ne {i j : I} (h : i ≠ j) (x : E i) (y : E j) :
    inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x)
        (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) j y) = 0 := by
  rw [completedSingle_apply, completedSingle_apply,
    CStarModule.completionCStarModule_inner_coe_coe]
  exact inner_single_ne h x y

/-- The complex linear span of the coordinate inclusions is dense in the
completed direct sum. -/
theorem dense_span_completedSingle :
    Dense (Submodule.span ℂ
      (Set.range fun p : Σ i, E i ↦
        completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) p.1 p.2) : Set (Completed B E)) := by
  let S : Submodule ℂ (Completed B E) :=
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : Σ i, E i ↦
      completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) p.1 p.2)
  have hcoe : Set.range ((↑) : Algebraic B E → Completed B E) ⊆
      (S : Set (Completed B E)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    induction x using CStarModule.DirectSum.induction with
    | h0 => exact Submodule.zero_mem S
    | ha i z x hi hz ih =>
        change algebraicInclusion
          (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i z + x) ∈ S
        rw [map_add]
        have hsingle : algebraicInclusion (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i z) =
            completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i z := by
          rw [completedSingle_apply, algebraicInclusion_apply,
            single_apply_eq_singleLinear]
        apply Submodule.add_mem S
        · rw [hsingle]
          exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨i, z⟩, rfl⟩
        · change (x : Completed B E) ∈ (S : Set (Completed B E))
          exact ih
  exact Dense.mono hcoe UniformSpace.Completion.denseRange_coe

/-- Characteristic coordinate laws of a pre-Hilbert-module direct sum.
This reusable contract also recognizes incomplete concrete presentations. -/
structure IsPreModel
    {X : Type uX} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℂ X]
    [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ X] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ X]
    (singleX : ∀ i, E i →L[ℂ] X) : Prop where
  /-- Coordinate inclusions preserve the right coefficient action. -/
  map_right_smul (i : I) (x : E i) (b : B) :
    singleX i (x <• b) = singleX i x <• b
  /-- Same-coordinate inclusions preserve the coefficient inner product. -/
  inner_same (i : I) (x y : E i) :
    rightInner (B := B) (singleX i x) (singleX i y) = rightInner (B := B) x y
  /-- Distinct coordinates are orthogonal. -/
  inner_ne {i j : I} (h : i ≠ j) (x : E i) (y : E j) :
    rightInner (B := B) (singleX i x) (singleX j y) = 0
  /-- Coordinate ranges have dense complex linear span. -/
  dense_span : Dense (Submodule.span ℂ
    (Set.range fun p : Σ i, E i ↦ singleX p.1 p.2) : Set X)

/-- Characteristic coordinate laws of a completed Hilbert-module direct sum.
Completeness is part of this contract rather than an accidental property of a
particular presentation. -/
structure IsModel
    {X : Type uX} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℂ X]
    [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ X] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ X] [CompleteSpace X]
    (singleX : ∀ i, E i →L[ℂ] X) : Prop
    extends IsPreModel (B := B) (E := E) singleX where

/-- The literal choice-free completed construction satisfies the complete direct-sum
model contract. -/
theorem completed_isModel :
    IsModel (B := B) (E := E)
      (fun i ↦ (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i).toContinuousLinearMap) := by
  refine { toIsPreModel := ?_ }
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, dense_span_completedSingle (B := B) (E := E)⟩
  · intro i x b
    exact completedSingle_right_smul i x b
  · intro i x y
    change CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
      (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x)
      (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i y) = _
    simpa only [rightInner] using congrArg MulOpposite.unop
      (inner_completedSingle_same (B := B) (E := E) i x y)
  · intro i j h x y
    change CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
      (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x)
      (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) j y) = 0
    change MulOpposite.unop
      (inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x)
        (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) j y)) = 0
    rw [inner_completedSingle_ne (B := B) (E := E) h x y]
    rfl

end CStarModule.DirectSum

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.DirectSum.Diagonal

/-!
# Coordinate projections on completed Hilbert-module direct sums

For any set of indices, the bounded diagonal with identity entries on that set
and zero entries elsewhere gives an adjointable projection on the literal
completed module sum. Its range is the closure of the complex span of the
selected coordinate inclusions. The component modules need not be complete,
and the index type may be infinite or empty.

For an integer-indexed family, the nonnegative cut includes degree zero.
The computed operator `2P - 1` is self-adjoint and squares to the identity.
This is the projection convention used in Arici, D'Andrea and Landi,
*Pimsner algebras and circle bundles*, §3.4, Definition 3.10. The construction
here works for arbitrary module families; tensor powers, the Fock creation
operators and Kasparov classes belong to their own constructions.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Set

namespace CStarModule.DirectSum

universe uB uI uE uX

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]

section Family

variable {I : Type uI} {E : I → Type uE}
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (E i)]
  [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]

/-- Adjointable maps from the completed sum are determined by their coordinate values. -/
theorem adjointable_ext_completedSingle
    {X : Type uX} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℂ X]
    [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ X] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ X]
    {S T : AdjointableOperator B (Completed B E) X}
    (h : ∀ i x, S (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x) =
      T (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x)) : S = T := by
  apply AdjointableOperator.toContinuousLinearMap_injective
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_on (dense_span_completedSingle (B := B) (E := E))
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, x⟩, rfl⟩
  exact h i x

/-- The actual bounded adjointable diagonal selecting a set of coordinates. -/
def cutProjection (s : Set I) : AdjointableOperator.End B (Completed B E) := by
  classical
  exact completedDiagonal
    (fun i ↦ if i ∈ s then (1 : AdjointableOperator.End B (E i)) else 0)
    ⟨1, zero_le_one, fun i ↦ by
      split_ifs
      · change ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (E i)‖ ≤ 1
        exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le
      · simp⟩

open Classical in
/-- A cut keeps precisely its selected coordinates, including their original values. -/
theorem cutProjection_apply_completedSingle (s : Set I) (i : I) (x : E i) :
    cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) s (completedSingle i x) =
      if i ∈ s then completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x else 0 := by
  classical
  rw [cutProjection, completedDiagonal_apply_completedSingle]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ s <;>
    simp only [hi, ite_true, ite_false, AdjointableOperator.one_apply,
      AdjointableOperator.zero_apply, map_zero]

/-- The cut is self-adjoint on the actual completed sum. -/
@[simp]
theorem star_cutProjection (s : Set I) :
    star (cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) s) = cutProjection s := by
  classical
  apply adjointable_ext_completedSingle
  intro i x
  rw [AdjointableOperator.star_apply, cutProjection,
    completedDiagonal_adjoint_apply_completedSingle,
    completedDiagonal_apply_completedSingle]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ s
  · simp only [ite_eq_left hi]
    rfl
  · simp only [ite_eq_right hi]
    rfl

/-- Selecting no coordinates gives the zero operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem cutProjection_empty :
    cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) (∅ : Set I) = 0 := by
  apply adjointable_ext_completedSingle
  intro i x
  rw [cutProjection_apply_completedSingle]
  simp

/-- Selecting all coordinates gives the identity on the completion. -/
@[simp]
theorem cutProjection_univ :
    cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) (Set.univ : Set I) = 1 := by
  apply adjointable_ext_completedSingle
  intro i x
  rw [cutProjection_apply_completedSingle]
  simp

/-- Composition of cuts is the cut on the intersection. -/
@[simp]
theorem cutProjection_mul (s t : Set I) :
    cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) s * cutProjection t = cutProjection (s ∩ t) := by
  classical
  apply adjointable_ext_completedSingle
  intro i x
  by_cases hs : i ∈ s <;> by_cases ht : i ∈ t <;>
    simp only [AdjointableOperator.mul_apply, cutProjection_apply_completedSingle,
      Set.mem_inter_iff, hs, ht, ite_true, ite_false,
      and_true, and_false, map_zero]

/-- The computed cut is idempotent. -/
theorem cutProjection_mul_self (s : Set I) :
    cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) s * cutProjection s = cutProjection s := by
  rw [cutProjection_mul, Set.inter_self]

/-- A coordinate cut is a star projection in the standard projection API. -/
theorem isStarProjection_cutProjection (s : Set I) :
    IsStarProjection (cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) s) :=
  ⟨cutProjection_mul_self s, star_cutProjection s⟩

/-- Every coordinate cut is contractive, also for an empty sum or zero modules. -/
theorem norm_cutProjection_le (s : Set I) :
    ‖cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) s‖ ≤ 1 :=
  IsStarProjection.norm_le _ (isStarProjection_cutProjection s)

/-- All coordinate cuts commute. -/
theorem cutProjection_comm (s t : Set I) :
    cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) s * cutProjection t =
      cutProjection t * cutProjection s := by
  rw [cutProjection_mul, cutProjection_mul, Set.inter_comm]

/-- Disjoint cuts have zero product. -/
theorem cutProjection_mul_of_disjoint {s t : Set I} (h : Disjoint s t) :
    cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) s * cutProjection t = 0 := by
  rw [cutProjection_mul, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp h, cutProjection_empty]

/-- A complementary cut is the complementary projection. -/
@[simp]
theorem cutProjection_compl (s : Set I) :
    cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) sᶜ = 1 - cutProjection s := by
  classical
  apply adjointable_ext_completedSingle
  intro i x
  by_cases hi : i ∈ s <;>
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, AdjointableOperator.add_apply,
      AdjointableOperator.neg_apply, AdjointableOperator.one_apply,
      cutProjection_apply_completedSingle, Set.mem_compl_iff, hi,
      not_true_eq_false, not_false_eq_true, ite_true, ite_false, neg_zero,
      add_zero, add_neg_cancel]

/-- A union of cuts satisfies the inclusion-exclusion formula. -/
theorem cutProjection_union (s t : Set I) :
    cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) (s ∪ t) =
      cutProjection s + cutProjection t - cutProjection (s ∩ t) := by
  classical
  apply adjointable_ext_completedSingle
  intro i x
  by_cases hs : i ∈ s <;> by_cases ht : i ∈ t <;>
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, AdjointableOperator.add_apply,
      AdjointableOperator.neg_apply, cutProjection_apply_completedSingle,
      Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff, hs, ht, ite_true, ite_false,
      and_true, and_false, or_true, or_false, add_zero, zero_add, neg_zero,
      add_assoc, add_neg_cancel]

/-- The complex linear span of the inclusions of the selected component modules. -/
def coordinateSpan (s : Set I) : Submodule ℂ (Completed B E) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : Σ i : s, E i.1 ↦
    completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) p.1.1 p.2)

/-- The cut acts identically on the closure of its selected coordinate span. -/
theorem cutProjection_eq_self_of_mem_closure_coordinateSpan
    (s : Set I) {x : Completed B E}
    (hx : x ∈ closure (coordinateSpan (B := B) (E := E) s : Set (Completed B E))) :
    cutProjection s x = x := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.eqOn_closure_span
    (f := (cutProjection s).toContinuousLinearMap)
    (g := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Completed B E)) ?_ hx
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, y⟩, rfl⟩
  exact (cutProjection_apply_completedSingle s i.1 y).trans (ite_eq_left i.2)

/-- Every cut value belongs to the closure of the selected coordinate span. -/
theorem cutProjection_mem_closure_coordinateSpan (s : Set I) (x : Completed B E) :
    cutProjection s x ∈
      closure (coordinateSpan (B := B) (E := E) s : Set (Completed B E)) := by
  classical
  let S := (coordinateSpan (B := B) (E := E) s).topologicalClosure
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : Σ i, E i ↦
      completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) p.1 p.2) ≤
        S.comap (cutProjection s).toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro _ ⟨⟨i, y⟩, rfl⟩
    change cutProjection s (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i y) ∈ S
    rw [cutProjection_apply_completedSingle]
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s
    · rw [ite_eq_left hi]
      apply (coordinateSpan s).le_topologicalClosure
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨⟨i, hi⟩, y⟩, rfl⟩
    · rw [ite_eq_right hi]
      exact S.zero_mem
  have hclosed : IsClosed
      (S.comap (cutProjection s).toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap : Set (Completed B E)) :=
    (Submodule.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).preimage
      (cutProjection s).toContinuousLinearMap.continuous
  exact closure_minimal hspan hclosed (dense_span_completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) x)

/-- The actual range is exactly the closure of the selected coordinate span. -/
theorem range_cutProjection (s : Set I) :
    Set.range (cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) s) =
      closure (coordinateSpan (B := B) (E := E) s : Set (Completed B E)) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact cutProjection_mem_closure_coordinateSpan s y
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨x, cutProjection_eq_self_of_mem_closure_coordinateSpan s hx⟩

/-- The range of a coordinate cut is closed. -/
theorem isClosed_range_cutProjection (s : Set I) :
    IsClosed (Set.range (cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) s)) := by
  rw [range_cutProjection]
  exact isClosed_closure

/-- Disjoint cuts have orthogonal ranges for the coefficient-valued inner product. -/
theorem rightInner_cutProjection_of_disjoint {s t : Set I} (h : Disjoint s t)
    (x y : Completed B E) :
    rightInner (B := B) (cutProjection s x) (cutProjection t y) = 0 := by
  rw [(cutProjection s).adjoint_inner]
  have hzero : (cutProjection (B := B) (E := E) s).adjoint (cutProjection t y) = 0 := by
    change star (cutProjection s) (cutProjection t y) = 0
    rw [star_cutProjection, ← AdjointableOperator.mul_apply,
      cutProjection_mul_of_disjoint h]
    exact AdjointableOperator.zero_apply y
  rw [hzero, rightInner_zero_right]

/-- The computed reflection is positive on the selected coordinates and negative elsewhere. -/
def cutInvolution (s : Set I) : AdjointableOperator.End B (Completed B E) :=
  2 * cutProjection s - 1

open Classical in
/-- The reflection acts by the literal signs fixed by the chosen cut. -/
theorem cutInvolution_apply_completedSingle (s : Set I) (i : I) (x : E i) :
    cutInvolution (B := B) (E := E) s (completedSingle i x) =
      if i ∈ s then completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x
        else -completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x := by
  classical
  by_cases hi : i ∈ s <;>
    simp only [cutInvolution, two_mul, sub_eq_add_neg,
      AdjointableOperator.add_apply, AdjointableOperator.neg_apply,
      AdjointableOperator.one_apply, cutProjection_apply_completedSingle,
      hi, ite_true, ite_false, zero_add, add_assoc, add_neg_cancel, add_zero]

/-- The reflection `2P - 1` is self-adjoint. -/
@[simp]
theorem star_cutInvolution (s : Set I) :
    star (cutInvolution (B := B) (E := E) s) = cutInvolution s := by
  simp only [cutInvolution, two_mul, star_sub, star_add, star_cutProjection, star_one]

/-- The actual reflection squares to the identity on the completion. -/
@[simp]
theorem cutInvolution_mul_self (s : Set I) :
    cutInvolution (B := B) (E := E) s * cutInvolution s = 1 := by
  classical
  apply adjointable_ext_completedSingle
  intro i x
  by_cases hi : i ∈ s <;>
    simp only [AdjointableOperator.mul_apply, cutInvolution_apply_completedSingle,
      hi, ite_true, ite_false, map_neg, neg_neg, AdjointableOperator.one_apply]

end Family

section Integer

variable {E : ℤ → Type uE}
variable [∀ n, NormedAddCommGroup (E n)] [∀ n, NormedSpace ℂ (E n)]
  [∀ n, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E n)] [∀ n, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E n)]

/-- The actual projection onto nonnegative degrees, with degree zero included. -/
def nonnegativeProjection : AdjointableOperator.End B (Completed B E) :=
  cutProjection (Set.Ici (0 : ℤ))

/-- Nonnegative degrees keep their values; strictly negative degrees are killed. -/
theorem nonnegativeProjection_apply_completedSingle (n : ℤ) (x : E n) :
    nonnegativeProjection (B := B) (E := E)
      (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) n x) =
      if 0 ≤ n then completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) n x else 0 := by
  classical
  simpa only [nonnegativeProjection, Set.mem_Ici] using
    (cutProjection_apply_completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) (Set.Ici (0 : ℤ)) n x)

/-- The nonnegative-degree projection is self-adjoint. -/
@[simp]
theorem star_nonnegativeProjection :
    star (nonnegativeProjection (B := B) (E := E)) = nonnegativeProjection :=
  star_cutProjection (Set.Ici (0 : ℤ))

/-- The nonnegative-degree projection is idempotent. -/
@[simp]
theorem nonnegativeProjection_mul_self :
    nonnegativeProjection (B := B) (E := E) * nonnegativeProjection =
      nonnegativeProjection :=
  cutProjection_mul_self (Set.Ici (0 : ℤ))

/-- The nonnegative-degree projection is contractive. -/
theorem norm_nonnegativeProjection_le :
    ‖nonnegativeProjection (B := B) (E := E)‖ ≤ 1 :=
  norm_cutProjection_le (Set.Ici (0 : ℤ))

/-- The range of the nonnegative projection is the closed span of its actual degrees. -/
theorem range_nonnegativeProjection :
    Set.range (nonnegativeProjection (B := B) (E := E)) =
      closure (coordinateSpan (B := B) (E := E) (Set.Ici (0 : ℤ)) :
        Set (Completed B E)) :=
  range_cutProjection (Set.Ici (0 : ℤ))

/-- The source's sign convention `2P - 1` on the integer-indexed completion. -/
def nonnegativeInvolution : AdjointableOperator.End B (Completed B E) :=
  2 * nonnegativeProjection - 1

/-- The boundary reflection is positive in degree zero and every positive degree. -/
theorem nonnegativeInvolution_apply_completedSingle (n : ℤ) (x : E n) :
    nonnegativeInvolution (B := B) (E := E)
      (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) n x) =
      if 0 ≤ n then completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) n x
        else -completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) n x := by
  classical
  simpa only [nonnegativeInvolution, nonnegativeProjection, cutInvolution, Set.mem_Ici] using
    (cutInvolution_apply_completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) (Set.Ici (0 : ℤ)) n x)

/-- The nonnegative reflection is self-adjoint. -/
@[simp]
theorem star_nonnegativeInvolution :
    star (nonnegativeInvolution (B := B) (E := E)) = nonnegativeInvolution :=
  star_cutInvolution (Set.Ici (0 : ℤ))

/-- The nonnegative reflection squares to the identity. -/
@[simp]
theorem nonnegativeInvolution_mul_self :
    nonnegativeInvolution (B := B) (E := E) * nonnegativeInvolution = 1 :=
  cutInvolution_mul_self (Set.Ici (0 : ℤ))

end Integer

end CStarModule.DirectSum

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.DirectSum.Completion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.DirectSum.AlgebraicDiagonal
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Adjointable.Completion
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.ContinuousLinearMap
import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.DirectSum.AlgebraicDiagonal.Bounded

/-!
# Bounded rectangular diagonals on actual completed module sums

The given rectangular family and its given adjoints first form one genuine
adjointable operator on the literal finite-support sums. Uniform bounds provide
continuity proofs only. The completed diagonal is then the stock completion of
that algebraic adjointable operator.

Original components may be incomplete and the index arbitrary or empty. The
norms and completed C-star-module structures are exactly the existing ones.
No alternate model, global dictionary or numeric operator choice is added.
-/

public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra RightActions

namespace CStarModule.DirectSum

universe uB uI uE uF

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {I : Type uI} {E : I → Type uE} {F : I → Type uF}
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (E i)]
  [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (F i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (F i)]
  [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (F i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (F i)]

/-- The actual completed diagonal of a given uniformly bounded rectangular
family. Bound witnesses occur only in continuity proofs, not operator values. -/
@[expose]
def completedDiagonal
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i))
    (hBound : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ i, ‖T i‖ ≤ c) :
    AdjointableOperator B (Completed B E) (Completed B F) := by
  let f0 : Algebraic B E →L[ℂ] Algebraic B F :=
    (algebraicDiagonal T).mkContinuousOfExistsBound (by
      rcases hBound with ⟨c, hc, hT⟩
      exact ⟨c, fun x ↦ algebraicDiagonal_norm_le T c hc hT x⟩)
  let g0 : Algebraic B F →L[ℂ] Algebraic B E :=
    (algebraicDiagonal (fun i ↦ (T i).adjointOperator)).mkContinuousOfExistsBound (by
      rcases hBound with ⟨c, hc, hT⟩
      have hAdjoint : ∀ i, ‖(T i).adjointOperator‖ ≤ c := by
        intro i
        simpa only [AdjointableOperator.norm_adjointOperator] using hT i
      exact ⟨c, fun y ↦ algebraicDiagonal_norm_le
        (fun i ↦ (T i).adjointOperator) c hc hAdjoint y⟩)
  have hPair : ∀ (x : Algebraic B E) (y : Algebraic B F),
      rightInner (B := B) (f0 x) y = rightInner (B := B) x (g0 y) := by
    intro x y
    change MulOpposite.unop
        (inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (algebraicDiagonal T x) y) =
      MulOpposite.unop
        (inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x
          (algebraicDiagonal (fun i ↦ (T i).adjointOperator) y))
    rw [inner_eq_algebraicInner, inner_eq_algebraicInner]
    exact congrArg MulOpposite.unop (algebraicDiagonal_adjoint_inner T x y)
  let algebraicOperator : AdjointableOperator B (Algebraic B E) (Algebraic B F) :=
    AdjointableOperator.ofAdjointPair f0 g0 hPair
  exact AdjointableOperator.completion algebraicOperator

/-- Every canonical algebraic image keeps the literal forward value. -/
theorem completedDiagonal_apply_coe
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i))
    (hBound : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ i, ‖T i‖ ≤ c) (x : Algebraic B E) :
    completedDiagonal T hBound (x : Completed B E) =
      (algebraicDiagonal T x : Completed B F) := by
  simp only [completedDiagonal, AdjointableOperator.completion_apply_coe,
    AdjointableOperator.ofAdjointPair_apply,
    LinearMap.mkContinuousOfExistsBound_apply]

/-- Every canonical algebraic image keeps the given adjoint family's value. -/
theorem completedDiagonal_adjoint_apply_coe
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i))
    (hBound : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ i, ‖T i‖ ≤ c) (y : Algebraic B F) :
    (completedDiagonal T hBound).adjoint (y : Completed B F) =
      (algebraicDiagonal (fun i ↦ (T i).adjointOperator) y : Completed B E) := by
  simp only [completedDiagonal,
    AdjointableOperator.completion_adjoint_apply_coe,
    AdjointableOperator.ofAdjointPair_adjoint,
    LinearMap.mkContinuousOfExistsBound_apply]

/-- The forward map acts on a coordinate inclusion by its given component. -/
theorem completedDiagonal_apply_completedSingle
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i))
    (hBound : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ i, ‖T i‖ ≤ c) (i : I) (x : E i) :
    completedDiagonal T hBound (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x) =
      completedSingle (B := B) (E := F) i (T i x) := by
  rw [completedSingle_apply, completedDiagonal_apply_coe,
    single_apply_eq_singleLinear, algebraicDiagonal_singleLinear,
    completedSingle_apply, single_apply_eq_singleLinear]

/-- The stored adjoint acts on a coordinate by the GIVEN component adjoint. -/
theorem completedDiagonal_adjoint_apply_completedSingle
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i))
    (hBound : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ i, ‖T i‖ ≤ c) (i : I) (y : F i) :
    (completedDiagonal T hBound).adjoint (completedSingle (B := B) (E := F) i y) =
      completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i ((T i).adjoint y) := by
  rw [completedSingle_apply, completedDiagonal_adjoint_apply_coe,
    single_apply_eq_singleLinear, algebraicDiagonal_singleLinear,
    AdjointableOperator.adjointOperator_apply,
    completedSingle_apply, single_apply_eq_singleLinear]

private theorem completedDiagonal_norm_apply_le
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i))
    (hBound : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ i, ‖T i‖ ≤ c)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ i, ‖T i‖ ≤ c) (x : Completed B E) :
    ‖completedDiagonal T hBound x‖ ≤ c * ‖x‖ := by
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x
    (isClosed_le (completedDiagonal T hBound).toContinuousLinearMap.continuous.norm
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm)) ?_
  intro a
  rw [completedDiagonal_apply_coe, UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe,
    UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe]
  exact algebraicDiagonal_norm_le T c hc hT a

/-- EVERY legitimate nonnegative component bound bounds the completed operator,
not merely one witness used internally to justify continuity. -/
theorem completedDiagonal_norm_le
    (T : ∀ i, AdjointableOperator B (E i) (F i))
    (hBound : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ i, ‖T i‖ ≤ c)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ i, ‖T i‖ ≤ c) :
    ‖completedDiagonal T hBound‖ ≤ c := by
  rw [AdjointableOperator.norm_eq]
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hc
    (completedDiagonal_norm_apply_le T hBound c hc hT)

end CStarModule.DirectSum

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.DirectSum.Completion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Generation
public import Mathlib.Logic.Encodable.Basic

/-!
# Countable generation of completed Hilbert-module direct sums

A countable direct sum of countably generated complete right modules is
countably generated.  The proof enumerates component generators and uses the
dense span of the literal completed coordinate inclusions.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open Set Topology
open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule.DirectSum

universe uB uI uE

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {I : Type uI} {E : I → Type uE}
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (E i)]
variable [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
variable [∀ i, CompleteSpace (E i)]

/-- A countable completed direct sum of countably generated components is
countably generated. -/
theorem isCountablyGenerated_completed
    [Countable I]
    (hE : ∀ i, CStarModule.IsCountablyGenerated (B := B) (E := E i)) :
    CStarModule.IsCountablyGenerated (B := B) (E := Completed B E) := by
  let gE : ∀ i, ℕ → E i := fun i ↦ Classical.choose (hE i)
  have hgE (i : I) :
      Dense (Submodule.span ℂ
        (Set.range fun p : ℕ × B ↦ gE i p.1 <• p.2) : Set (E i)) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (hE i)
  let _ : Encodable I := Encodable.ofCountable I
  let g : ℕ → Completed B E := fun n =>
    match (Encodable.decode n : Option (Σ i, ℕ)) with
    | some p => completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) p.1 (gE p.1 p.2)
    | none => 0
  let M : Submodule ℂ (Completed B E) :=
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : ℕ × B ↦ g p.1 <• p.2)
  let C : Submodule ℂ (Completed B E) := M.topologicalClosure
  have hCclosed : IsClosed (C : Set (Completed B E)) :=
    M.isClosed_topologicalClosure
  have hsingle (i : I) (x : E i) :
      completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x ∈ C := by
    let L := (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i).toContinuousLinearMap
    let U : Submodule ℂ (E i) := Submodule.comap L.toLinearMap C
    have hUclosed : IsClosed (U : Set (E i)) := by
      change IsClosed (L ⁻¹' (C : Set (Completed B E)))
      exact hCclosed.preimage L.continuous
    have hspan :
        Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : ℕ × B ↦ gE i p.1 <• p.2) ≤ U := by
      apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨⟨n, b⟩, rfl⟩
      apply Submodule.mem_comap.mpr
      change completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i (gE i n <• b) ∈ C
      rw [completedSingle_right_smul]
      let k := Encodable.encode (⟨i, n⟩ : Σ i, ℕ)
      have hg : g k =
          completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i (gE i n) := by
        simp [k, g, Encodable.encodek]
      rw [← hg]
      exact M.le_topologicalClosure
        (Submodule.subset_span ⟨(k, b), by
          simp [k, g, Encodable.encodek]⟩)
    have hUtop : (⊤ : Submodule ℂ (E i)) ≤ U := by
      rw [← Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mp (hgE i)]
      exact Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ hspan hUclosed
    exact Submodule.mem_comap.mp (hUtop (by trivial))
  refine ⟨g, Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr ?_⟩
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  let P : Submodule ℂ (Completed B E) :=
    Submodule.span ℂ
      (Set.range fun p : Σ i, E i ↦ completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) p.1 p.2)
  have hPC : P ≤ C := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact hsingle p.1 p.2
  have hPtop : P.topologicalClosure = ⊤ :=
    Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mp
      (dense_span_completedSingle (B := B) (E := E))
  have hCtop : C = ⊤ := by
    apply le_antisymm le_top
    rw [← hPtop]
    exact Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ hPC hCclosed
  change x ∈ C
  rw [hCtop]
  trivial

end CStarModule.DirectSum

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Grading.Module
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.DirectSum.Completion

/-!
# Gradings on completed Hilbert-module direct sums

A family of graded complete right modules induces the coordinatewise grading
on the literal finite-support sum and hence on its stock completion.  The
construction works for arbitrary, including empty, index types.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Set Topology
open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule.DirectSum

universe uB uI uE

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {gamma : CStarGrading B}
variable {I : Type uI} {E : I → Type uE}
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℂ (E i)]
variable [∀ i, SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)] [∀ i, CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (E i)]
variable [∀ i, CompleteSpace (E i)]

private def algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i)) :
    Algebraic B E ≃ₗ[ℂ] Algebraic B E :=
  (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := E)).trans <|
    (DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv fun i ↦
      (delta i).generator.toLinearEquiv).trans
        (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := E)).symm

omit [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ] in
private theorem toDFinsupp_algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (x : Algebraic B E) (i : I) :
    toDFinsupp (algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv delta x) i =
      (delta i).generator (toDFinsupp x i) :=
  rfl

omit [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ] in
private theorem support_algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (x : Algebraic B E) :
    support (algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv delta x) = support x := by
  classical
  ext i
  rw [mem_support_iff, mem_support_iff,
    toDFinsupp_algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv]
  constructor
  · intro h hx
    apply h
    simp [hx]
  · intro h hx
    apply h
    exact (delta i).generator.injective (by simpa using hx)

omit [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ] in
private theorem algebraicInner_generator
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (x y : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicInner (algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv delta x)
        (algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv delta y) =
      MulOpposite.op
        (gamma.generatorAut (MulOpposite.unop (algebraicInner x y))) := by
  classical
  rw [algebraicInner_eq_sum, algebraicInner_eq_sum,
    support_algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv]
  apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
  simp only [Finset.unop_sum, map_sum, MulOpposite.unop_op,
    toDFinsupp_algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simpa only [rightInner] using
    (delta i).generator_rightInner (toDFinsupp x i) (toDFinsupp y i)

/-- Coordinatewise grading generator on the algebraic finite-support sum. -/
@[no_expose]
def algebraicGenerator
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i)) :
    Algebraic B E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Algebraic B E where
  toLinearEquiv := algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv delta
  norm_map' x := by
    rw [norm_algebraic, norm_algebraic,
      algebraicInner_generator delta x x]
    simp only [MulOpposite.norm_unop, MulOpposite.norm_op,
      StarAlgEquiv.norm_map]

private theorem algebraicGenerator_apply
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (x : Algebraic B E) :
    algebraicGenerator delta x = algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv delta x :=
  rfl

theorem algebraicGenerator_single
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (i : I) (x : E i) :
    algebraicGenerator delta (single (B := B) (E := E) i x) =
      single (B := B) (E := E) i ((delta i).generator x) := by
  change algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv delta
      (single (B := B) (E := E) i x) = _
  apply (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := E)).injective
  ext j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    simp only [toDFinsupp_algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv,
      single_apply_same]
  · simp only [toDFinsupp_algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv,
      single_apply_ne hji, map_zero]

/-- Canonical simp-normal form of coordinatewise generation on an algebraic
single-coordinate vector. -/
@[simp]
theorem algebraicGenerator_singleLinear
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (i : I) (x : E i) :
    algebraicGenerator delta (singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x) =
      singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i ((delta i).generator x) := by
  simpa only [single_apply_eq_singleLinear] using
    algebraicGenerator_single delta i x

private def completedGeneratorCLM
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i)) :
    Completed B E →L[ℂ] Completed B E :=
  ((algebraicInclusion (B := B) (E := E)).toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (algebraicGenerator delta).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap).fromCompletion

@[simp]
private theorem completedGeneratorCLM_coe
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (x : Algebraic B E) :
    completedGeneratorCLM delta (x : Completed B E) =
      (algebraicGenerator delta x : Completed B E) := by
  rw [completedGeneratorCLM,
    ContinuousLinearMap.fromCompletion_apply_coe,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  change algebraicInclusion (algebraicGenerator delta x) = _
  rw [algebraicInclusion_apply]

private theorem norm_completedGeneratorCLM
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (x : Completed B E) :
    ‖completedGeneratorCLM delta x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x
    (isClosed_eq
      (continuous_norm.comp (completedGeneratorCLM delta).continuous)
      continuous_norm) ?_
  intro y
  rw [completedGeneratorCLM_coe,
    UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe,
    UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe]
  exact (algebraicGenerator delta).norm_map y

private def completedGeneratorIsometry
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i)) :
    Completed B E →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Completed B E where
  toLinearMap := (completedGeneratorCLM delta).toLinearMap
  norm_map' := norm_completedGeneratorCLM delta

@[simp]
private theorem completedGeneratorIsometry_coe
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (x : Algebraic B E) :
    completedGeneratorIsometry delta (x : Completed B E) =
      (algebraicGenerator delta x : Completed B E) := by
  change completedGeneratorCLM delta (x : Completed B E) = _
  rw [completedGeneratorCLM_coe]

private theorem completedGeneratorIsometry_involutive
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i)) :
    Function.Involutive (completedGeneratorIsometry delta) := by
  intro x
  let G := completedGeneratorIsometry delta
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x
    (isClosed_eq (G.continuous.comp G.continuous) continuous_id) ?_
  intro y
  simp only [completedGeneratorIsometry_coe]
  simp only [algebraicGenerator_apply]
  apply congrArg (fun z : Algebraic B E => (z : Completed B E))
  apply (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := E)).injective
  ext i
  rw [toDFinsupp_algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv,
    toDFinsupp_algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv]
  exact (delta i).generator_involutive (toDFinsupp y i)

/-- Coordinatewise grading generator on the completed direct sum. -/
@[no_expose]
def completedGenerator
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i)) :
    Completed B E ≃L[ℂ] Completed B E where
  toFun := completedGeneratorIsometry delta
  invFun := completedGeneratorIsometry delta
  left_inv := completedGeneratorIsometry_involutive delta
  right_inv := completedGeneratorIsometry_involutive delta
  map_add' := map_add (completedGeneratorIsometry delta)
  map_smul' := map_smul (completedGeneratorIsometry delta)
  continuous_toFun := (completedGeneratorIsometry delta).continuous
  continuous_invFun := (completedGeneratorIsometry delta).continuous

private theorem completedGenerator_apply
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (x : Completed B E) :
    completedGenerator delta x = completedGeneratorIsometry delta x :=
  rfl

theorem completedGenerator_single
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (i : I) (x : E i) :
    completedGenerator delta (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x) =
      completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i ((delta i).generator x) := by
  rw [completedSingle_apply, completedSingle_apply]
  change completedGeneratorIsometry delta
      ((single (B := B) (E := E) i x : Algebraic B E) : Completed B E) = _
  rw [completedGeneratorIsometry_coe, algebraicGenerator_single]

/-- Canonical simp-normal form of the completed generator on an embedded
algebraic single-coordinate vector. -/
@[simp]
theorem completedGenerator_singleLinear
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (i : I) (x : E i) :
    completedGenerator delta
        ((singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x : Algebraic B E) : Completed B E) =
      ((singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i ((delta i).generator x) :
        Algebraic B E) : Completed B E) := by
  change completedGeneratorIsometry delta
      ((singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x : Algebraic B E) : Completed B E) = _
  rw [completedGeneratorIsometry_coe, algebraicGenerator_singleLinear]

/-- The completed direct sum carries the coordinatewise module grading. -/
@[no_expose]
def grading
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i)) :
    CStarModuleGrading gamma (Completed B E) where
  generator := completedGenerator delta
  generator_involutive := completedGeneratorIsometry_involutive delta
  generator_right_smul := by
    intro x b
    let G := completedGenerator delta
    have hl : Continuous fun z : Completed B E => G (z <• b) :=
      G.continuous.comp (CStarModule.continuous_right_smul_const b)
    have hr : Continuous fun z : Completed B E => G z <• gamma.generatorAut b :=
      (CStarModule.continuous_right_smul_const (gamma.generatorAut b)).comp
        G.continuous
    refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x (isClosed_eq hl hr) ?_
    intro y
    simp only [completedGenerator_apply]
    change completedGeneratorIsometry delta
        (((y : Algebraic B E) : Completed B E) <• b) =
      completedGeneratorIsometry delta (y : Completed B E) <•
        gamma.generatorAut b
    rw [← CStarModule.coe_completion_coeff_smul
        (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (E := Algebraic B E),
      completedGeneratorIsometry_coe, completedGeneratorIsometry_coe,
      ← CStarModule.coe_completion_coeff_smul
        (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (E := Algebraic B E)]
    apply congrArg (fun z : Algebraic B E => (z : Completed B E))
    change algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv delta (y <• b) =
      algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv delta y <• gamma.generatorAut b
    apply (toDFinsupp (B := B) (E := E)).injective
    ext i
    rw [toDFinsupp_algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv,
      toDFinsupp_right_smul, (delta i).generator_right_smul,
      toDFinsupp_right_smul,
      toDFinsupp_algebraicGeneratorLinearEquiv]
  generator_rightInner := by
    intro x y
    let G := completedGenerator delta
    have hl : Continuous fun p : Completed B E × Completed B E =>
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) (G p.1) (G p.2) :=
      CStarModule.continuous_rightInner.comp
        ((G.continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
          (G.continuous.comp continuous_snd))
    have hr : Continuous fun p : Completed B E × Completed B E =>
        gamma.generatorAut (CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) p.1 p.2) :=
      (StarAlgEquiv.isometry gamma.generatorAut).continuous.comp
        CStarModule.continuous_rightInner
    refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on₂ x y (isClosed_eq hl hr) ?_
    intro a b
    simp only [completedGenerator_apply]
    change CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
        (completedGeneratorIsometry delta (a : Completed B E))
        (completedGeneratorIsometry delta (b : Completed B E)) =
      gamma.generatorAut
        (CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          (a : Completed B E) (b : Completed B E))
    rw [completedGeneratorIsometry_coe,
      completedGeneratorIsometry_coe]
    simp only [CStarModule.rightInner,
      CStarModule.completionCStarModule_inner_coe_coe,
      inner_eq_algebraicInner]
    simp only [algebraicGenerator_apply]
    rw [algebraicInner_generator]
    rfl

private theorem grading_generator
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i)) :
    (grading delta).generator = completedGenerator delta :=
  rfl

theorem grading_generator_completedSingle
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (i : I) (x : E i) :
    (grading delta).generator (completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i x) =
      completedSingle (B := B) (E := E) i ((delta i).generator x) :=
  by
    rw [grading_generator, completedGenerator_single]

/-- Canonical simp-normal form of the completed direct-sum grading on an
embedded algebraic single-coordinate vector. -/
@[simp]
theorem grading_generator_singleLinear
    (delta : ∀ i, CStarModuleGrading gamma (E i))
    (i : I) (x : E i) :
    (grading delta).generator
        ((singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i x : Algebraic B E) : Completed B E) =
      ((singleLinear (B := B) (E := E) i ((delta i).generator x) :
        Algebraic B E) : Completed B E) := by
  rw [grading_generator, completedGenerator_singleLinear]

end CStarModule.DirectSum

Author: @toskua

module


public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Generation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Unitary

/-!
# Countable generation transported by a module unitary

A countable right-coefficient generating sequence remains generating after a
unitary module equivalence. The proof transports the dense span through the
actual continuous linear equivalence; no dense-range output is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open Set Topology
open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule.IsCountablyGenerated

universe uB uE uF

variable {B : Type uB} {E : Type uE} {F : Type uF}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
  [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CompleteSpace E]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ F]
  [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ F] [CompleteSpace F]

/-- Countable generation is preserved by a unitary equivalence of right
C-star modules. -/
theorem unitaryEquiv
    (hE : CStarModule.IsCountablyGenerated (B := B) (E := E))
    (U : CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv B E F) :
    CStarModule.IsCountablyGenerated (B := B) (E := F) := by
  rcases hE with ⟨g, hg⟩
  let gF : ℕ → F := fun n => U (g n)
  let M : Submodule ℂ F :=
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : ℕ × B => gF p.1 <• p.2)
  let C : Submodule ℂ F := M.topologicalClosure
  have hCclosed : IsClosed (C : Set F) := M.isClosed_topologicalClosure
  let P : Submodule ℂ E :=
    Submodule.comap U.toAdjointable.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap C
  have hPclosed : IsClosed (P : Set E) := by
    change IsClosed (U ⁻¹' (C : Set F))
    exact hCclosed.preimage U.isometry.continuous
  have hspan :
      Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : ℕ × B => g p.1 <• p.2) ≤ P := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨⟨n, b⟩, rfl⟩
    apply Submodule.mem_comap.mpr
    change U.toAdjointable (g n <• b) ∈ C
    rw [U.toAdjointable.map_right_smul]
    exact M.le_topologicalClosure
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨(n, b), rfl⟩)
  have hPtop : (⊤ : Submodule ℂ E) ≤ P := by
    rw [← Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mp hg]
    exact Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ hspan hPclosed
  refine ⟨gF, Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr ?_⟩
  apply top_unique
  intro y _hy
  have hy : U (U.symm y) ∈ C :=
    Submodule.mem_comap.mp (hPtop (show U.symm y ∈ (⊤ : Submodule ℂ E) by trivial))
  rwa [U.apply_symm_apply] at hy

end CStarModule.IsCountablyGenerated
