public import MathlibExt.Algebra.Star.StarAlgHom
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.Basic

/-!
# The actual algebraic A tensor K(full H) star homomorphism

The neutral complex tensor universal map lifts the original bilinear product
of the coefficient and full-H compact factor actions. Their actual commutation
proves multiplication and genuine adjoints prove the star law. The previously
constructed arbitrary compact product puts every original pure tensor in the
actual compact module ideal; linearity gives the whole algebraic tensor image.

The resulting nonunital star-algebra homomorphism has the actual CompactAlgebra
H A target, with original pure formula Txi tensor ab. This is the algebraic
constructor needed for Blackadar10.1.2's original A tensor K(L2G) output. The
spatial minimum completion and terminal Takai theorem remain separate work.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions TensorProduct
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- Lift the literal compact elementary product by the neutral complex tensor universal map. -/
def algebraicTensorOperator :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier →ₗ[ℂ]
      AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact TensorProduct.lift
    { toFun := fun a =>
        { toFun := fun T => (compactElementaryOperator H A a T :
            AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A))
          map_add' := fun T U => by
            simp only [compactElementaryOperator_coe, map_add, mul_add]
          map_smul' := fun c T => by
            simp only [compactElementaryOperator_coe, map_smul]
            exact mul_smul_comm c (coefficientHom H A a) (compactHilbertHom H A T) }
      map_add' := fun a b => by
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro T
        change (compactElementaryOperator H A (a + b) T : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A)) =
          (compactElementaryOperator H A a T : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A)) +
            (compactElementaryOperator H A b T : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A))
        simp only [compactElementaryOperator_coe, map_add, add_mul]
      map_smul' := fun c a => by
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro T
        change (compactElementaryOperator H A (c • a) T : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A)) =
          c • (compactElementaryOperator H A a T : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A))
        simp only [compactElementaryOperator_coe, map_smul, smul_mul_assoc] }

/-- The neutral universal lift retains the exact original compact elementary tensor value. -/
theorem algebraicTensorOperator_tmul (a : A)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    algebraicTensorOperator H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) =
      (compactElementaryOperator H A a T : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A)) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  rfl

/-- Actual factor commutation gives the original algebraic tensor multiplication law. -/
theorem algebraicTensorOperator_mul
    (z w : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    algebraicTensorOperator H A (z * w) =
      algebraicTensorOperator H A z * algebraicTensorOperator H A w := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a T =>
    induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul b U =>
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, algebraicTensorOperator_tmul,
        algebraicTensorOperator_tmul, algebraicTensorOperator_tmul]
      simp only [compactElementaryOperator_coe, map_mul]
      have hSwap : coefficientHom H A b * compactHilbertHom H A T =
          compactHilbertHom H A T * coefficientHom H A b :=
        (compactHilbertHom_commutes_coefficientHom H A T b).eq.symm
      calc
        (coefficientHom H A a * coefficientHom H A b) *
            (compactHilbertHom H A T * compactHilbertHom H A U) =
          coefficientHom H A a * (coefficientHom H A b * compactHilbertHom H A T) *
            compactHilbertHom H A U := by simp only [mul_assoc]
        _ = coefficientHom H A a * (compactHilbertHom H A T * coefficientHom H A b) *
            compactHilbertHom H A U := by rw [hSwap]
        _ = (coefficientHom H A a * compactHilbertHom H A T) *
            (coefficientHom H A b * compactHilbertHom H A U) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    | add w w' hw hw' => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hw, hw']
  | add z z' hz hz' => simp only [add_mul, map_add, hz, hz']

/-- The genuine factor adjoints preserve the original algebraic tensor involution. -/
theorem algebraicTensorOperator_star
    (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    algebraicTensorOperator H A (star z) = star (algebraicTensorOperator H A z) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a T =>
    rw [TensorProduct.star_tmul, algebraicTensorOperator_tmul, algebraicTensorOperator_tmul]
    simp only [compactElementaryOperator_coe, star_mul]
    simpa only [map_star] using
      (compactHilbertHom_commutes_coefficientHom H A (star T) (star a)).eq.symm
  | add z w hz hw => simp only [star_add, map_add, hz, hw]

/-- Every original algebraic tensor has actual compact module image. -/
theorem algebraicTensorOperator_mem_compact
    (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    algebraicTensorOperator H A z ∈
      AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule (B := A) (E := Space H A) (F := Space H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a T =>
    rw [algebraicTensorOperator_tmul]
    exact (compactElementaryOperator H A a T).property
  | add z w hz hw =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hz hw

/-- The actual algebraic A tensor K(full H) nonunital star homomorphism into its compact module target. -/
def algebraicCompactTensorHom :
    A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CompactAlgebra H A := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.codRestrict
    (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ofLinearMap (algebraicTensorOperator H A)
      (algebraicTensorOperator_mul H A) (algebraicTensorOperator_star H A))
    (AdjointableOperator.compactStarSubalgebra (B := A) (E := Space H A))
    (fun z => by
      change algebraicTensorOperator H A z ∈
        AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule (B := A) (E := Space H A) (F := Space H A)
      exact algebraicTensorOperator_mem_compact H A z)

/-- The actual tensor star homomorphism retains each original compact elementary value. -/
theorem algebraicCompactTensorHom_tmul (a : A)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    algebraicCompactTensorHom H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) = compactElementaryOperator H A a T := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  apply Subtype.ext
  change algebraicTensorOperator H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) =
    (compactElementaryOperator H A a T : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A))
  exact algebraicTensorOperator_tmul H A a T

/-- The actual algebraic tensor target acts by the original full-H elementary tensor formula. -/
theorem algebraicCompactTensorHom_pure (a : A)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) (ξ : H) (b : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A))
        (pure H A ξ b) = pure H A ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) (a * b) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  rw [algebraicCompactTensorHom_tmul]
  change (coefficientHom H A a * compactHilbertHom H A T) (pure H A ξ b) =
    pure H A ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) (a * b)
  rw [AdjointableOperator.mul_apply, compactHilbertHom_pure, coefficientHom_pure]

end

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

/-!
# The actual Hilbert amplification of a nonunital coefficient algebra

The carrier is the literal balanced internal tensor completion of the original
complex Hilbert space with the coefficient self module. Its norm, complex
module, coefficient action and inner product are the existing radical and stock
completion data. Compact endomorphisms retain that actual operator norm.

This construction does not identify the compact algebra with a minimum tensor
until the genuine elementary action and norm/density comparison are supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original Hilbert space internally tensored over ℂ with the coefficient
self module, through the actual balancing/radical quotients and completion. -/
abbrev Space : Type (max uH uA) := by
  letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  letI : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  letI : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  letI : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  letI : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  exact CompletedTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)

/-- The existing radical norm followed by its stock completion norm. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def spaceNormedAddCommGroup : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := by
  letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  letI : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  letI : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  letI : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  letI : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)

  letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ

/-- The original coefficient-valued pure-tensor inner formula. -/
theorem rightInner_pure (ξ η : H) (a b : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    rightInner (B := A) (pure H A ξ a) (pure H A η b) =
      inner ℂ ξ η • (star a * b) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  have : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  have hscalar (c : ℂ) (x : A) : scalarSelfHom A c x = c • x := rfl
  have hinner : rightInner (B := ℂ) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ)
      ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm η) = inner ℂ ξ η := by
    rw [ScalarRight.rightInner_apply]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change rightInner (B := A)
      (completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) a)
      (completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm η) b) = _
  rw [rightInner_completedPure, hinner, hscalar, CStarModule.Right.rightInner_self,
    mul_smul_comm]

/-- The computed pure norm is the product of the original two factor norms. -/
theorem norm_pure (ξ : H) (a : A) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    ‖pure H A ξ a‖ = ‖ξ‖ * ‖a‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  have : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg (pure H A ξ a))
    (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg ξ) (norm_nonneg a))).mp
  rw [← CStarModule.norm_rightInner_self (B := A), rightInner_pure,
    norm_smul, ← inner_self_re_eq_norm, inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
    CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self]
  ring

/-- The actual norm-closed compact endomorphisms of the original amplification. -/
abbrev CompactAlgebra : Type (max uH uA) := by
  letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ

  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=

  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=

  letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=

/-!
# The actual coefficient action on Hilbert amplification

Left multiplication on the original nonunital coefficient self module commutes
with the literal scalar representation. The already constructed completed
second-factor operator therefore acts on the original Hilbert amplification.
Its pure-tensor value multiplies the coefficient in its original order, and
its stored adjoint multiplies by the genuine coefficient adjoint.

This supplies the coefficient factor of the elementary tensor action needed
for Blackadar, K-Theory for Operator Algebras, Theorem 10.1.2. The minimum tensor
norm, compact range identification and Takai isomorphism are separate statements.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

/-- Original coefficient left multiplication commutes with the literal scalar self representation. -/
theorem leftMul_commutes_scalarSelfHom
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] (a : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ c : ℂ, Commute (AdjointableOperator.leftMul (B := A) a) (scalarSelfHom A c) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  intro c
  change AdjointableOperator.leftMul a * scalarSelfHom A c =
    scalarSelfHom A c * AdjointableOperator.leftMul a
  apply AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro b
  change a * (c • b) = c • (a * b)
  exact mul_smul_comm c a b

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The coefficient acts through actual left multiplication on the original second factor. -/
def coefficientOperator (a : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact completedRightOperator (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
    (AdjointableOperator.leftMul (B := A) a) (leftMul_commutes_scalarSelfHom A a)

/-- The original Hilbert vector stays fixed while its coefficient is multiplied on the left. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientOperator_pure (a : A) (ξ : H) (b : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    coefficientOperator H A a (pure H A ξ b) = pure H A ξ (a * b) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  change completedRightOperator (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
      (AdjointableOperator.leftMul (B := A) a) (leftMul_commutes_scalarSelfHom A a)
      (completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) b) =
    completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) (a * b)
  simpa only [AdjointableOperator.leftMul_apply] using
    completedRightOperator_pure (scalarSelfHom A) (AdjointableOperator.leftMul (B := A) a)
      (leftMul_commutes_scalarSelfHom A a) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) b

/-- The stored genuine adjoint multiplies the coefficient by the original coefficient adjoint. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientOperator_adjoint_pure (a : A) (ξ : H) (b : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    (coefficientOperator H A a).adjoint (pure H A ξ b) = pure H A ξ (star a * b) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  change (completedRightOperator (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
      (AdjointableOperator.leftMul (B := A) a) (leftMul_commutes_scalarSelfHom A a)).adjoint
      (completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) b) =
    completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) (star a * b)
  exact completedRightOperator_adjoint_pure (scalarSelfHom A)
      (AdjointableOperator.leftMul (B := A) a) (leftMul_commutes_scalarSelfHom A a)
      ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) b

/-- The actual completed coefficient action is bounded by the original coefficient norm. -/
theorem coefficientOperator_norm_le (a : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    ‖coefficientOperator H A a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  have hleft : ‖AdjointableOperator.leftMul (B := A) a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := by
    rw [AdjointableOperator.norm_eq]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_mul_apply_le ℂ A a
  exact (completedRightOperator_norm_le (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
    (AdjointableOperator.leftMul (B := A) a) (leftMul_commutes_scalarSelfHom A a)).trans hleft

end

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.CoefficientAction

/-!
# The actual coefficient star homomorphism on Hilbert amplification

The computed coefficient operators preserve the original zero, addition,
product, complex scalar and adjoint operations. Their original pure-vector
values prove these constructor laws on the actual completed tensor because
those vectors have dense complex span.

The resulting nonunital star-algebra homomorphism is the coefficient factor
needed to construct the original elementary A tensor K(H) action in Blackadar,
K-Theory for Operator Algebras, Theorem10.1.2. No tensor homomorphism, compact
image, minimum tensor model or Takai theorem is assumed or constructed here.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- Actual adjointable amplification operators are determined by their original pure values. -/
theorem operator_ext_pure :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    ∀ {S T : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A)},
      (∀ ξ : H, ∀ b : A, S (pure H A ξ b) = T (pure H A ξ b)) → S = T := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  intro S T h
  have hMaps : S.toContinuousLinearMap = T.toContinuousLinearMap := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_on
      (completedPure_dense_span (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A))
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, b⟩, rfl⟩
    have hx : completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) x b =
        pure H A (ScalarRight.equivL H x) b := by
      change completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) x b =
        completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (ScalarRight.equivL H x)) b
      rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    change S (completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) x b) =
      T (completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) x b)
    rw [hx]
    exact h (ScalarRight.equivL H x) b
  apply AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro z
  exact congrArg (fun f : Space H A →L[ℂ] Space H A => f z) hMaps

/-- The original coefficient operators bundled with their proved algebra and genuine adjoint laws. -/
def coefficientHom :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact
    { toFun := coefficientOperator H A
      map_zero' := by
        apply operator_ext_pure H A
        intro ξ b
        rw [coefficientOperator_pure, zero_mul, AdjointableOperator.zero_apply]
        change completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) 0 = 0
        simp only [completedPure, balancedPure_zero_right, map_zero]
      map_add' := fun a c => by
        apply operator_ext_pure H A
        intro ξ b
        rw [coefficientOperator_pure, AdjointableOperator.add_apply,
          coefficientOperator_pure, coefficientOperator_pure, add_mul]
        change completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) (a * b + c * b) =
          completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) (a * b) +
            completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) (c * b)
        exact completedPure_add_right (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) (a * b) (c * b)
      map_mul' := fun a c => by
        apply operator_ext_pure H A
        intro ξ b
        simp only [coefficientOperator_pure, AdjointableOperator.mul_apply, mul_assoc]
      map_smul' := fun c a => by
        apply operator_ext_pure H A
        intro ξ b
        rw [coefficientOperator_pure, AdjointableOperator.smul_apply,
          coefficientOperator_pure, smul_mul_assoc]
        change completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) (c • (a * b)) =
          c • completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) (a * b)
        exact completedPure_smul_right (scalarSelfHom A) c ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) (a * b)
      map_star' := fun a => by
        apply operator_ext_pure H A
        intro ξ b
        rw [coefficientOperator_pure, AdjointableOperator.star_apply, coefficientOperator_adjoint_pure] }

/-- The actual coefficient homomorphism keeps the original completed coefficient operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientHom_apply (a : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    coefficientHom H A a = coefficientOperator H A a := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  rfl

/-- The bundled homomorphism has the literal elementary coefficient value on original pure vectors. -/
theorem coefficientHom_pure (a : A) (ξ : H) (b : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    coefficientHom H A a (pure H A ξ b) = pure H A ξ (a * b) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact coefficientOperator_pure H A a ξ b

end

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.ElementaryCompacts
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.CompactOperator.BasisApproximation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Operator.FiniteCoordinateExpansion

/-!
# Actual finite Hilbert-basis compressions of full-H compact operators

Reuse the stock finite projections of an arbitrary Hilbert basis. The
already proved compact-sandwich theorem supplies operator-norm convergence
of the diagonal finite-set net. Package those actual maps in the original
compact ideal, retaining their original matrix-entry rank-one values.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter
open scoped BigOperators InnerProductSpace Topology

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

universe uH uI
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {ι : Type uI} (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ H)

/-- The actual two-sided finite projection compression as a linear map of the full compact ideal. -/
def compactCompression (s : Finset ι) :
    (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier →ₗ[ℂ]
      (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier where
  toFun k :=
    ⟨(b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s).comp ((k : H →L[ℂ] H).comp (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s)),
      (k.property.comp_clm (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s)).clm_comp (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s)⟩
  map_add' k l := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s).comp
        (((k : H →L[ℂ] H) + (l : H →L[ℂ] H)).comp (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s)) = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.add_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_add]
    rfl
  map_smul' c k := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s).comp
        ((c • (k : H →L[ℂ] H)).comp (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s)) = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_smul]
    rfl

/-- Compact compression retains exactly the original operator composition. -/
@[simp]
theorem compactCompression_coe (s : Finset ι)
    (k : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    (compactCompression b s k : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s).comp ((k : H →L[ℂ] H).comp (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s)) := rfl

/-- The original compact operator norm bounds every finite compression. -/
theorem norm_compactCompression_le (s : Finset ι)
    (k : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    ‖compactCompression b s k‖ ≤ ‖k‖ := by
  change ‖(b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s).comp
      ((k : H →L[ℂ] H).comp (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s))‖ ≤ ‖(k : H →L[ℂ] H)‖
  exact HilbertBasis.norm_sandwich_le b b (k : H →L[ℂ] H) s s

/-- Forward the existing compact-sandwich convergence along the diagonal finite-subset net. -/
theorem compactCompression_tendsto
    (k : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    Tendsto (fun s : Finset ι => compactCompression b s k) atTop (𝓝 k) := by
  classical
  have hdiag : Tendsto (fun s : Finset ι => (s, s)) atTop atTop := by
    rw [← prod_atTop_atTop_eq]
    exact tendsto_id.prodMk tendsto_id
  have h := (b.tendsto_compact_sandwich b k.property).comp hdiag
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have hεEvent := Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp h ε hε
  filter_upwards [hεEvent] with s hs
  change dist ((b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s).comp
    ((k : H →L[ℂ] H).comp (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj s))) (k : H →L[ℂ] H) < ε
  exact hs

/-- The actual compression has exactly its original finite-frame matrix-entry rank-one expansion. -/
theorem compactCompression_eq_sum (s : Finset ι)
    (k : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    compactCompression b s k =
      ∑ i : s, ∑ j : s,
        inner ℂ (b (i : ι)) ((k : H →L[ℂ] H) (b (j : ι))) •
          hilbertCompactRankOne H (b (i : ι)) (b (j : ι)) := by
  have hcoe :
      (((∑ i : s, ∑ j : s,
        inner ℂ (b (i : ι)) ((k : H →L[ℂ] H) (b (j : ι))) •
          hilbertCompactRankOne H (b (i : ι)) (b (j : ι))) :
          (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) : H →L[ℂ] H) =
        ∑ i : s, ∑ j : s,
          inner ℂ (b (i : ι)) ((k : H →L[ℂ] H) (b (j : ι))) •
            InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b (i : ι)) (b (j : ι)) := by
    change NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype (R := ℂ)
        (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier
        (∑ i : s, ∑ j : s,
          inner ℂ (b (i : ι)) ((k : H →L[ℂ] H) (b (j : ι))) •
            hilbertCompactRankOne H (b (i : ι)) (b (j : ι))) = _
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype_apply,
      hilbertCompactRankOne_coe]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [compactCompression_coe, hcoe]
  have hsum :
      (∑ j : s, ∑ i : s,
        inner ℂ (b (j : ι)) ((k : H →L[ℂ] H) (b (i : ι))) •
          InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b (j : ι)) (b (i : ι))) =
        ∑ j ∈ s, ∑ i ∈ s,
          inner ℂ (b j) ((k : H →L[ℂ] H) (b i)) •
            InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b j) (b i) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : s, ∑ i ∈ s,
          inner ℂ (b (j : ι)) ((k : H →L[ℂ] H) (b i)) •
            InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b (j : ι)) (b i) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        exact Finset.sum_coe_sort s (fun i : ι =>
          inner ℂ (b (j : ι)) ((k : H →L[ℂ] H) (b i)) •
            InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b (j : ι)) (b i))
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_coe_sort s (fun j : ι => ∑ i ∈ s,
        inner ℂ (b j) ((k : H →L[ℂ] H) (b i)) •
          InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b j) (b i))
  exact (HilbertBasis.proj_comp_proj_eq_sum_rankOne b b (k : H →L[ℂ] H) s s).trans hsum.symm

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

/-!
# The actual arbitrary coefficient and full-H compact product image

The original elementary rank-one identity gives compact image for coefficient
products a * star e. The genuine approximate unit converges to each original
coefficient, and the same coefficient representation is continuous. Then the
actual norm closure of full-H Hilbert rank-one spans and continuity of the
original factor action give compact image for every actual compact T.

The resulting value is in the existing CompactAlgebra H A. No compactness,
output model or norm identity is supplied as a premise. This is a constructor
prerequisite for the actual algebraic A tensor K(full H) map in Blackadar10.1.2;
its minimum completion and the terminal Takai theorem are separate obligations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions Topology
open Filter CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original Hilbert rank-one factor has compact module image for every original coefficient. -/
theorem coefficient_hilbertRankOne_mem_compact_allCoefficients (a : A) (ξ η : H) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    coefficientHom H A a * hilbertOperator H A (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ ξ η) ∈
      AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule (B := A) (E := Space H A) (F := Space H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  let : CompleteSpace (Space H A) := by
    exact inferInstanceAs
      (CompleteSpace (CompletedTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)))
  let : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  let : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  have hmul : Tendsto (fun e : A => a * e) (CStarAlgebra.approximateUnit A) (nhds a) :=
    (CStarAlgebra.increasingApproximateUnit (A := A)).tendsto_mul_left a
  have hcoef : Tendsto (fun e : A => a * star e) (CStarAlgebra.approximateUnit A) (nhds a) := by
    apply hmul.congr'
    filter_upwards [(CStarAlgebra.increasingApproximateUnit (A := A)).eventually_star_eq] with e he
    rw [he]
  have hOperators : Tendsto
      (fun e : A => coefficientHom H A (a * star e) *
        hilbertOperator H A (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ ξ η))
      (CStarAlgebra.approximateUnit A)
      (nhds (coefficientHom H A a * hilbertOperator H A (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ ξ η))) :=
    (((map_continuous (coefficientHom H A)).tendsto a).comp hcoef).mul tendsto_const_nhds
  have hmem : coefficientHom H A a * hilbertOperator H A (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ ξ η) ∈
      closure (AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule
        (B := A) (E := Space H A) (F := Space H A) :
          Set (AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A))) :=
    mem_closure_of_tendsto hOperators (Eventually.of_forall fun e =>
      coefficient_hilbertRankOne_mem_compact H A ξ η a e)
  rw [(AdjointableOperator.isClosed_compactSubmodule
    (B := A) (E := Space H A) (F := Space H A)).closure_eq] at hmem
  exact hmem

/-- Every original compact Hilbert operator has actual compact module image with every coefficient. -/
theorem coefficient_hilbertOperator_mem_compact (a : A) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : IsCompactOperator T) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    coefficientHom H A a * hilbertOperator H A T ∈
      AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule (B := A) (E := Space H A) (F := Space H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  let : CompleteSpace (Space H A) := by
    exact inferInstanceAs
      (CompleteSpace (CompletedTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)))
  let K : Submodule ℂ (AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A)) :=
    AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule (B := A) (E := Space H A) (F := Space H A)
  let F : (H →L[ℂ] H) →ₗ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A) :=
    { toFun := fun U => coefficientHom H A a * hilbertHom H A U
      map_add' := fun U V => by rw [map_add, mul_add]
      map_smul' := fun c U => by
        rw [map_smul]
        exact mul_smul_comm c (coefficientHom H A a) (hilbertHom H A U) }
  let S : Submodule ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) := K.comap F
  have hF : Continuous F := by
    change Continuous (fun U : H →L[ℂ] H => coefficientHom H A a * hilbertHom H A U)
    exact continuous_const.mul (map_continuous (hilbertHom H A))
  have hSclosed : IsClosed (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
    change IsClosed (F ⁻¹' (K : Set (AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A))))
    exact (AdjointableOperator.isClosed_compactSubmodule
      (B := A) (E := Space H A) (F := Space H A)).preimage hF
  have hspan : InnerProductSpace.finiteRankSubmodule (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := H) ≤ S := by
    change Submodule.span ℂ
      (Set.range fun p : H × H => InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ p.1 p.2) ≤ S
    apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro _ ⟨⟨ξ, η⟩, rfl⟩
    change coefficientHom H A a * hilbertHom H A (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ ξ η) ∈ K
    simpa only [hilbertHom_apply] using
      coefficient_hilbertRankOne_mem_compact_allCoefficients H A a ξ η
  have hTcl := hT.mem_topologicalClosure_finiteRankSubmodule (𝕜 := ℂ)
  change T ∈ closure (InnerProductSpace.finiteRankSubmodule
    (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := H) : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) at hTcl
  have hClosure : closure (InnerProductSpace.finiteRankSubmodule
      (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := H) : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ⊆ S :=
    closure_minimal (fun U hU => hspan hU) hSclosed
  have hmem : T ∈ S := hClosure hTcl
  change coefficientHom H A a * hilbertHom H A T ∈ K at hmem
  simpa only [hilbertHom_apply] using hmem

/-- The two original algebraic tensor factors have actual compact module product image. -/
theorem coefficient_compactHilbertHom_mem_compact (a : A)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;

    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=

  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=

  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A

/-- Compute the original arbitrary coefficient/compact product in the actual compact algebra. -/
def compactElementaryOperator (a : A)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) : CompactAlgebra H A := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ

  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H

      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=

  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=

  exact ⟨coefficientHom H A a * compactHilbertHom H A T,

/-- The computed compact element keeps the literal original product of the two factors. -/
theorem compactElementaryOperator_coe (a : A)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;

  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H

  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)

    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H

  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.AlgebraicTensorHom

import Mathlib.Topology.Constructions
import Mathlib.Topology.Maps.Basic

/-!
# Dense range of the actual algebraic compact tensor action

The original completed pure vectors have dense complex span. Rank-one module
operators are continuous linear in their first vector and continuous star
semilinear in their second. The actual elementary tensor range contains every
pure-pair rank-one, hence its closed span contains every original rank-one.
The genuine compact module ideal is exactly that norm-closed rank-one span.

Subtype inducing topology gives dense range of the actual algebraic tensor
homomorphism in the existing CompactAlgebra H A. This is the missing onto
comparison prerequisite for its actually induced completion, not a proof of
raw injectivity, the least cross norm or the terminal Takai theorem.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions TensorProduct Topology
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original Hilbert/coefficient pure vectors have dense complex span in the actual completion. -/
theorem pure_dense_span :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    Dense (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : H × A => pure H A p.1 p.2) : Set (Space H A)) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  have hRange : Set.range (fun p : H × A => pure H A p.1 p.2) =
      Set.range (fun p : ScalarRight H × A => completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) p.1 p.2) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨ξ, a⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ, a), rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨ξ, a⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(ScalarRight.equivL H ξ, a), ?_⟩
      change completedPure (scalarSelfHom A)
        ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (ScalarRight.equivL H ξ)) a =
          completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ξ a
      rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [hRange]
  exact completedPure_dense_span (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)

/-- The actual algebraic tensor operator range closes to the original compact module ideal. -/
theorem closure_range_algebraicTensorOperator_eq_compactSubmodule :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    (LinearMap.range (algebraicTensorOperator H A)).topologicalClosure =
      AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule (B := A) (E := Space H A) (F := Space H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  let E := Space H A
  let D := AdjointableOperator.End A E
  let R : Submodule ℂ D := (LinearMap.range (algebraicTensorOperator H A)).topologicalClosure
  have hRclosed : IsClosed (R : Set D) := (LinearMap.range (algebraicTensorOperator H A)).isClosed_topologicalClosure
  let left (y : E) : E →L[ℂ] D :=
    ({ toFun := fun x => AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) x y
       map_add' := fun x x' => by
         apply AdjointableOperator.ext
         intro z
         change (x + x') <• rightInner (B := A) y z =
           x <• rightInner (B := A) y z + x' <• rightInner (B := A) y z
         exact CStarModule.add_right_smul x x' (rightInner (B := A) y z)
       map_smul' := fun c x => by
         apply AdjointableOperator.ext
         intro z
         change (c • x) <• rightInner (B := A) y z = c • (x <• rightInner (B := A) y z)
         exact CStarModule.smul_right_smul c x (rightInner (B := A) y z) } : E →ₗ[ℂ] D).mkContinuous ‖y‖
      (fun x => by
        change ‖AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) x y‖ ≤ ‖y‖ * ‖x‖
        simpa only [mul_comm] using (AdjointableOperator.norm_rankOne_le (B := A) x y))
  let right (x : E) : E →L⋆[ℂ] D :=
    ({ toFun := fun y => AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) x y
       map_add' := fun y y' => by
         apply AdjointableOperator.ext
         intro z
         change x <• rightInner (B := A) (y + y') z =
           x <• rightInner (B := A) y z + x <• rightInner (B := A) y' z
         rw [CStarModule.rightInner_add_left, CStarModule.right_smul_add]
       map_smul' := fun c y => by
         change AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) x (c • y) =
           star c • AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) x y
         apply AdjointableOperator.ext
         intro z
         simp only [AdjointableOperator.rankOne_apply, AdjointableOperator.smul_apply,
           CStarModule.rightInner_smul_left, CStarModule.right_smul_smul] } :
        E →ₗ⋆[ℂ] D).mkContinuous ‖x‖ (fun y => AdjointableOperator.norm_rankOne_le (B := A) x y)
  have hPure (ξ η : H) (u v : A) :
      AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) (pure H A ξ u) (pure H A η v) ∈ R := by
    apply Submodule.le_topologicalClosure
    refine ⟨(u * star v) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H ξ η, ?_⟩
    rw [algebraicTensorOperator_tmul, compactElementaryOperator_coe, compactHilbertHom_apply]
    change coefficientHom H A (u * star v) * hilbertOperator H A (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ ξ η) =
      AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) (pure H A ξ u) (pure H A η v)
    exact coefficient_hilbertRankOne_eq_rankOne H A ξ η u v
  have hdense : Dense (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : H × A => pure H A p.1 p.2) : Set E) :=
    pure_dense_span H A
  have hLeft (η : H) (v : A) (x : E) :
      AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) x (pure H A η v) ∈ R := by
    let P : Submodule ℂ E := R.comap (left (pure H A η v)).toLinearMap
    have hPclosed : IsClosed (P : Set E) := by
      change IsClosed ((left (pure H A η v)) ⁻¹' (R : Set D))
      exact hRclosed.preimage (left (pure H A η v)).continuous
    have hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : H × A => pure H A p.1 p.2) ≤ P := by
      apply Submodule.span_le.2
      rintro _ ⟨⟨ξ, u⟩, rfl⟩
      change AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) (pure H A ξ u) (pure H A η v) ∈ R
      exact hPure ξ η u v
    have hx : x ∈ P := (closure_minimal (fun _ h => hspan h) hPclosed) (hdense x)
    exact hx
  have hAll (x y : E) : AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) x y ∈ R := by
    let P : Submodule ℂ E := R.comap (right x).toLinearMap
    have hPclosed : IsClosed (P : Set E) := by
      change IsClosed ((right x) ⁻¹' (R : Set D))
      exact hRclosed.preimage (right x).continuous
    have hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : H × A => pure H A p.1 p.2) ≤ P := by
      apply Submodule.span_le.2
      rintro _ ⟨⟨η, v⟩, rfl⟩
      change AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) x (pure H A η v) ∈ R
      exact hLeft η v x
    have hy : y ∈ P := (closure_minimal (fun _ h => hspan h) hPclosed) (hdense y)
    exact hy
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ ?_ AdjointableOperator.isClosed_compactSubmodule
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact algebraicTensorOperator_mem_compact H A z
  · change (AdjointableOperator.finiteRankSubmodule (B := A) (E := E) (F := E)).topologicalClosure ≤ R
    apply Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ ?_ hRclosed
    apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hAll x y

/-- The actual algebraic A tensor K(full H) hom has dense range in the original compact module algebra. -/
theorem denseRange_algebraicCompactTensorHom :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    DenseRange (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  let ι : CompactAlgebra H A → AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A) := Subtype.val
  have hι : Topology.IsInducing ι := Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal
  change Dense (Set.range (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A))
  apply hι.dense_iff.mpr
  intro T
  have hImage : ι '' Set.range (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A) =
      Set.range (algebraicTensorOperator H A) := by
    ext U
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨S, ⟨z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨algebraicCompactTensorHom H A z, ⟨z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hImage]
  change (T : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A)) ∈
    (LinearMap.range (algebraicTensorOperator H A)).topologicalClosure
  rw [closure_range_algebraicTensorOperator_eq_compactSubmodule]
  exact T.property

end
