module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.HilbertAction
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.CoefficientHom
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.Calkin

/-!
# Actual elementary compact rank-one operators on Hilbert amplification

The original Hilbert rank-one operator is a genuine compact operator on the
same full Hilbert space. The product of its actual amplified action and the
coefficient product u * star v is the literal module rank-one operator on
xi tensor u and eta tensor v. Thus this elementary product has actual compact
A-module image, with a computed value in the existing compact ideal.

This is the generator prerequisite for the algebraic A tensor K(full H) map
into the original CompactAlgebra H A required by Blackadar Theorem10.1.2.
The arbitrary coefficient/compact-factor closure and minimum-completion
comparison remain separate needed constructors; terminal Takai proofs stay open.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions InnerProductSpace
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original full-H rank-one operator, bundled in the actual compact closed star ideal. -/
def hilbertCompactRankOne (ξ η : H) :
    (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier := by
  refine ⟨InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ ξ η, ?_⟩
  change IsCompactOperator (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ ξ η)
  have hcompact :=
    (isCompactOperator_of_locallyCompactSpace_rng
      (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ ξ)).comp_clm (_root_.innerSL ℂ (E := H) η)
  simpa only [InnerProductSpace.rankOne_def', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] using hcompact

/-- The original compact rank-one subtype has its literal full-H vector action. -/
theorem hilbertCompactRankOne_apply (ξ η ζ : H) :
    (hilbertCompactRankOne H ξ η : H →L[ℂ] H) ζ = inner ℂ η ζ • ξ :=
  rfl

/-- The compact-ideal inclusion retains the original rank-one operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem hilbertCompactRankOne_coe (x y : H) :
    (hilbertCompactRankOne H x y : H →L[ℂ] H) = InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ x y := rfl

/-- The original rank-one composition law in the actual compact ideal. -/
theorem hilbertCompactRankOne_mul (x y z w : H) :
    hilbertCompactRankOne H x y * hilbertCompactRankOne H z w = inner ℂ y z • hilbertCompactRankOne H x w := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ x y).comp (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ z w) =
    inner ℂ y z • InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ x w
  exact InnerProductSpace.rankOne_comp_rankOne x y z w

/-- The original adjoint exchanges the two rank-one vectors. -/
@[simp]
theorem hilbertCompactRankOne_star (x y : H) : star (hilbertCompactRankOne H x y) = hilbertCompactRankOne H y x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change star (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ x y) = InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ y x
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, InnerProductSpace.adjoint_rankOne]

variable (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original completed pure vector is complex-linear in its Hilbert factor. -/
theorem pure_smul_left (c : ℂ) (ξ : H) (b : A) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    pure H A (c • ξ) b = c • pure H A ξ b := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  change completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (c • ξ)) b =
    c • completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) b
  rw [map_smul]
  exact completedPure_smul_left (scalarSelfHom A) c ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) b

/-- Original coefficient multiplication is the actual completed right module action. -/
theorem pure_right_smul (ξ : H) (u v : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    pure H A ξ (u * v) = pure H A ξ u <• v := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  change completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) (u * v) =
    completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) u <• v
  simpa only [CStarModule.Right.right_smul_self] using
    completedPure_right_smul (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) u v

/-- The elementary coefficient/rank-one product equals the genuine amplified module rank-one operator. -/
theorem coefficient_hilbertRankOne_eq_rankOne (ξ η : H) (u v : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    coefficientHom H A (u * star v) *
        hilbertOperator H A (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ ξ η) =
      AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) (pure H A ξ u) (pure H A η v) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  apply operator_ext_pure H A
  intro ζ b
  rw [AdjointableOperator.mul_apply, hilbertOperator_pure, coefficientHom_pure,
    AdjointableOperator.rankOne_apply, rightInner_pure]
  change pure H A (inner ℂ η ζ • ξ) ((u * star v) * b) =
    pure H A ξ u <• (inner ℂ η ζ • (star v * b))
  rw [pure_smul_left, CStarModule.right_smul_smul, ← pure_right_smul, mul_assoc]

/-- The original elementary generator product belongs to the actual compact module ideal. -/
theorem coefficient_hilbertRankOne_mem_compact (ξ η : H) (u v : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    coefficientHom H A (u * star v) * hilbertOperator H A (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ ξ η) ∈
      AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule (B := A) (E := Space H A) (F := Space H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  rw [coefficient_hilbertRankOne_eq_rankOne]
  exact AdjointableOperator.rankOne_mem_compact (pure H A ξ u) (pure H A η v)

/-- A computed elementary rank-one value in the original compact algebra, with actual ideal membership. -/
def elementaryCompactRankOne (ξ η : H) (u v : A) : CompactAlgebra H A := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact ⟨AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := A) (pure H A ξ u) (pure H A η v),
    AdjointableOperator.rankOne_mem_compact (pure H A ξ u) (pure H A η v)⟩

/-- The constructed compact element has the exact original coefficient/Hilbert generator value. -/
theorem elementaryCompactRankOne_coe (ξ η : H) (u v : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    (elementaryCompactRankOne H A ξ η u v : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A)) =
      coefficientHom H A (u * star v) * hilbertOperator H A (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ ξ η) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact (coefficient_hilbertRankOne_eq_rankOne H A ξ η u v).symm

end

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.MatrixCoefficients
public import MathlibExt.Algebra.Star.StarAlgHom
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CStarMatrix
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Orthonormal

/-!
# The actual finite-frame matrix corner in the full compact tensor

For a finite orthonormal family in the original Hilbert space, send a matrix
to the literal sum of its entries tensor the original rank-one matrix units.
The stock rank-one product/adjoint laws prove its algebra and star fields;
the already constructed tensor matrix coefficients recover every entry.

This injective raw map is the finite-corner prerequisite for comparing each
genuine cross norm in its actual completion. It uses no tensor norm, completed
model, countable Hilbert basis or nontrivial/unit coefficient hypothesis.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators CStarAlgebra TensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

universe uH uA uI

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

variable {ι : Type uI} [Fintype ι]
variable (v : ι → H) (hv : Orthonormal ℂ v)

open scoped Classical in
omit [Fintype ι] in
include hv in
/-- Orthonormal rank-one matrix units have their literal Kronecker multiplication. -/
theorem hilbertCompactRankOne_frame_mul (i j k l : ι) :
    hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v j) * hilbertCompactRankOne H (v k) (v l) =
      if j = k then hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v l) else 0 := by
  rw [hilbertCompactRankOne_mul, (orthonormal_iff_ite.mp hv) j k]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [one_smul, zero_smul]

variable (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The actual finite matrix-entry tensor sum on the original raw algebraic tensor. -/
noncomputable def finiteMatrixTensorLinear :
    CStarMatrix ι ι A →ₗ[ℂ] A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier where
  toFun M := ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v j)
  map_add' M N := by
    simp only [CStarMatrix.add_apply, TensorProduct.add_tmul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c M := by
    simp only [RingHom.id_apply, CStarMatrix.smul_apply, Finset.smul_sum,
      TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

/-- Every source matrix has exactly its original finite entry/rank-one tensor sum. -/
theorem finiteMatrixTensorLinear_apply (M : CStarMatrix ι ι A) :
    finiteMatrixTensorLinear v A M =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v j) := rfl

open scoped Classical in
omit [Fintype ι] in
include hv in
/-- A product of two original tensor summands obeys the genuine matrix-unit law. -/
theorem finiteMatrixTensor_summand_mul (a b : A) (i j k l : ι) :
    (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v j)) *
        (b ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v k) (v l)) =
      if j = k then (a * b) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v l) else 0 := by
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, hilbertCompactRankOne_frame_mul v hv]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero]

include hv in
/-- The raw finite tensor sum preserves the original matrix multiplication. -/
theorem finiteMatrixTensorLinear_mul (M N : CStarMatrix ι ι A) :
    finiteMatrixTensorLinear v A (M * N) =
      finiteMatrixTensorLinear v A M * finiteMatrixTensorLinear v A N := by
  classical
  symm
  change (∑ i, ∑ j, M i j ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v j)) *
      (∑ k, ∑ l, N k l ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v k) (v l)) = _
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ l,
        (M i j ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v j)) *
          (N k l ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v k) (v l)) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ l,
        if j = k then (M i j * N k l) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v l) else 0 := by
      simp only [finiteMatrixTensor_summand_mul v hv A]
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ k,
        if j = k then (M i j * N k l) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v l) else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ l, (M i j * N j l) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v l) := by
      simp
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ l, ∑ j, (M i j * N j l) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v l) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = finiteMatrixTensorLinear v A (M * N) := by
      simp only [finiteMatrixTensorLinear_apply, CStarMatrix.mul_apply, TensorProduct.sum_tmul]

/-- The raw finite tensor sum preserves the original matrix adjoint. -/
theorem finiteMatrixTensorLinear_star (M : CStarMatrix ι ι A) :
    finiteMatrixTensorLinear v A (star M) = star (finiteMatrixTensorLinear v A M) := by
  simp only [finiteMatrixTensorLinear_apply, CStarMatrix.star_apply,
    star_sum, TensorProduct.star_tmul, hilbertCompactRankOne_star]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

include hv in
/-- Existing full-H tensor coefficients recover every original matrix entry. -/
theorem tensorMatrixCoefficient_finiteMatrixTensor (M : CStarMatrix ι ι A) (i j : ι) :
    tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v j) (v i) (finiteMatrixTensorLinear v A M) = M i j := by
  classical
  have hi := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp hv
  simp only [finiteMatrixTensorLinear_apply, map_sum, tensorMatrixCoefficient_tmul,
    compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient_apply, hilbertCompactRankOne_coe,
    InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply, inner_smul_right, hi]
  simp only [ite_mul, mul_ite, one_mul, zero_mul, mul_zero,
    ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul]
  simp [eq_comm]

include hv in
/-- The original matrix-entry sum is injective, including an empty finite frame. -/
theorem finiteMatrixTensorLinear_injective : Function.Injective (finiteMatrixTensorLinear v A) := by
  intro M N h
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  have hc := congrArg (tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v j) (v i)) h
  simpa only [tensorMatrixCoefficient_finiteMatrixTensor v hv A] using hc

/-- The actual nonunital star homomorphism from the original C-star matrix corner. -/
noncomputable def finiteMatrixTensorHom :
    CStarMatrix ι ι A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier :=
  NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ofLinearMap (finiteMatrixTensorLinear v A)
    (finiteMatrixTensorLinear_mul v hv A) (finiteMatrixTensorLinear_star v A)

/-- The star hom retains each actual finite matrix-entry tensor sum. -/
theorem finiteMatrixTensorHom_apply (M : CStarMatrix ι ι A) :
    finiteMatrixTensorHom v hv A M =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v j) := rfl

/-- The actual finite-frame star homomorphism has the original matrix kernel. -/
theorem finiteMatrixTensorHom_injective : Function.Injective (finiteMatrixTensorHom v hv A) :=
  finiteMatrixTensorLinear_injective v hv A

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.FiniteMatrixTensor

/-!
# Actual finite-frame corners of arbitrary raw compact tensors

Extract the original coefficient-valued entries of a raw tensor, then use
the actual finite matrix tensor map. On pure tensors this is the literal
finite rank-one compression of the compact factor. These linear maps are
needed to extend the finite-corner norm computation to every raw tensor;
they use no completed model or norm-comparison certificate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped TensorProduct BigOperators CStarAlgebra

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

universe uH uA uI

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {ι : Type uI}
variable (v : ι → H) (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original tensor matrix coefficients, collected in their actual source matrix. -/
noncomputable def tensorFrameMatrixLinear :
    A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier →ₗ[ℂ] CStarMatrix ι ι A where
  toFun z := CStarMatrix.ofMatrix fun i j => tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v j) (v i) z
  map_add' z w := by
    apply CStarMatrix.ext
    intro i j
    rw [CStarMatrix.add_apply]
    rw [CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_apply (m := ι) (n := ι) (A := A)
      (M := fun r c => tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v c) (v r) (z + w)) (i := i)]
    rw [CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_apply (m := ι) (n := ι) (A := A)
      (M := fun r c => tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v c) (v r) z) (i := i)]
    rw [CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_apply (m := ι) (n := ι) (A := A)
      (M := fun r c => tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v c) (v r) w) (i := i)]
    exact (tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v j) (v i)).map_add z w
  map_smul' c z := by
    apply CStarMatrix.ext
    intro i j
    rw [CStarMatrix.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
    rw [CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_apply (m := ι) (n := ι) (A := A)
      (M := fun r d => tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v d) (v r) (c • z)) (i := i)]
    rw [CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_apply (m := ι) (n := ι) (A := A)
      (M := fun r d => tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v d) (v r) z) (i := i)]
    exact (tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v j) (v i)).map_smul c z

/-- Each extracted matrix entry is the original full-H coefficient of the raw tensor. -/
theorem tensorFrameMatrixLinear_apply
    (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) (i j : ι) :
    tensorFrameMatrixLinear v A z i j = tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v j) (v i) z := rfl

variable [Fintype ι]

/-- The actual finite-frame raw tensor compression, with its linear structure. -/
noncomputable def finiteTensorCorner :
    A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier →ₗ[ℂ]
      A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier :=
  (finiteMatrixTensorLinear v A).comp (tensorFrameMatrixLinear v A)

/-- The corner is the literal sum of extracted entries tensor original rank-one operators. -/
theorem finiteTensorCorner_apply
    (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    finiteTensorCorner v A z =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, tensorMatrixCoefficient H A (v j) (v i) z ⊗ₜ[ℂ] hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v j) := rfl

/-- An orthonormal corner is the image of its actual matrix under the constructed star hom. -/
theorem finiteTensorCorner_eq_finiteMatrixTensorHom (hv : Orthonormal ℂ v)
    (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    finiteTensorCorner v A z = finiteMatrixTensorHom v hv A (tensorFrameMatrixLinear v A z) := rfl

/-- On each pure tensor, the compact factor has its actual finite rank-one compression. -/
theorem finiteTensorCorner_tmul (a : A)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    finiteTensorCorner v A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) =
      a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (∑ i, ∑ j,
        inner ℂ (v i) ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) (v j)) • hilbertCompactRankOne H (v i) (v j)) := by
  simp only [finiteTensorCorner_apply, tensorMatrixCoefficient_tmul,
    compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient_apply, TensorProduct.tmul_sum, TensorProduct.smul_tmul]

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.CoefficientAction

/-!
# The actual Hilbert-factor action on coefficient amplification

The existing scalar-right correspondence transports an original bounded
Hilbert-space operator and its genuine Hilbert adjoint. The existing completed
first-factor construction acts on the literal Hilbert/coefficient tensor.
Its original pure formula implies commutation with the coefficient action.

These are the two factors needed for the elementary A tensor K(H) operator
in Blackadar, K-Theory for Operator Algebras, Theorem10.1.2. Definition13.5.1
and its following paragraph give the actual internal tensor and first-factor
operator. The minimum tensor norm and the Takai isomorphism remain separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original Hilbert operator acts through the actual completed first-factor map. -/
def hilbertOperator (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact completedLeftOperator (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (F₁ := ScalarRight H)
    (scalarSelfHom A) (ScalarRight.Adjointable.ofContinuousLinearMap H H T)

/-- The original coefficient stays fixed while its Hilbert vector receives the source operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem hilbertOperator_pure (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ : H) (b : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    hilbertOperator H A T (pure H A ξ b) = pure H A (T ξ) b := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  have hSource : ScalarRight.Adjointable.ofContinuousLinearMap H H T
      ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) = (ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (T ξ) := by
    apply (ScalarRight.equivL H).injective
    rw [ScalarRight.Adjointable.ofContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change completedLeftOperator (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (F₁ := ScalarRight H)
      (scalarSelfHom A) (ScalarRight.Adjointable.ofContinuousLinearMap H H T)
      (completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) b) =
    completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (T ξ)) b
  rw [completedLeftOperator_pure, hSource]

/-- The actual stored adjoint acts through the genuine Hilbert-space adjoint. -/
@[simp]
theorem hilbertOperator_adjoint_pure (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ : H) (b : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    (hilbertOperator H A T).adjoint (pure H A ξ b) =
      pure H A (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ξ) b := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  have hSource : (ScalarRight.Adjointable.ofContinuousLinearMap H H T).adjoint
      ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) =
        (ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ξ) := by
    apply (ScalarRight.equivL H).injective
    let L : AdjointableOperator.End ℂ (ScalarRight H) :=
      ScalarRight.Adjointable.ofContinuousLinearMap H H T
    let Lstar : AdjointableOperator.End ℂ (ScalarRight H) :=
      ScalarRight.Adjointable.ofContinuousLinearMap H H (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T)
    have hLstar : L.adjointOperator = Lstar :=
      ScalarRight.Adjointable.ofContinuousLinearMap_adjointOperator H H T
    have hEq : ScalarRight.equivL H (L.adjointOperator ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ)) =
        ScalarRight.equivL H ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ξ)) := by
      calc
        ScalarRight.equivL H (L.adjointOperator ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ)) =
            ScalarRight.equivL H (Lstar ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ)) :=
          congrArg (fun S : AdjointableOperator.End ℂ (ScalarRight H) =>
            ScalarRight.equivL H (S ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ))) hLstar
        _ = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T
            (ScalarRight.equivL H ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ)) :=
          ScalarRight.Adjointable.ofContinuousLinearMap_apply H H
            (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ)
        _ = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ξ :=
          congrArg (fun v : H => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T v)
            ((ScalarRight.equivL H).apply_symm_apply ξ)
        _ = ScalarRight.equivL H
            ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ξ)) :=
          ((ScalarRight.equivL H).apply_symm_apply _).symm
    simpa only [AdjointableOperator.adjointOperator_apply] using hEq
  change (completedLeftOperator (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (F₁ := ScalarRight H)
      (scalarSelfHom A) (ScalarRight.Adjointable.ofContinuousLinearMap H H T)).adjoint
      (completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm ξ) b) =
    completedPure (scalarSelfHom A)
      ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ξ)) b
  rw [completedLeftOperator_adjoint_pure, hSource]

/-- The actual completed Hilbert action retains the original Hilbert operator norm bound. -/
theorem hilbertOperator_norm_le (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    ‖hilbertOperator H A T‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  have hBound := completedLeftOperator_norm_le (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (F₁ := ScalarRight H)
    (scalarSelfHom A) (ScalarRight.Adjointable.ofContinuousLinearMap H H T)
  rw [ScalarRight.Adjointable.norm_ofContinuousLinearMap] at hBound
  exact hBound

/-- The two actual completed factor operators commute on the original amplification. -/
theorem hilbertOperator_commutes_coefficientOperator (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (a : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    Commute (hilbertOperator H A T) (coefficientOperator H A a) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  let L : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A) := hilbertOperator H A T
  let R : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A) := coefficientOperator H A a
  have hMaps : L.toContinuousLinearMap.comp R.toContinuousLinearMap =
      R.toContinuousLinearMap.comp L.toContinuousLinearMap := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_on
      (completedPure_dense_span (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A))
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, b⟩, rfl⟩
    have hx : completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) x b =
        pure H A (ScalarRight.equivL H x) b := by
      change completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) x b =
        completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (ScalarRight.equivL H x)) b
      rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    change L (R (completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) x b)) =
      R (L (completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) x b))
    rw [hx]
    change hilbertOperator H A T (coefficientOperator H A a
        (pure H A (ScalarRight.equivL H x) b)) =
      coefficientOperator H A a (hilbertOperator H A T
        (pure H A (ScalarRight.equivL H x) b))
    rw [coefficientOperator_pure, hilbertOperator_pure, hilbertOperator_pure, coefficientOperator_pure]
  change L * R = R * L
  apply AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro z
  change (L.toContinuousLinearMap.comp R.toContinuousLinearMap) z =
    (R.toContinuousLinearMap.comp L.toContinuousLinearMap) z
  exact congrArg (fun f : Space H A →L[ℂ] Space H A => f z) hMaps

end
